TL;DR: ECAS(Edge-Controlled Agentic System)提出一种面向高性能计算(HPC)科学应用的智能体系统，通过将云端LLM推理、边缘设备控制和HPC执行三层分离，并采用验证门控(validation-gated)执行机制，实现从自然语言目标到目标规模HPC作业的闭环自动化执行，最小化人工干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC科学应用的部署是"翻译问题"——将高层目标转换为系统特定的工件(源码、环境、启动命令、批处理脚本)易出错且劳动密集。虽然LLM智能体可自动化此过程，但存在两大障碍：(1)信任与可靠性问题——云端模型直接访问HPC会暴露凭据和执行权限，缺乏本地策略检查；(2)适应性障碍——一次性生成无法应对站点特定的运行时故障。

Method: ECAS采用三层架构：(1)云端(推理平面)——托管LLM提出计划、工件和修复，输出抽象诊断而非站点特定命令；(2)边缘(控制平面)——用户控制设备持有凭据、工作流状态、策略检查、日志清理和执行权限；(3)HPC(执行平面)——通过MCP/IRI执行作业。核心机制为验证门控执行：静态检查→小规模验证→基于清理后反馈的修复→策略门控通过后提升至目标规模。额外包含构建阶段的专家-在环技能构建方法：HPC专家离线处理代表性任务，每次修正被提炼为边缘私有的、可复用的"技能"(站点特定的过程性知识)，部署时通过检索相关技能来条件化生成与修复。

Result: 在ALCF的Crux和Sophia两套生产系统上，使用IOR、DLIO和E3SM-IO三种科学应用，在6种注入故障类型下的初步实验表明：(1)端到端可行性——三个工作负载均完成端到端执行，E3SM-IO在512进程目标规模达到1112 MiB/s聚合写入带宽；(2)闭环修复——一次性生成0/6故障解决，闭环修复提升至6/6(30/30次运行全部自主完成)；(3)验证门控——三种运行时故障下，直接提交在15/15次运行中产生4节点目标规模失败，验证门控将所有失败限制在1节点验证阶段，目标规模失败为0/15；(4)技能条件化——冷启动(空技能库)代理仅解决4/6故障(20/30)，技能条件化代理解决全部6/6(30/30)，将两个需站点特定知识的故障从不可解决转为自主修复。

Conclusion: ECAS证明了将自适应推理委托给云端、同时在边缘保留执行控制的可行性。凭据、状态、技能库和执行权限保留在用户控制的边缘，作业仅在验证通过后提升，为LLM驱动的HPC自动化提供凭据隔离和策略中介执行，同时减少浪费的节点小时数。构建阶段的专家-在环方法将站点专业知识一次性捕获为可复用技能，使部署循环自动运行，仅在真正新颖的故障时需要专家介入。作为研究原型，评估存在局限(两个相关系统、确定性故障注入、小规模)，完整评估正在进行中。

Abstract: Scientific applications increasingly rely on high-performance computing (HPC), yet translating a scientist's high-level goal into a correct target-scale execution remains brittle and labor-intensive. Large language model (LLM) agents promise to automate this, but two obstacles remain: granting a cloud-hosted model direct HPC access exposes credentials and execution authority, while withholding it demands continuous human supervision; and one-shot generation cannot adapt when generated artifacts fail in a site-specific HPC environment. We present \textsc{ECAS}, an \textbf{E}dge-\textbf{C}ontrolled \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{S}ystem for closed-loop execution of scientific computing campaigns with limited human intervention. \textsc{ECAS} separates \emph{reasoning}, \emph{control}, and \emph{execution}: a cloud-hosted LLM proposes plans, artifacts, and repairs; a user-controlled edge agent retains credentials, workflow state, and execution authority while enforcing policy and resource constraints; and the HPC system computes. Its core mechanism is \emph{validation-gated execution}: generated artifacts pass static checks and small-scale validation, failures trigger repairs from sanitized execution feedback, and target-scale execution is permitted only after validation and policy checks pass. \textsc{ECAS} also draws on an edge-resident library of expert-distilled, site-specific skills that is never disclosed to the cloud. In preliminary experiments with three scientific applications on two production ALCF systems under six injected fault types, closed-loop repair improves application success from 0/6 to 6/6 over one-shot generation, validation gating prevents all three observed target-scale failures, and skill conditioning improves success from 4/6 to 6/6. These results show the feasibility of delegating adaptive reasoning to the cloud while retaining execution control at the edge.

</details>


### [180] [OpWeave: Flexible Operator Disaggregation for Heterogeneous LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14237)
*Zikun Li,Yixuan Mei,Shiqi Pan,Zixuan Chen,Xiaowen Zhang,Mengdi Wu,Shuhuai Lin,Yutong Yang,Zhihao Zhang,Xupeng Miao,Rashmi Vinayak,Zhihao Jia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OpWeave 提出了一套面向异构 GPU 的算子级解耦服务（ODS）端到端框架，通过解析成本模型、规则性感知的规划器以及基于 vLLM 的灵活运行时，在满足 TPOT SLO 的前提下显著降低大模型推理服务成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统在解码阶段将注意力与 FFN/MoE 算子共置部署，导致两类算子（内存带宽受限的注意力 vs. 计算密集的 GEMM）在硬件匹配上低效，且 KV 缓存与模型权重争夺显存限制了可服务的批大小；此外，现有固定边界（如 attention–FFN split）的 ODS 方案缺乏统一的理论刻画，且难以适应混合注意力（hybrid-attention）模型中层间结构的差异。

Method: 1) 建立解析成本模型，给出 colocation、homogeneous ODS、heterogeneous ODS 三种模式下每 token 成本的闭式表达，并证明同构与异构 ODS 相对共置部署的增益上界及单峰性；2) 提出 partition block 抽象与 regularity-aware 子块模板，将算子划分与设备组部署的组合搜索压缩到可处理规模；3) 构建网络安全的每 owner Pareto 前沿，并使用分支定界精确搜索最低成本满足 TPOT SLO 的方案；4) 基于 vLLM 实现分布式运行时，每个 rank 通过单次 native 提交完成整轮解码的计算与通信序列。

Result: 在 H100 同构集群上，OpWeave 相对最佳可行基线最高降低 1.78× 服务成本，pipeline stage 数从 124 降至 20.7，每输出 token 跨节点传输量最高减少 22.8×，计算占用率超过 80%（基线约 50%）；在 H100+L40S / H100+A100 异构集群上，最高相对非 OpWeave 基线降低 1.89×，相对同构 OpWeave 平均再降 14%，与理论上限 (1+√η)/2 的趋势一致。

Conclusion: OpWeave 首次将算子级解耦服务的理论、规划与执行打通：通过成本模型量化了 ODS 的适用条件与收益上限，通过规则性感知的精确规划在异构硬件上联合搜索最优算子切分、并行与批量配置，并通过低开销运行时落地；其抽象和结论为未来面向更异构模型与硬件的算子级解耦研究提供了基础。

Abstract: LLM serving systems increasingly disaggregate inference into finer-grained stages, with recent approaches separating attention from FFN or MoE execution during decode. This operator-level disaggregated serving (ODS) can improve hardware matching and enable independent scaling, particularly across heterogeneous devices. However, existing systems fix operator boundaries and lack a unified characterization of when disaggregation reduces serving cost. We present OpWeave, an end-to-end framework for heterogeneous ODS. OpWeave provides an analytical cost model that bounds the gains of homogeneous and heterogeneous ODS over colocated serving. It jointly optimizes operator partitioning and deployment configuration through a regularity-aware planner that keeps the search tractable even for hybrid-attention models. A vLLM-based runtime executes the synthesized plans with flexible operator stages across heterogeneous device groups. In our evaluation, OpWeave reduces serving cost by up to $1.78\times$ on homogeneous and $1.89\times$ on heterogeneous GPU clusters relative to the best feasible baseline, while meeting latency SLOs.

</details>


### [181] [MANE: A Multi-Path Adaptive Network for Edge Onloading of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14660)
*Sokratis Nikolaidis,Stylianos I. Venieris,Leonidas Malachias,Iakovos S. Venieris*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MANE是一个面向多设备边缘推理的分布式框架，通过在服务器端设计多路径尾部架构，结合三阶段训练方案和基于滞回调度的设备回退策略，在多租户边缘服务器场景下实现动态的精度-吞吐量权衡，显著提升SLO满足率和系统吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能办公等多设备物联网环境中，单个边缘服务器需同时为多个设备提供推理辅助。现有按需加载（onloading）方法假设单设备独占服务器，缺少有效的多租户负载管理机制，导致请求队列积压、延迟SLO违反严重，甚至退化为设备端推理而丧失精度优势。

Method: 1. **多路径尾部架构**：服务器端在预训练骨干网络中设计三条不同深度的注入路径（accurate/balanced/fast），配合轻量级路径无关的设备端共享头部（约12.6k参数），实现运行时精度-吞吐量的动态调节。2. **三阶段训练方案**：(a) 第一阶段联合优化共享头部和所有路径适配器，提出Joint Head Network Distillation (JHND)损失以学习通用中间表示；(b) 第二阶段冻结共享头，单独训练各路径适配器；(c) 第三阶段冻结头并附加预训练尾部，用标准知识蒸馏微调各路径。3. **基于滞回的调度器**：通过增长计数器(GC)和排空计数器(DC)实现路径间的迟滞切换，避免振荡；在最快路径仍过载时按比例ϕ=0.2对设备实施公平轮换的回退策略，并设有冷却时间T_cooldown以稳定负载。

Result: 在Tiny ImageNet（200类）上，使用ResNet152和ConvNeXt Small在RTX 3080服务器及Samsung S20 FE设备上的部署评估显示：MANE在最多40个并发设备的100ms严格SLO下保持80%以上的SLO满足率，而服务器端基线在15-20设备时已完全失败（满足率降至0%）；在精度上比设备端MobileNetV2基线高6个百分点（最终达76-78% vs. 73.13%）；系统吞吐量优于所有服务器端基线，无明显平台期；设备端额外开销仅5ms，远低于MobileNetV2的25ms。

Conclusion: MANE通过多路径架构、联合头部蒸馏和基于滞回的公平调度，首次将多路径分割计算、瓶颈蒸馏和多租户调度统一在一个框架中，使分割计算能够在多设备智能边缘环境中保持鲁棒性和可扩展性，是迈向实用化智能室内环境推理的重要一步。

Abstract: Split computing constitutes a widely used distributed inference approach, where a lightweight head model is onloaded onto the device and a heavier tail model resides on an edge server, leveraging the growing computational capabilities of modern System-on-Chips while alleviating server load. As intelligent indoor environments such as smart offices grow increasingly populated with diverse IoT devices, a single edge server must simultaneously assist multiple devices, each competing for the same shared inference resources. Without a principled mechanism to manage this shared load, the server is quickly overwhelmed, causing latency SLO violations and rendering server-assisted inference ineffective. In this work, we present MANE, a distributed inference framework that equips the server with a multi-path tail architecture, enabling a dynamic accuracy--throughput trade-off at runtime. By introducing a novel multi-path model architecture, a three-stage training scheme featuring a Joint Head Network Distillation loss and a hysteresis-based scheduler with an equitable device-fallback policy, MANE maintains over 80% SLO satisfaction rate where state-of-the-art onloading methods fail completely, while preserving accuracy 6pp higher than on-device alternatives, across up to 40 concurrent devices.

</details>


### [182] [TriCalRAG: A Three-Strategy, Retrieval-Augmented Benchmark for On-Premise LLM-Based Root Cause Analysis in AIOps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14762)
*Rohit Patel,Susil Kumar Mohanty,Jeenal Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TriCalRAG 提出了一个在单块高性能工作站 GPU（RTX PRO 6000, 96GB）上对开源大模型进行根因分析（RCA）的可复现基准，在四个真实日志数据集（BGL、HDFS、Thunderbird、OpenStack）上对比两个开源模型（Qwen2.5-14B、Mistral-Small）在零样本、少样本和 RAG 三种提示策略下的表现，并与经典 LSTM 基线 DeepLog 对比。核心发现：RAG 不仅将平均 F1 提升 0.10-0.27，更重要的是显著稳定了模型校准——零样本提示会驱使两模型产生"几乎全预测为异常"的退化行为，而 RAG 在多数配置下保持预测阳性率接近真实类别平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端 LLM API 在 AIOps 根因分析中面临数据隐私风险、网络延迟和按查询计费成本的问题，且现有 LLM 服务基准多假设多卡数据中心集群，缺乏对单卡工作站部署可行性的严格评估。此外，仅靠 F1 等聚合指标会掩盖模型在类别不平衡下的退化行为（如全预测为正类），需要校准诊断。

Method: 在单块 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 (96GB) 上通过 vLLM 服务 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 和 Mistral-Small-Instruct(22B)，针对 600 个 5 行连续日志窗口构成的事件（每数据集 150 个，50/50 平衡），采用零样本、少样本（固定 2 个示例）、RAG（FAISS+MiniLM-L6 检索 Top-3 相似历史事件，排除查询自身）三种提示策略。模型输出结构化 JSON，由 F1、精确率/召回率（3 随机种子 + 1000 次 bootstrap 95% 置信区间）评估，并辅以预测阳性率作为校准诊断。基线为在无泄露数据上重训的 DeepLog LSTM。消融实验研究批量大小（1-128）和 AWQ 4-bit 量化的影响。

Result: 1) 主结果：Mistral-Small 宏平均 F1=0.644 优于 Qwen2.5-14B 的 0.560，但 Qwen 校准失败配置数（5/12）少于 Mistral（7/12），且吞吐量约为其两倍（713 vs 366 tok/s）。2) RAG 在 BGL（F1=0.92-0.94）和 Thunderbird（F1=0.88-89）显著优于零样本（F1=0.51-0.73）；HDFS 因窗口粒度与按块标注不匹配，所有方法 F1 均不超过 0.687。3) 校准：零样本下 Mistral-Small 在 BGL/HDFS/OpenStack 的预测阳性率达 0.987-1.000，而 RAG 配置中 7/8 保持校准，零样本仅 2/8。4) DeepLog 修正无泄露后 F1=0.698，介于两个 LLM 之间。5) 消融：批量 1→128 吞吐量提升 41×（48→1991 tok/s）；AWQ 4-bit 量化延迟降低 20% 且 F1 几乎无变化（0.739 vs 0.730）。

Conclusion: 在单卡工作站 GPU 上运行开源 LLM 进行 AIOps 根因分析是可行的，主要瓶颈不在硬件而在于提示设计。RAG 是最可靠的配置，其核心价值在于稳定校准而非单纯提升 F1——仅靠 F1 会严重高估退化模型的能力。模型选择取决于部署优先级：追求峰值精度选 Mistral-Small，追求跨提示条件的稳定行为和高吞吐选 Qwen2.5-14B。论文还公开了完整的基准测试框架、数据集划分和评估代码以支持可复现研究。局限包括：HDFS 窗口粒度不匹配、模型覆盖仅两家、DeepLog 评估规模较小、未对生成的根因文本质量自动评分。

Abstract: Cloud-hosted large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for root cause analysis (RCA) in AIOps pipelines, but they introduce data privacy risk, network latency, and per-query cost that scale poorly with production log volumes. We present TriCalRAG, a benchmark evaluating open-weight LLMs served locally via vLLM on a single high-memory workstation GPU (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, 96GB) against a classical LSTM-based log anomaly detector (DeepLog), across four real, publicly available log datasets (BGL, HDFS, Thunderbird, OpenStack). We evaluate two open-weight models (Qwen2.5-14B, Mistral-Small) under three prompting strategies: zero-shot, few-shot, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a labeled incident history, reporting accuracy, precision/recall, and F1 with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across 3 random seeds, alongside throughput and VRAM footprint. Our results show that RAG not only improves mean F1 by 0.10-0.27 over zero-shot prompting but, more importantly, substantially stabilizes model calibration: zero-shot prompting drives both models toward near-degenerate behavior (predicting "anomaly" on up to 100% of incidents on some datasets), while RAG keeps predicted-positive rates close to the true class balance in the majority of configurations. Mistral-Small achieves higher macro-averaged F1 than Qwen2.5-14B (0.644 vs. 0.560) but exhibits calibration failures in more configurations (7 vs. 5 of 12), while running at roughly half the throughput - indicating the better model choice depends on whether a deployment prioritizes peak accuracy or predictable behavior across prompting conditions. Ablations show batching scales throughput 41 times on a single card and that 4-bit quantization reduces latency 20% with no measurable accuracy loss. We release our benchmark harness, dataset splits, and evaluation code to support reproducible on-premise AIOps research.

</details>


### [183] [Validating Hybrid-State Cache Recovery for GLM-5.3-Flash with vLLM and LMCache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15030)
*Frank Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对混合注意力语言模型 GLM-5.3-Flash 与 vLLM+LMCache 集成中的缓存恢复不一致问题，提出 strict-prefix lookup 修复方案，并在受控数值对照下完成实验验证与串行性能测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 hybrid LLM 推理中，外部 KV/状态缓存传输成功后，调度器可能仍按错误的前缀长度恢复，导致生成偏离。论文揭示并修复了 GLM-5.3-Flash + vLLM + LMCache 在四路张量并行下出现的 complete-hit 但状态/位置不匹配（state/position mismatch）问题。

Method: 在四卡 TP=4 配置下，对 45 层 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 量化检查点运行 vLLM + LMCache；构造"modified recomputation control"作为数值基线（共享计算修正、匹配检查点调度、固化每 rank 的 FLA autotuner profile），并通过 strict-prefix lookup 排除查询末尾 token 后再做检查点选择；对 9 个边界 prompt 长度做 pre-fix/repaired 配对矩阵、instrumented 传输与保存回归、三模板扩展以及串行性能对比。

Result: 修复前 36 个配对生成有 34/36 一致，在 N=3584 与 N=5376 两个精确边界上失败；strict-prefix 修复后 36/36 一致。instrumented run 通过 20928 行页面比对、432 个非零尾部 H2D 观测与 268 个延迟保存等待。三模板扩展在两个新容器中以 256 token 续写通过 72 对。两个容器对 120 个请求保持输出相等；CPU reload 相比 cold 重算使 TTFT 降低 46–64%，总时延降低 1.9–7.0%。

Conclusion: 在单一模型版本与受控配置下，对集成故障的 strict-prefix 修复路径得到有限实验验证，并测得串行场景下的 CPU reload 收益；但论文明确声明该证据不足以证明通用确定性、任务质量等价、并发服务收益或超出 GPU 内存的容量扩展。

Abstract: External cache transfers can succeed while a hybrid language model resumes from an inconsistent state. We examine the full 45-layer GLM-5.3-Flash model, using the RedHatAI/ GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 quantized checkpoint with vLLM and LMCache under four-way tensor parallelism. A complete-hit recovery mismatch restored state for the full prompt while the scheduler credited one fewer token. We aligned recovery through strict-prefix lookup and established a numerical comparison using shared computation corrections, matched checkpoint scheduling, and fixed per-rank kernel configurations. In a nine-length serial workload, agreement with the modified recomputation control improved from 34/36 to 36/36 generations, each containing 64 token IDs. A separate instrumented run passed recorded transfer-page, effective-tail, and delayed-save checks. Three additional synthetic templates passed 72 paired 256-token continuations across two fresh-container runs. A subsequent serial performance study preserved output equality across 120 requests; among the measured trials, CPU reload reduced time to first token by 46-64% and total request time by 1.9-7.0% relative to modified cold recomputation. The contribution is an experimentally validated integration repair applying an existing checkpoint-alignment principle. The evidence is confined to one model revision and controlled configuration; it does not establish general determinism, task-quality equivalence, concurrent-serving gains, or capacity beyond GPU memory.

</details>


### [184] [CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15664)
*Victor H. Chen,Hairui Yu,Stella K. Chung,Hong Yan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出CIDERS框架，针对云-边协同大语言模型部署中全局共识与本地个性化难以平衡的问题，首次将云边协作建模为个性化双层优化（上层优化边端个性化messenger，下层进行云端知识蒸馏），并通过共识变量校正将全局轨迹嵌入到每一步本地个性化更新中。在Qwen2.5-3B/1.5B上的实验表明，在压缩边端路径上数学推理提升3.1×、代码生成提升1.7×，指令指标相对提升10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云-边LLM范式固守模型共识原则，忽略了边缘场景中数据、用户行为和物理环境的天然个性化特性，导致模型参数调整能力分散在云端与边缘之间，无法同时满足统一知识基础与领域特定适应的需求。物理世界智能（如自动驾驶、工业机器人闭环控制）对低延迟、数据隐私和实时性提出了硬性要求，使云-边协作成为架构性必然。

Method: 方法包含三大模块：(1) 模型分解——将LLM分为云端冻结全骨干ℬ_F、本地可学习压缩骨干ℬ_L和客户端个性化messenger 𝒫_M；(2) 个性化双层优化(PBO)——上层优化messenger实现快速客户端适应，下层通过任务感知知识蒸馏(TAKD)对齐可学习骨干与下游任务；(3) 共识变量校正几何更新——客户端维护本地共识变量c_i，通过γ参数调节将全局轨迹注入本地个性化步骤，云端仅传输压缩的共识增量Δc_i以实现精确的本地位移重建。算法提供FO（一阶）和FD（有限差分Hessian-向量积）两种求解器。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B/1.5B上的三个互补协议实验中，CIDERS-FO在6个指标中均领先FedBiOT、FedOT和LocalOT：GSM8K精度领先5.30–11.15个百分点，Dolly PPL降低约8.7%，HumanEval-X三种语言pass@1提升2.4–4.3个百分点；压缩后6层messenger在NLL上比FedBiOT低9.9–22.2%。理论分析证明在η=O(T^{-1/2})步长下，联合目标差距以O(T^{-1/2})次线性速率收敛到稳定邻域，参考方向几何上位于本地梯度与全局共识方向的连线段上，权重ψ_t=(1-γ)+γ(1-α)^t。

Conclusion: CIDERS首次为云-边LLM系统提供了完整的个性化双层优化理论框架和高效求解器，通过共识变量校正机制成功协调全局共识与本地个性化，实验证明该方法在压缩部署路径下显著优于现有联邦微调基线。然而，FD相对FO无一致优势，AdapEmu与全骨干AdapFu之间仍存在显著能力差距，跨域个性化匹配优势较小但绝对响应质量更优。未来工作将扩展至具身智能与世界模型。

Abstract: Amid the rapid advancement of physical-world intelligence, cloud-edge collaborative large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising roadmap for practical LLM deployment. However, existing cloud-edge paradigms struggle to balance global consensus with local personalization, which fails to satisfy the need for a unified knowledge foundation on the cloud and domain-specific adaptation at the edge. To address this, we introduce, for the first time, a personalized bilevel optimization framework that formalizes cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a dual structure: the upper level optimizes edge-side personalization, while the lower level governs cloud-side knowledge transfer, reaching cloud-edge evolving in coordination. We then propose CIDERS, an efficient solver that decomposes the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger. While the cloud performs knowledge transfer to the learnable backbone, the key lies in embedding global trajectories into each local personalization step via consensus-variate correction to reconcile personalization with consensus. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis, including a geometric characterization of the local trajectory and a full convergence guarantee, revealing an explicit trade-off structure between personalization and global convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CIDERS consistently outperforms competitive baselines on the compressed edge path, with 3.1x and 1.7x gains on mathematical reasoning and code generation, respectively, and a 10\% relative gain on instruction metrics. Mechanism experiments attribute these gains to early consensus-corrected coordination and task-aware distillation. Overall, CIDERS offers a viable path toward consensus-guided continuous personalization in cloud-edge LLM systems.

</details>


### [185] [Scalability and Performance Evaluation of Federated Learning Frameworks: A Comparative Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15681)
*Bassel Soudan,Sohail Abbas,Ahmed Kubba,Manar Wasif Abu Talib,Qassim Nasir*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对四个主流联邦学习框架（FedML、Flower、Substra、OpenFL）进行了系统的实验比较，重点评估了它们在不同客户端数量下的可扩展性和关键性能指标（训练时间、损失、准确率、CPU和RAM使用情况）。OpenFL在可扩展性方面表现最佳，Substra资源效率高但训练时间呈指数增长，Flower损失异常偏高，FedML准确率偏低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习领域存在多种开源框架，但缺乏对它们在可扩展性和实际性能方面的系统性比较。随着FL应用场景的扩展，框架在不同规模下的表现对实际部署至关重要，因此需要为研究者和从业者提供选型指导。

Method: 对FedML、Flower、Substra和OpenFL四个FL框架进行实验性比较，通过改变客户端数量进行联邦学习训练，重点分析以下指标：(1) 总训练时间；(2) 损失值与准确率；(3) CPU和RAM资源使用情况。从可扩展性角度评估各框架在不同客户端规模下的性能特征。

Result: Flower显示异常高的损失值；FedML准确率范围较低（66%-79%）；Substra资源效率良好，但总训练时间随客户端数增加呈指数增长；OpenFL在所有客户端规模下均表现出稳定的准确率、损失和训练时间，CPU和RAM使用也保持稳定，可扩展性最佳。

Conclusion: OpenFL是最具可扩展性的FL平台，在不同客户端数量下保持稳定的性能指标，适合实际部署场景；Substra在资源效率方面表现优异但存在训练时间的可扩展性瓶颈；各框架在性能特征上差异显著。本研究为FL框架的选型和实际部署提供了有价值的参考依据。

Abstract: This paper presents a systematic examination and experimental comparison of the prominent Federated Learning (FL) frameworks FedML, Flower, Substra, and OpenFL. The frameworks are evaluated experimentally by implementing Federated Learning over a varying number of clients, emphasizing a thorough analysis of scalability and key performance metrics. The study assesses the impact of increasing client counts on total training time, loss and accuracy values, and CPU and RAM usage. Results indicate distinct performance characteristics among the frameworks, with Flower displaying an unusually high loss, FedML achieving a notably low accuracy range of 66% to 79%, and Substra demonstrating good resource efficiency, albeit with an exponential growth in total training time. Notably, OpenFL emerges as the most scalable platform, demonstrating consistent accuracy, loss, and training time across different client counts. OpenFL's stable CPU and RAM underscore its reliability in real-world scenarios. This comprehensive analysis provides valuable insights into the relative performance of FL frameworks, offering good understanding of their capabilities and providing guidance for their effective deployment across diverse user bases.

</details>


### [186] [A Lifecycle Cost Analysis of Smart-Contract-Coordinated Federated Learning Marketplaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13170)
*Luan Mantegazine,Luiza Leidemer,Claudio Geyer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对基于智能合约协调的联邦学习（FL）市场进行端到端的生命周期成本分析，提出并验证了解析摊销模型，揭示该类系统的运行成本呈摊销式结构——固定部署成本远高于每轮重复成本，因此随联邦运行轮次增加，每轮平均成本会快速逼近其重复操作渐近值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有区块链+联邦学习市场的工作大多只评估孤立的区块链交易成本（如单次合约调用的 gas），缺乏对完整市场生命周期经济性的刻画。这导致一个核心问题未被回答：运行成本究竟由一次性部署主导（可摊销）还是由每轮重复操作主导（线性增长），而这直接决定了该类平台是否随规模扩大而变得经济。

Method: 实现 DAO 治理的市场参考架构（Solidity 智能合约 + IPFS + Flower FL 框架），在本地 Hardhat EVM 上精确计量每个生命周期阶段（设置阶段 s19–s23、训练循环 s24–s31、结算阶段 s32–s33）的 gas 消耗；在 MNIST/MNISTNet 上以 FedAvg 进行三组对照消融（baseline / no-IPFS / full），分析 N∈{2,8,16,32} 的执行时间分解；推导出摊销解析模型 ḡ(R)=G_setup/R+G_round，并将其推广为关于受雇训练者数 N_t 的摊销拐点 R_be(N_t)。

Result: （1）消融：baseline/no-IPFS/full 三组最终精度统计上无差异（0.9882–0.9885），每轮时间差异落在实验噪声范围内，说明去中心化协调层对学习无负面影响；（2）生命周期 gas 分解：每名受雇训练者的一次性部署约 3.8M gas，其中 registerTrainer 与 AcceptOffer 占部署成本约 3/4；每轮重复成本约 0.5M gas（3 名训练者时 G_round(3)=496,400）；（3）摊销模型：摊销拐点 R_be≈20.37 轮（定义为平均成本=2×渐近重复成本），R=100 时平均成本仅比渐近值高 20%；（4）鲁棒性：R_be(N_t) 跨 N_t 两个数量级变化仅约 19%，极限收敛至约 22.11 轮，证明拐点位置由架构而非联邦规模决定。

Conclusion: 智能合约协调的 FL 市场具有摊销式成本结构——并非因为链上操作绝对廉价，而是因为每轮重复成本比固定部署成本低 1–2 个数量级，因此随联邦运行时间延长而被"稀释"。这一结论为评估去中心化协调架构提供了以生命周期摊销而非单笔交易成本为基础的新视角，论证了在持续运行的联邦下该类市场在经济上是可行的；同时作者也指出结论受限于单模型（MNISTNet/MNIST）、单一匹配制度（k̄=1）等有效性威胁。

Abstract: Blockchain-enabled Federated Learning (FL) marketplaces enable collaborative model training among mutually distrustful participants through smart contracts. Although numerous architectures exist, their economic evaluation is typically limited to isolated blockchain operations rather than the complete marketplace lifecycle. Consequently, it remains unclear whether operational costs depend on operating at scale. This paper presents an experimental study of the operational cost of a DAO-governed marketplace. Our evaluation decomposes the gas consumption of every blockchain operation throughout the contract lifecycle, performs ablation experiments to isolate the impact of on-chain coordination and IPFS storage on federated training, and derives an analytical model describing the amortization of deployment costs. Results show the lifecycle of a single training task consumes approximately 3.8 million gas units per hired trainer. The average cost per training round reaches its amortization knee - defined as twice the asymptotic recurring cost - after approximately 20 communication rounds. Moreover, integrating smart contracts and IPFS preserves model performance, achieving accuracy comparable to conventional FL deployments. These findings demonstrate that smart-contract-coordinated FL marketplaces exhibit an amortizing cost structure not because on-chain operations are inexpensive, but because recurring costs are one to two orders of magnitude smaller than fixed deployment costs, thereby diluting over the federation's lifetime.

</details>


### [187] [Dynamic HBM Repartitioning for Multi-Turn MoE Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13537)
*Jinpyo Kim,Mingi Kwon,Younghoon Min,Jongryool Kim,Jishen Zhao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: VAMP 是一个面向多轮 MoE 推理服务的框架，通过运行时动态重分配专家权重与 KV 缓存之间的 HBM 边界，利用三路代价模型在专家卸载、KV 驱逐和请求抢占之间选择最低代价方案，并借助 CUDA 虚拟内存管理（VMM）按页粒度重映射实现无数据拷贝的重分区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 模型中专家权重占据绝大部分 HBM，而每 token 仅激活稀疏的专家子集；多轮 agentic 工作负载的可复用前缀 KV 缓存持续增长，导致固定 KV 缓存容量耗尽后引发"前缀缓存悬崖"——命中率骤降、TTFT 飙升。静态 HBM 分区无法将专家显存回收用于 KV 缓存。

Method: 1) 三路代价模型：估算专家卸载（重复传输开销）、KV 缓存驱逐（重预填充代价）和请求抢占（调度与重排队代价）的未来惩罚，选择最低代价动作。2) 动态 HBM 重分区：使用 CUDA VMM 按 expert group 页粒度重映射物理 HBM 页面，无需复制驻留数据。3) 批感知专家卸载：每层预取整个卸载区域，与前层计算通过双缓冲重叠传输。实现于 vLLM，约 7100 行代码。

Result: 在 2×H100 PCIe 上服务 Qwen3-Next-80B（80B 总参数，每 token 激活 3B），5 次重放 2,103 回合 SWE-agent 轨迹：VAMP-15 将 TTFT p90 从 26.1s 降至 1.10s（23.6×），请求吞吐量提升 20.7%，前缀缓存命中率从 0.19% 升至 89.8%，抢占率从 562.7/千回合降至 0.18；代价是 TPOT 增加 31.1%。在 4×H200 NVLink 上于 c=32 并发时，TTFT p99 降低 10.2×。不同卸载比例存在权衡：VAMP-15 在 TTFT 与 TPOT 间取得最佳平衡，VAMP-20 在低并发时因过卸载反而表现更差。

Conclusion: VAMP 通过动态 HBM 重分区成功推迟了多轮 MoE 服务中的"前缀缓存悬崖"，显著降低 TTFT 与抢占率。专家卸载比例应根据工作负载匹配而非最大化。局限性：当前控制器在内存压力缓解后不恢复专家驻留；未与 host 端 KV 缓存卸载结合。

Abstract: Long-running multi-turn requests accumulate reusable key-value (KV) state. Once this state exceeds a fixed GPU KV-cache allocation, serving systems evict reusable prefixes, repeat prefill work, and may preempt requests. This pressure is particularly acute for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: their expert weights occupy most GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM), even though each token activates only a sparse subset of experts. A static boundary between weights and the KV cache prevents serving systems from using expert memory to preserve reusable state as conversations grow. We present VAMP, an MoE serving framework that changes this HBM boundary at runtime. When a KV allocation cannot be satisfied, VAMP compares the estimated future work of three alternatives: staging expert weights from host memory, evicting cached prefixes that may require re-prefill, or preempting and rescheduling requests. It then converts a bounded expert-weight region into KV-cache capacity when that action has the lowest estimated penalty. CUDA Virtual Memory Management page remapping performs this conversion without copying resident KV data. We implement VAMP in the vLLM serving engine and evaluate Qwen3-Next-80B on recorded and controlled multi-turn workloads. Across five replays of a recorded 2,103-turn SWE-bench agent workload, VAMP with a 15% maximum expert-offloading ratio reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) p90 from 26.1 s to 1.10 s (23.6 times) and increases request throughput by 20.7% relative to unmodified vLLM, while increasing time per output token (TPOT) by 31.1%.

</details>


### [188] [PEAT: Pseudo-Error Assessment for GPU Kernel Validation in DNN Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13544)
*Xuan Truong Nguyen,Hong Quan Tran,Tuan Duc Chu,Thanh Tuan Dao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PEAT是一个轻量级GPU内核验证框架，针对DNN训练中的伪误差评估。它通过Playback FI和Frequency-based Runtime FI两种故障注入技术收集误差特征，并利用Analyzer和Detector对误差进行表征与分类。该框架在NVIDIA V100和AMD MI250上对多种CNN和Transformer模型（涵盖预训练和微调场景）进行了验证，揭示了收敛模式、重复块模式、前向/反向误差差异等规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN训练系统快速发展，新内核开发与移植频繁。然而，内核验证面临巨大挑战：单元测试中微小误差（10⁻⁴~10⁻²量级）的阈值难以确定；现有故障注入方法成本极高（如FIdelity需>290万次实验、>49万节点小时）；GPU代码验证工具主要关注并发bug，无法揭示DNN训练中的静默误差；DNN对精度具有一定容忍度且各层误差范围差异大，单一阈值无法适用。核心问题：如何在DNN训练流中高效地表征新内核实现的正确性。

Method: PEAT框架包含三个核心组件：1) **Profiler**：包含两种FI方案——Playback FI（记录阶段采集权重/激活/梯度等训练上下文数据，回放阶段对预录数据注入故障并对比golden结果生成误差曲线）和Frequency-based Runtime FI（在训练过程中按频率持续注入故障以观察渐进式退化）；使用FP64/FP16/RV/RZ四种误差模型。2) **Analyzer**：通过(mean, std)对在三个层级（单操作、不同操作、重复块组）进行误差范围表征，并利用Spearman等级相关分析误差与权重/激活均值方差的关联。3) **Detector**：基于预定义阈值[xmin,xmax]和[rmin,rmax]以及Spearman分数，提供充分条件将误差模式与已知错误模型关联。关键概念包括Fault Injecting Point (FIP) 和 Fault Observing Point (FOP)。

Result: 在8个CNN模型（ResNet系列、MobileNet、EfficientNet-B0）和5个Transformer模型（T5-small/large/3B、Phi-1.5、Llama3.2-1B）上，针对预训练和微调场景在NVIDIA V100和AMD MI250两种GPU上验证。主要发现：1) **收敛模式**：FP16误差范围小且变化稳定，RV/RZ误差变化显著；2) **归一化后FP16误差比FP64大10³-10⁴倍；3) **规范化层敏感性**：BN/LN层对RZ误差最敏感；4) **重复块模式**：ResNet中相同输入输出形状的块呈现相似误差模式，T5编码器块每6层重复；5) **前向vs反向**：前向注入误差远大于反向注入（因梯度范围显著小于权重/激活）；6) **强相关性**：精度误差与权重/激活方差呈高Spearman相关（0.7-1.0）；7) **跨GPU一致性**：NVIDIA和AMD GPU上误差模式相似，证明方法无硬件依赖性；8) **阈值分类**：Conv/FC层FP16误差变化小而RV/RZ变化大；BN/LN层可设th1=1.0、th2=10.0区分RZ与RV/FP16误差；9) **实际影响**：10⁻³量级的微小误差即可导致训练精度明显下降。

Conclusion: PEAT是一种基于两种简洁有效的故障注入技术（Playback FI和Frequency-based Runtime FI）的内核表征框架，作为DNN框架开发过程中特征化与检测微小误差的低成本工具。PEAT为框架开发者提供有价值的洞察，通过识别特定DNN设备代码中潜在隐蔽误差的发生来简化设备代码验证。PEAT不依赖硬件或平台特定假设，能够在不同开发环境中表现良好，展现了广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely adopted in various fields, driving an emerging trend in developing software stacks associated with DNN training systems. For example, many codes have been ported across different frameworks or developed to leverage the computing power of GPUs or domain-specific accelerators. However, validating a kernel implementation in DNN training is time-consuming and generally requires massive storage. Specifically, this poses a fundamental question: how to characterize the behavior of a new implementation when it is integrated into a DNN training flow. Unfortunately, this problem is not well investigated in the literature, to the best of our knowledge. To address this shortcoming, we present PEAT - a lightweight inspection framework for \underline{P}seudo-\underline{E}rror \underline{A}ssessment associated with GPU kernel validation in DNN \underline{T}raining. Firstly, inspired by conventional fault injection (FI), PEAT's Profiler invokes an operation-wise kernel in a training flow to collect a DNN model's states (e.g., checkpoints and activations). More importantly, the Profiler introduces two simple yet effective techniques, playback FI and frequency-based runtime FI, leveraging persistent kernel calling during the training process. Secondly, PEAT's Analyzer characterizes profiled errors, revealing some signatures from the error distribution of a kernel compared to the golden one. Lastly, PEAT's Detector provides some guidelines as a sufficient condition, which enables associating several well-known error models with signature patterns. We demonstrate the applicability of our approach by presenting the results and analysis using GPUs from the two most popular vendors, NVIDIA V100 and AMD MI250, on various AI models, from vision tasks to language models, for both pretraining and finetuning scenarios.

</details>


### [189] [The Essence of Git: Concepts for P2P Replication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13555)
*Erick Lavoie*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文以Daniel Jackson的"概念设计"方法为框架，重新审视Git的对象模型与复制协议，证明Git远不止是一个去中心化版本控制系统，而是逼近P2P复制本质的通用框架。作者综述了大量基于Git构建的应用（账本、日志、博弈、知识管理、文本编辑、审阅、访问控制、大数据集、安全等），揭示Git提交历史与分布式算法理论（CRDT、hash chain/blocklace、状态机复制）之间的深层联系，并与Secure-Scuttlebutt、Nostr、P2Panda、Willow等其他P2P模型对比，讨论Git模型是否趋近"通用"以及构建真正通用的P2P对象模型所需的最小扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Git虽以版本控制闻名，但其对象模型和增量复制协议已被广泛复用于远超源码管理的应用场景；同时，分布式系统理论中关于强最终一致性和拜占庭容错的抽象（hash chain、blocklace、hash chronicle等）本质上是对Git提交历史的抽象。作者希望从P2P应用开发者视角，借助Jackson的概念设计方法，给出Git核心概念的更一般化的定义、用途和操作原则，并探讨Git模型是否已逼近P2P复制的本质，为寻找通用P2P对象模型奠定基础。

Method: 采用Jackson的"概念设计"方法：(1) 对关键概念(path/tree/blob/commit/reference/repository等)给出抽象级定义；(2) 识别每个概念的用途；(3) 通过操作原则说明用户交互。论文分为：背景（第2节，原始Git对象模型）、综述（第3节，文献与开源项目中的应用）、理论联系（第4节，与CRDT、hash chain、blocklace等的关系）、重定义（第5节，对核心概念给出超越版本控制的一般化定义）、对比（第6节，与其他P2P模型比较）、结论与开放问题（第7节）。

Result: 1. 综述了十余类基于Git构建的应用，包括GOC-Ledger/DOLE v2（基于CRDT的账本）、2P-BFT-Log（BFT追加日志）、Gachix（Nix包缓存）、Catan/Monopoly博弈、Quit Store（RDF知识管理）、Pinnacle（协同文本编辑）、Git-reviewed（去中心化代码审阅）、Walser（基于信任图的访问控制）、XetHub（大数据集Merkle树）、Secure Git（加密Git）、Gitless/Jujutsu（替代前端）、Git notes/git-meta（元数据）、Radicle（P2P代码协作）、Git-annex（外部blob管理）等。2. 揭示Git不可变对象存储本质上是grow-only set CRDT，引用存储支持更复杂的合并；展示消息→commit、点对点交付→复制、happened-before→父子关系这一映射足以实现共识、复制寄存器、视图变更等所有现代分布式抽象。3. 提出Git核心概念的一般化定义，使其适用于任意分布式应用而非仅限于版本控制。4. 与SSB、Nostr、P2Panda（基于追加日志、无对象模型）和Willow（更接近Git的状态对象模型、基于时间戳的覆盖语义）对比，指出Git模型已较高层次但尚非完全通用，Willow的模型理论上可在Git上模拟。5. 提出开放问题：现有P2P项目在表达力与效率上是否等价于Git？是否存在类似ZF集合论的通用对象模型基础？构建BFT P2P应用所需的Git最小扩展是什么？

Conclusion: Git的对象模型与增量复制协议可被视为P2P复用的通用基础，已逼近分布式算法（共识、BFT日志）和收敛复制数据结构（CRDT）的本质。论文从P2P应用开发者视角给出了核心概念的一般化定义，并指出Git模型在表达能力上高于多数现有P2P框架但尚未完全通用（如Willow的时间戳覆盖语义需要扩展）。开放问题包括：是否存在等价或更优的通用对象模型、Git是否足以支撑BFT P2P应用、使其成为通用的最小扩展。强调"将同步对象与时机的选择权留给终端用户"的设计目标有助于构建更具韧性的计算基础设施，并在用户与平台/服务运营方利益之间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: Git is most commonly known as a decentralized version control system. Underneath the surface, the design of Git exhibits an elegant object model and incremental replication protocols that have been used to build a variety of applications that go much beyond version control. In this paper, we survey those applications and show how application concepts have been mapped to Git concepts to show the latter's generality. We also show the connection between the Git commit history and the theory of distributed algorithms and convergent replicated data structures, suggesting that it approaches their essence. We finally compare to current peer-to-peer frameworks to establish the level of abstraction of the Git object model and peek at its potential universality. Throughout, we frame our discussion using the \textit{conceptual design} approach proposed by Daniel Jackson.

</details>


### [190] [Object Model Analysis of a Supercomputer with Digital Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13571)
*Shilpika Shilpika,George K. Thiruvathukal,Venkatram Vishwanath,Michael E. Papka*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 DAT，一个基于 Unreal Engine 构建的交互式三维数字分析孪生，用于可视化超级计算机。它通过参数化描述自动生成可导航场景，统一了空间视图、逻辑角色和动态遥测三大视图，并新增了"点击选取"与"命令 shell"双路径选择机制以及一个面向相机的 in-world LCD 面板来实时展示节点指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超算运维人员和开发者需要将超级计算机的物理布局（机柜/刀片）、逻辑角色（计算/存储/网关等）以及实时遥测流三类信息整合理解，但传统仪表盘将动态视图与空间视图割裂，楼层图又缺乏动态性，导致难以将指标异常回溯到具体硬件组件及其邻居。游戏引擎具备实时渲染与空间导航能力，但其挑战在于如何在不淹没场景的前提下把密集的 per-node 信息在原位呈现。

Method: 方法核心是一个"数据—扩展—呈现"三层解耦的架构：
1) 元数据驱动的 Digital Twin Prototype (DTP)：用递归的 parent-id 表示 rack→chassis→blade→node 的物理包含层次，role 与 health 解耦正交编码，并附带设备能力摘要与类型化链路；
2) 通过 ClusterBuilder/SimDirector/LCD Panel/Network Visualizer 等 Actor 将 DTP 展开为 Digital Twin Instance (DTI)，按机柜行列布局渲染，节点颜色编码角色与健康状态；
3) 事件驱动 SimDirector 维护虚拟时钟与事件表，驱动 job 与硬件活动动画，节点在有 job 时"呼吸"并按 job 颜色发光；
4) 新增双路径选择机制：3D 屏幕中心射线点击（直接路径）与命令行 shell 的 select（符号路径），汇聚到同一个 selected-state；选择后弹出一个 billboard 朝向相机、可复用的 in-world LCD 面板（半透明 quad + 文本），按固定亚秒级节奏刷新；
5) 遥测层当前为合成占位（基于真实 job 负载叠加 per-node 相位振荡的温度/利用率），后续可替换为录制的真实遥测。

Result: 原型已在 Apple Silicon 笔记本上的 Unreal Engine 编辑器与 standalone 配置中构建并启动成功，可从规格文件加载场景、推进模拟、自动捕获帧；通过人工交互验证了双路径选择共用同一状态、面板始终随相机 billboard 且文本随虚拟时钟连续更新、利用率/温度随 job 启停升降、运行 job 计数与节点动画一致；性能开销低（每点击一次射线查询，面板为单个轻量 Actor，每秒数次字符串重建而非逐帧）。目前仍受限于单机评测、未连真实遥测、仅支持单选单面板、未可视化跨机柜网络拓扑、未做正式用户研究。

Conclusion: DAT 通过参数化数字孪生将超算的空间与动态视图桥接起来：用户可直接指向或命名任意节点并就地读取其状态。未来工作方向包括：可视化跨机柜网络拓扑、接入录制的真实时间戳遥测并由虚拟时钟驱动回放、按级别聚合 blades→chassis→racks 健康、多面板同显与 LOD、可扩展性与可用性研究；代码将在发表时开源。

Abstract: Operators and developers need a mental model of both the structure and the live behavior of a large supercomputer, but its physical layout, logical organization, and streams of per-node telemetry are difficult to relate to one another, making it hard to trace a metric or event back to a specific hardware component. We present DAT, an interactive three-dimensional digital analytics twin of a compute cluster built in a real-time game engine, Unreal Engine. DAT expands a compact, parametric description of a supercomputer, a reusable Digital Twin Prototype (DTP), into a navigable Digital Twin Instance (DTI) that mirrors its physical containment hierarchy of racks, chassis, blades, and network links, encoding each node's role and health in its appearance, while a lightweight event-driven simulator animates job and hardware activity over a virtual clock. Our current implementation adds a two-path node-selection mechanism, unifying direct 3D pointing with command-shell queries, that opens an in-world visual-analytics panel beside any selected component showing summary statistics and live, time-varying metrics. We describe this architecture, report qualitative behavior from the working prototype, and outline the path toward driving the panels with recorded telemetry and in-situ anomaly detection.

</details>


### [191] [BOOST: Concurrent Access to Host Memory and HBM to Accelerate LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13592)
*Anish Saxena,Jae Hyung Ju,Hritvik Taneja,Po-An Tsai,Aamer Jaleel,Christos Kozyrakis,Moinuddin Qureshi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: BOOST是首个在无需修改GPU内核的前提下，使LLM推理同时并发、按带宽比例访问HBM与主机内存的运行时系统。它通过基于模运算的页面放置（MPP）和感知wave的KV池管理（DSR），在每个GPU wave内实现并发且比例匹配的内存访问，从而同时获得两层的合并带宽和扩展容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理的解码阶段受限于GPU内存带宽与容量。虽然现代GPU通过C2G互连拥有带宽约为HBM 10%的主机内存，但现有服务系统要么完全不使用主机内存，要么将其视为HBM的辅助层级，通过预取方式将数据迁移到HBM后再服务。这导致主机内存带宽被浪费，且预取消耗HBM写带宽，反而降低有效需求带宽。要充分利用两层级带宽，访问必须同时满足并发性（每个wave内同时访问两层）和比例性（按带宽比例分配访问）。现有的带宽比例页面放置策略（如BAPP-R）在4KB页时代可隐式实现并发，但现代GPU使用2MB大页，每个wave仅涉及数十个页面，随机放置在wave级别产生巨大比例方差，导致性能反而下降。

Method: BOOST由两个组件构成：(1) 页面分配管理器（PAM），对静态模型权重采用模运算页面放置（MPP），将连续K个superpage分配给HBM、第K+1个分配给主机层，确保每个wave内访问比例严格匹配带宽比；对CTA足迹与页边界不对齐的内核，使用superpage粒度（LCM of CTA footprint与页大小）确保每个CTA仅访问一个层级。(2) 数据形状重映射器（DSR），针对注意力内核中动态分配的KV缓存，将KV按head分块（KV head chunk）映射，并在运行时通过贪心策略维护single-head-host与all-local两类block的比例，使active KV head chunks中访问主机层的比例始终接近目标α。BOOST在vLLM中实现（约800行代码），仅修改权重加载器和KV池管理器，通过mmap/mbind分配页面，无需任何GPU端内核改动或运行时数据迁移。

Result: 在Grace Hopper系统上（α=10%），BOOST将TPOT在同batch大小下平均提升4.3%（而预取方案反而劣化6%）；在高吞吐服务中吞吐量平均提升31%（比预取高15%）。PAM单独贡献约23%加速，DSR再贡献额外约7%。在容量匹配对比中，4%的TPOT/吞吐增益纯粹来自并发访问，而非仅来自容量扩展。BAPP-R策略因wave级比例方差反而造成0.4%-2.7%的TPOT退化。在更高α（12%）的H100模拟平台上，BOOST达到9.6%的加速。在面向GB200的分析模型预测中，BOOST增益随α增大而提升，最高可超过预取60%。

Conclusion: BOOST证明了通过wave感知的页面放置和运行时数据管理，可以在不修改任何GPU内核的前提下实现并发且比例匹配的HBM+主机内存访问，从而同时提取两层级的合并带宽并扩展可用容量。这一方法在带宽受限的在线LLM解码场景中优于传统的预取式层级方案，且对未来具有更高α的近内存/分离内存系统（如Vera、NVLink-connected）同样适用，为充分释放异构GPU内存系统潜力提供了实用路径。

Abstract: GPU memory bandwidth and capacity limit throughput in large language model (LLM) inference. The GPU memory system consists of a primary tier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and a secondary tier of host memory connected via CPU-to-GPU interconnect. Current serving systems treat the tiers hierarchically: they serve exclusively from HBM when data fits, and otherwise prefetch data from host memory to HBM before use. In both cases, the host memory bandwidth is never well utilized. Prefetching expands capacity by utilizing host memory, but consumes HBM bandwidth for writes, reducing the bandwidth available for demand loads. We observe that fully utilizing both host and HBM bandwidth requires each wave of GPU threadblocks to access both tiers concurrently and in proportion to their bandwidth ratio. Existing bandwidth-proportional placement strategies fail to provide concurrency because they are not aware of GPU waves, and the large 2MB GPU page size. This paper presents BOOST, the first runtime system that provides concurrent and proportional access to both GPU memory tiers, extracting the combined bandwidth of host memory and HBM for LLM inference without kernel changes. The key insight in BOOST is to use kernel access patterns to make page allocation and runtime data management wave-aware. For static model weights, BOOST applies modulo-based page placement that eliminates access-ratio variance; for dynamically provisioned attention key-value (KV) pairs, it makes the free KV page pool wave-aware. We integrate BOOST into vLLM and evaluate on a Grace Hopper system. At iso-batch size, BOOST improves Time-per-Output-Token (TPOT) by 4.3% over HBM-only serving, whereas prefetching degrades TPOT by 6%. In high-throughput serving, BOOST improves throughput by 31% on average, outperforming prefetching by 15%.

</details>


### [192] [Real-World Deployment and Performance Characterisation of Fog-Based Deep Learning for Cold-Chain Temperature Prediction over LoRaWAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14036)
*Jeremiah Taguta,Jean Frederic Isingizwe Nturambirwe,Clement Nthambazale Nyirenda*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次在实际冷库环境中部署了基于雾计算的LSTM-GRU深度学习模型，通过LoRaWAN传感器数据预测苹果冷藏室温度，并在Raspberry Pi 4上实现了条件SHAP可解释性。系统以0.2°C的MAE、约0.7 Wh/次预测的能耗和555 ms的延迟运行，证明了在资源受限边缘硬件上进行可解释温度预测的可行性，同时揭示了传感器触发的单点故障等真实部署问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球约三分之一的食物在供应链中被浪费，其中新鲜水果蔬菜（FFV）占近一半。冷链中断是主要原因之一。现有研究多采用云端机器学习推理，面临延迟高、数据丢失等问题，尤其是在低连接环境中。雾计算虽具优势，但在FFV冷链温度预测领域此前仅在仿真中验证，缺乏真实部署的性能基准数据。

Method: 采用堆叠式LSTM-GRU架构（LSTM(64)-Dropout-BatchNorm-GRU(50)-BatchNorm-Dense(1)），部署于Raspberry Pi 4雾节点。通过LoRaWAN（EU868）连接Kerlink网关和两个传感器（Synetica enLink ZonePlus环境传感器和Netvox R718E振动传感器）。事件驱动的传感器融合机制集成异步到达的传感器数据。使用SHAP GradientExplainer进行条件可解释性分析，仅在预测到温度中断时触发。模型离线训练后加载，在线推理。

Result: 温度预测精度：MAE = 0.1972°C（95% CI [0.1834, 0.2146]），MSE = 0.3826，R² = 0.7683；能耗约0.2 kWh/天（≈0.7 Wh/次预测），平均功耗8W；总延迟约555 ms（网络/消息占主导，推理约228 ms，SHAP额外约195 ms）；CPU平均1.95%（SHAP触发时升至2.42%，增加28%）；RAM约727 MiB（<20%）。24天运行中经历5次故障，系统可用性86.31%。SHAP分析显示温度、湿度及其交互作用是主要预测驱动因素。

Conclusion: 研究证明了在资源受限的边缘硬件上进行可解释FFV冷链温度预测的可行性，单个雾节点可实现近实时、自主、低成本的预测。真实部署揭示了仿真无法发现的问题：基础设施故障后自主恢复、断网期间持续运行、以及由传感器触发设计导致的单点故障。系统存在轻微正偏差（0.13°C），偏向高估温度，属于安全方向的偏差。未来工作将重新设计推理触发机制以实现优雅降级，并扩展到商业冷链环境。

Abstract: Fresh fruits and vegetables (FFVs) are highly perishable, and cold-chain breaks contribute significantly to global food waste. While Machine Learning (ML) can enable proactive intervention, cloud-based inference faces challenges such as latency and data loss. Fog computing addresses these issues but has been tested only in simulation for FFV cold-chain temperature prediction. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this paper presents its first real-world deployment. A fog-deployed LSTM-GRU model predicted cold-room temperature using LoRaWAN sensor data collected from a South African apple cold-storage facility with induced cold-chain breaks. Running entirely on a Raspberry Pi 4 with no cloud dependency, the system generated conditional SHAP explanations only when a break is predicted. The deployed system predicts cold-room temperature with an MAE of 0.2°C at roughly 0.2 kWh per day (0.7 Wh per prediction). Predictions were delivered in under one second (555 ms), dominated by network and messaging rather than computation, with conditional explanations adding modest cost. SHAP consumes 28% more CPU but is well within the hardware's capacity. The model attributes its predictions primarily to temperature, humidity, and their interaction. Critically, the deployment surfaced what simulation cannot: a sensor-triggered single point of failure, alongside genuine resilience, autonomous recovery from infrastructure faults and continued operation through internet loss. These are the first published deployment benchmarks for fog-based temperature prediction in FFV cold chains, establishing that explainable temperature forecasting is feasible on resource-constrained edge hardware. Future work includes asynchronous sensor fusion, commercial cold chain deployment, alternative model architectures, and causal analysis.

</details>


### [193] [Reducing Cold-Start Latency in Serverless Applications via Dynamic Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14040)
*Georgios Alexopoulos,Konstantinos Karakatsanis,Nikolaos Alexopoulos,Dimitris Mitropoulos,Thodoris Sotiropoulos*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出PyXtrim系统，将Python无服务器应用的冷启动去膨胀问题建模为动态切片问题，通过跨语言动态依赖引擎跟踪Python字节码和原生扩展间的数据/控制依赖，以应用的外部可见行为作为切片标准，在AWS Lambda上31个应用中实现冷启动延迟中位数降低21.7%、峰值内存降低17.1%，效果为现有最优工具λ-trim的两倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无服务器计算中冷启动延迟是关键挑战，其中初始化阶段（占计费时长53.8%）的大部分代码从未影响handler行为（30%-66%是冗余的）。现有方法如λ-trim（仅处理单模块）、FaaSLight（错误假设需要编译）、SlimStart（延迟副作用）均存在局限，Python的动态特性和原生扩展依赖使传统静态去膨胀方法难以处理。

Method: 将去膨胀建模为动态切片问题：(1)切片标准设为产生外部可见效果的操作（sinks），通过拦截libc调用识别；(2)构建动态依赖图（DDG），通过shadow interpreter（基于sys.monitoring）跟踪Python字节码的标签传播记录数据/控制依赖，仅IMPORT_NAME和MAKE_FUNCTION引入标签；(3)C-API拦截器通过GOT重写捕获原生扩展对Python对象的访问，并将其转化为依赖边；(4)trimmer离线计算fslice(S)\bslice(T)删除未影响sinks的import和函数定义语句，并实现import collapsing优化处理冗余导入链。

Result: 在AWS Lambda的31个真实应用上评估：PyXtrim成功处理全部31个应用（λ-trim 28个、FaaSLight 10个、SlimStart 7个）；冷启动延迟中位数降低21.7%（λ-trim仅8.5%），峰值内存降低17.1%（λ-trim仅5.4%）；去膨胀时间中位数5分钟（λ-trim为62分钟）；从未使任何应用变慢；消融实验证明sink detector使效果翻倍，C-API拦截器保证安全性（缺失时19/31应用失败）；在本地环境下复现了类似结果（中位数24.7%）。

Conclusion: 动态切片是优化无服务器程序的有效基础，PyXtrim通过跨Python和原生代码的依赖跟踪，能有效处理真实应用中反射、原生扩展和系统资源交互等复杂场景；该依赖分析方法不局限于去膨胀，还可用于源代码-汇点漏洞检测等其他用途。

Abstract: We present PyXtrim, a system that reduces the cold-start latency of serverless applications through debloating. We focus on Python, a dominant language for serverless applications whose dynamic features and extensive use of native extensions make traditional static debloating particularly challenging. PyXtrim frames debloating as a dynamic slicing problem, using the application's externally visible behavior as the slicing criterion. Everything outside the resulting slice is removed, both from the application and its dependencies. Our key technical contribution is that the slice is computed by a cross-language dynamic dependence engine that tracks data and control dependences across Python and native code and identifies operations that interact with the operating system, which form the slicing criterion. As a result, PyXtrim can effectively handle real-world applications that rely on dynamic features such as reflection, interoperate with native code and interact with system resources. Across 31 applications on AWS Lambda, PyXtrim reduces cold-start latency by 21.7% and peak memory usage by 17.1% at the median. This is more than double the reduction achieved by the state of the art, while debloating each application in minutes.

</details>


### [194] [DQN-Scheduler: A Multi-Objective Optimization Framework for Scheduling Microservices in Cloud Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14117)
*Abdullah Alelyani,Amitava Data,Ghulam Mubasher*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了DQN-Scheduler，一种基于Double Deep Q-Network的强化学习框架，用于云环境中微服务的调度。该框架首次同时优化多个相互冲突的目标：资源利用率、负载均衡、延迟、可靠性和可用性。通过结合贝叶斯推理进行动作选择和Pareto Front方法构建奖励模型，在阿里云真实数据集上的实验表明，DQN-Scheduler在多个指标上优于遗传算法(GA)、粒子群优化(PSO)和最佳适配算法(BFA)等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云环境中微服务调度面临资源利用率、负载均衡、网络延迟、可靠性和可用性等多个相互冲突目标的优化挑战。现有研究通常只关注单一或双目标，忽视目标间的冲突性、云环境的动态性和随机性，且大多基于科学工作流基准而非真实云环境数据集，无法反映真实场景。

Method: 1. **系统建模**：构建包含云平台、微服务、多目标优化、负载均衡、QoS、可靠性、延迟等多种数学模型。2. **Double Deep Q-Network Agent**：采用Q-network和Q-target双网络架构，结合经验回放和ε-greedy策略；状态包含CPU/内存的最大、平均和最小需求；动作空间为各PM承载微服务的概率向量。3. **基于Pareto Front的奖励模型**：使用NSGA-III算法处理多目标冲突，通过计算当前状态与Pareto前沿点的欧氏距离作为奖励。4. **贝叶斯推理动作选择机制**：利用后验概率方法根据实时环境状态调整PM承载微服务的概率分布。5. **框架组件**：包括Agent、SLA监控、资源利用率监控、网络流量监控和集群管理组件。6. **实验评估**：基于阿里云真实数据集(超过90,000容器、1,300+ PMs和3,280微服务)进行模拟仿真。

Result: 实验结果(表3和图2-6)显示：1. **资源利用率**：DQN-Scheduler的CPU利用率均值1.3043、SD为0.7499，内存利用率均值8.57927、SD为3.3464，整体性能均衡稳定。2. **QoS/SLA违规**：DQN-Scheduler在整个月长实验中无SLA违规，而GA有0.000093次违规。3. **可靠性**：DQN-Scheduler的熵SD最高(1.1033)，均值较低(0.4547)，表明微服务在各PM间分布的变异性最强，单点故障风险最低。4. **延迟**：DQN-Scheduler延迟均值4.8555ms、SD为12.7412，仅次于PSO但优于GA和BFA，在可靠性和延迟间取得最佳平衡。综合来看，DQN-Scheduler是唯一在所有指标上均表现优异的方法，成功平衡了多个冲突目标。

Conclusion: DQN-Scheduler是首个同时优化资源利用率、负载均衡、延迟、可靠性和可用性等多个冲突目标的微服务调度框架。通过将Double DQN与Pareto Front奖励模型和贝叶斯推理动作选择相结合，框架能够适应云环境的动态性和随机性。实验证明其在真实数据集上全面优于GA、PSO和BFA基线算法。未来工作可聚焦于微服务自动扩缩容与系统复杂度管理。

Abstract: Cloud computing has emerged as an information technology solution, providing software and infrastructure solutions for companies and individuals. The pay-as-you-go approach has increased demands for the cloud. The massive range of resources, the variety of services, and flexible pricing grab attention. In addition, microservices have emerged as a new way of building software, with applications developed as loosely dependent tasks. Additionally, container technology has boosted the popularity of microservices by offering a platform for this type of architecture. Containers and microservices improve the flexibility and scalability of cloud applications. There are two primary types of microservices: batch and online services, with the majority of applications falling into the online service category. Scheduling microservices is challenging because it requires careful management of resource utilization, load balancing, network latency, reliability, and availability. In this study, we introduce the DQN-Scheduler, a novel reinforcement learning-based agent designed to optimize microservice scheduling in cloud environments. Our approach aims to optimize multiple scheduling objectives simultaneously, such as resource utilization, load balancing, latency, reliability, and availability. To our knowledge, this is the first framework to address all these objectives simultaneously. The DQN-Scheduler was tested against benchmark algorithms in the field. The experimental results demonstrate that the DQN-Scheduler outperforms benchmark algorithms.

</details>


### [195] [Partition-Aware Scheduling for Mobile Heterogeneous Inference Co-Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14213)
*Zhuojin Li,Marco Paolieri,Leana Golubchik*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对移动端异构推理（CPU 集群 + GPU）提出分区感知的 DAG 调度方法，联合优化算子内分区（intra-operator parallelism）与算子间调度（inter-operator parallelism），通过在线迭代搜索框架在部署时实现接近离线最优解的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动推理优化方法要么仅利用算子间并行（将整个算子分配到某个设备，如 HEFT），要么仅利用算子内并行（对每个算子进行 CPU-GPU 协同执行分区）。两者各有局限：纯调度方法在链状主导（如 ResNet16）的 DAG 上因缺乏就绪算子而无法利用空闲设备；纯分区方法在分支密集（如 HRNet）的 DAG 上可能因占用所有设备执行单个算子而延误其他就绪算子。因此需要联合决策算子分区与调度。

Method: 1) 问题形式化：将推理建模为静态算子 DAG，分区决策包括分区策略（输出通道/输入通道/空间/不分区）与工作量划分，调度决策包括设备分配与执行顺序，目标为最小化端到端 makespan。使用全屏障依赖模型，K_i = |D|。2) 在线迭代搜索框架：(a) 分阶段（Staging）——利用网络块结构或按 HEFT rank 引导的探索将大 DAG 分解为最多 20 个算子的子阶段；(b) 关键性感知采样（Criticality-aware Sampling）——在调度子任务图上计算 slack，以 slack 加权 + 均匀采样的混合分布（ρ=0.8）选择待更新的算子；(c) 延迟预测（Latency Prediction）——使用离线训练的 GBDT 模型（含 GPU 后端感知特征）在线估计分区执行时间，避免穷尽剖析。3) 基线方法：schedule-only（HEFT 等）、partition-only（OSPD 局部最优）、expanded-DAG（先固定分区后调度）、partition-aware list scheduling、Joint-Gurobi（离线最优参考）。

Result: 在 4 款移动平台（OnePlus 11、Motorola Edge Plus 2022、Pixel 4、Pixel 5）和 18 个推理模型上评估：仿真与实测均显示迭代搜索达到 Joint-Gurobi 1.00×–1.04× 的平均归一化延迟，显著优于纯调度、纯分区及扩展 DAG 等基线。部署期开销平均仅为模型初始化时间的 37.4%，具备在线部署可行性。分阶段机制、分割数=设备数等设计选择通过消融实验验证有效。

Conclusion: 分区与调度在移动异构推理中必须联合优化；本文提出的在线迭代搜索通过分阶段、关键性感知采样与轻量级延迟预测，在部署时间预算内实现了接近离线最优解的调度质量，验证了算子内协同执行与算子间 DAG 调度结合的有效性。未来方向包括扩展至 NPU/DSP、纳入能耗与热行为目标。

Abstract: Modern mobile inference runs on heterogeneous platforms combining mobile GPUs with multiple CPU core clusters. Existing optimizations typically exploit either inter-operator parallelism, by assigning entire operators to CPU cores or to the GPU, or intra-operator parallelism, by partitioning each operator for CPU-GPU co-execution. We consider these two forms of parallelism together, to improve inference latency of tasks that can be represented by a static DAG of operators with predefined input/output tensor shapes (e.g., CNNs or vision transformers). We define the problem of partition-aware DAG scheduling for mobile heterogeneous inference, illustrating that the best strategy depends on the structure of the inference DAG, thus motivating a joint formulation capturing operator partition choices, device assignment, and execution order. We propose an online iterative search framework, which decomposes large DAGs into stages, focuses search on critical operators, and uses latency predictors to estimate partitioned execution without exhaustive profiling. Across representative mobile inference workloads, our approach achieves latency close to an offline solution while keeping scheduling overhead to a fraction of the model initialization cost, allowing platform-specific scheduling at deployment time.

</details>


### [196] [Joint Optimization for Federated Learning and Transmission over Unreliable Wireless Networks with Heterogeneous Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14246)
*Changheng Wang,Xianchao Zhang,Zhiqing Wei,Lingzhu Zhao,Zhongming Yang,Zhiyong Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向不可靠无线网络的联邦学习框架FedRW（联邦随机游走平均），通过联合优化随机游走路径选择与传输参数，在数据异构和无线传输不可靠的双重挑战下提升联邦学习性能。该框架在高数据异构场景下比现有基线方法提升精度2.26%-9%，联合优化后额外获得至少2.78%的精度提升和更快的收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线联邦学习面临两大核心挑战：(1) 数据异构性（Non-IID）导致客户端漂移（client drift），多次本地更新会放大模型发散；(2) 不可靠的无线链路（衰落、干扰、噪声）导致传输错误，使模型更新失效甚至整个随机游走链中断。现有方法要么忽略数据异构性，要么将整个模型作为单包传输而不支持重传，在多跳随机游走结构中性能受限。

Method: 1. **FedRW框架**：采用并行随机游走链替代FedAvg的本地迭代更新，沿D2D链路逐步传递模型并在每跳执行SGD更新，服务器最终聚合并行链结果。
2. **传输模型**：将模型分片为多包并支持ARQ重传（CRC校验），推导包大小ζ、最大重传次数R与时延的闭式关系。
3. **联合优化问题**：以最小化训练损失为目标，联合优化随机游走路径S、包大小n、最大重传次数R，受时延约束。
4. **收敛分析**：在Polyak-Łojasiewicz（PŁ）条件下推导FedRW在不可靠无线网络中的期望收敛上界，显式建立RW路径、传输参数与学习性能的联系。
5. **问题简化**：利用收敛上界将原问题转化为最大化链路可靠性的通用形式。
6. **分布式求解**：
   - 最优包大小：对n采用对数采样，对每个β用命题2确定最优n；
   - 最优重传次数：采用命题3确定最大满足时延约束的R；
   - 路径选择：提出**弹性感知波束搜索+动态剪枝**策略，综合当前链路可靠性和路径可扩展性选择下一跳。

Result: 1. **数据异构处理**：在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100四个基准数据集上，FedRW在混合Non-IID和Dirichlet Non-IID设置下均优于FedAvg、FedProx、FedNova基线，精度提升2.26%-9%，且收敛更稳定。
2. **联合优化效果**：在MNIST上比Greedy-RW提升2.78%（源于动态剪枝波束搜索的前瞻性），比RandParam提升4.67%（源于传输参数优化），接近无差错理想FedRW上界。
3. **鲁棒性**：在不同最大重传次数γ_R、时延约束γ_τ、误码率BER条件下，联合优化方法聚合的RW链数始终最优，性能差距在高BER下尤为显著。
4. **消融验证**：链内完全异构（γ=1）效果最佳，链内同质化（γ=0）导致严重性能退化，证实了链内多样性的必要性；约束(22c)防止少数高可靠性客户端被重复选中。
5. **理论验证**：训练损失经验曲线与理论收敛上界一致，证实PŁ条件在非凸神经网络中的实际适用性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的FedRW框架有效缓解了无线联邦学习中的数据异构性和传输不可靠双重挑战。通过将模型沿随机游走路径分片传输并联合优化路径选择与传输参数，在理论（基于PŁ条件的期望收敛上界）和实验（多数据集、多异构设置、多无线条件）两方面均验证了其优越性。提出的分布式算法复杂度近线性，具备良好的可扩展性。未来工作包括：建立匹配下界（通过率失真理论或对抗构造）、将分析扩展到PŁ条件之外（如构造融合无线条件、异构性与随机游走动力学的Lyapunov函数）。

Abstract: In wireless federated learning (FL), data heterogeneity and multiple local updates induce client drift, degrading model convergence. It is further affected by unreliable wireless links, as transmission errors may invalidate model updates. To address these challenges, we propose a federated random walk averaging (FedRW) framework, which is a variant of federated averaging (FedAvg) that mitigates data heterogeneity by updating models along random walk (RW) paths and aggregating them at the server. Model parameters are transmitted in packets with retransmission support to improve training quality by mitigating wireless errors along RW paths. Meanwhile, wireless transmission delays hinder the exploration of FedRW. To this end, we formulate a joint optimization problem that integrates learning, RW path selection, and transmission parameter tuning, aiming to minimize the training loss under delay constraints. By deriving an upper bound on the expected convergence of FedRW over unreliable wireless networks, we reduce the problem to a general form agnostic to task type and model architecture. A distributed solution is then proposed, in which the server or clients optimize packet size and maximum number of retransmissions locally, and efficiently select reliable and expandable next-hop nodes via a resilience-aware beam search with dynamic pruning. Simulation results show that FedRW achieves 2.26%-9% higher accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines under high data heterogeneity. Furthermore, the jointly optimized FedRW yields at least 2.78% higher accuracy and faster convergence compared to baselines.

</details>


### [197] [Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14306)
*Shrey Pandit,Xuan-Phi Nguyen,Yiran Zhao,Shafiq Joty*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对MoE模型在长上下文或大batch训练中的内存峰值问题，提出了四个"有界流式算子"，分别控制专家分发、词表投影、梯度检查点边界和优化器状态四个不同的内存峰值，使其在启动时即可确定GPU工作集大小。在120B-667B参数的MoE模型上实现了1M上下文训练，是FSDP2基线的8-32倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型在长上下文或大batch训练时，任意一个组件的内存峰值超过设备显存就会失败。现有并行方案对四个组件（专家分发、词表投影、检查点边界、优化器状态）缺乏上界控制，且不同配置下哪个峰值最先超限会变化，仅降低最大峰值只会暴露下一个瓶颈。

Method: 提出四个"有界流式算子"，每个只改变计算和数据移动的顺序与粒度，保持损失和梯度完全精确：(1) PipelinedLLEP - 通过每源token预算c限制每个分块的最大路由数，采用跨步分块成员策略；(2) Ring-DTP - 环形数据-张量并行的词表投影，循环传输激活或权重分片，用在线log-sum-exp折叠logits条带；(3) SCO - 选择性检查点卸载，按主机预算将检查点边界卸载到CPU内存并在反向传播时预取；(4) OffloadStreamAdamW - 将CPU Adam更新流式化，通过bucket流水线将参数在主机和GPU间流转以利用通信-计算重叠。

Result: 在匹配组件测试中：MoE分派峰值降低高达59.3%（不损失吞吐量）；词表投影峰值降低86.6%；卸载优化器步骤提速2.05倍。在120B、241B和667B参数MoE模型上组合使用，可训练1M上下文长度（是调优FSDP2基线的8-32倍），吞吐量高达基线的10.4倍，最大全局batch达12倍。

Conclusion: MoE在长上下文或大batch训练失败有四个相互独立的原因，其相对大小随配置变化，只有当每个原因都有界且都非强制时栈才可用。所提出的四个调度使GPU工作集由启动配置决定，所有项在token上限设定后固定。组合后在120B-667B参数MoE上达到1M token上下文训练，而FSDP2基线在32K-128K即显存耗尽。

Abstract: Training a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model at long context or large batch size fails as soon as any one component's peak allocation exceeds device memory, so the target is every peak at once, not the average footprint. Four are left unbounded by the parallelism plans in common use, and each grows differently: expert dispatch with the routing matrix, the vocabulary projection with tokens times vocabulary, gradient checkpoint boundaries with depth times sequence length, and optimizer state with parameter count. Which one runs out first changes with the model, the context length, and the device count, so lowering the largest only exposes the next. We bound all four with schedules whose GPU working set is fixed at launch: PipelinedLLEP extends least-loaded expert parallelism with a cap on the tokens each source contributes to a dispatch chunk, Ring-DTP circulates activations or weight shards around a ring at the vocabulary projection and folds each block of logits into an online log-sum-exp, Selective checkpoint offload (SCO) keeps the one long-lived tensor of each checkpoint boundary in CPU memory, and OffloadStreamAdamW turns the serial CPU Adam update of optimizer offload into a bucket pipeline. All four change only the order and granularity of computation and data movement, so the loss and gradients stay exact. In matched component tests, they cut the MoE dispatch peak by up to $59.3\%$ without losing throughput, the vocabulary projection peak by $86.6\%$, and the offloaded optimizer step by $2.05\times$ faster. Composed on MoE models from 120B to 667B parameters, they train at 1M context length, $8$--$32\times$ the reach of a tuned FSDP2 baseline, and up to $10.4\times$ its throughput.

</details>


### [198] [Color Complexity of Recolorable Graph Exploration: Upper and Lower Bounds via Block Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14356)
*Shoma Hiraoka,Shunsuke Imori,Shota Takahashi,Yuichi Sudo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究无内部记忆的匿名智能体在无端口图上的探索问题，智能体仅通过可重写的顶点颜色作为外部记忆。作者通过块结构（block structure）刻画了两类图的最优颜色数，并首次给出了无限制重着色下非平凡的颜色数下界。核心结果包括：树和简单环的三色紧界、块为圈或完全二部图的图类的四色紧界（含仙人掌）、块为团或无三角图的图类的五色上界，以及子立方伪树的四色下界（通过SAT证书证明）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在BFUW模型（Böckenhauer-Frei-Unger-Wehner模型）下，智能体无法使用端口号、顶点标识或内部记忆，只能通过顶点颜色进行导航。此前已有六色（一般图）和五色（无三角图、φ-free图）算法，但无限制重着色下的非平凡颜色下界一直未知。该文旨在填补这一空白，确定由块结构定义的图类的精确颜色复杂度。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 设计三种确定性规则函数算法——三色算法𝒜_TC3用于树和简单环、四色算法𝒜_C4用于块为圈或完全二部图的图类、五色算法𝒜_US5基于semi-DFS模拟；(2) 通过对手论证和案例分析证明两色不足以探索P₃；(3) 使用计算机辅助SAT证明：对9个至多5个顶点的子立方伪树族ℋ，将"是否存在三色公共规则"编码为CNF公式B_τ，并附加合并子句、轨迹子句和域子句，通过DRAT反驳验证不可满足性。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 三色是树和简单环类的最优颜色数（Theorem 3 + Lemma 4）；(2) 四色是包含所有子立方伪树且包含于𝒢_CB的图类的最优颜色数（Theorem 6 + Theorem 13），将仙人掌图的上界从五色改进到紧的四色；(3) 五色足以探索块为团或无三角图的图类𝒢_KTF，时间复杂度O(nΔ)（Theorem 11），并扩展到unichord-free图；(4) 结构表征：uniform separation property恰好刻画𝒢_KTF类（Lemma 10）；(5) 一般图的精确颜色复杂度被界定在4到6之间。

Conclusion: 本文通过块结构确定了BFUW模型下多个图类的精确颜色复杂度，确立了无限制重着色下的首个非平凡颜色下界。三色对树/简单环、四色对伪树相关类、五色对𝒢_KTF类均为最优。证明结合了对手论证、半DFS模拟的归纳分析，以及基于SAT的可验证证书。开放问题包括：能否不使用计算机辅助证明四色下界，以及单个图的四色下界。

Abstract: We study exploration of anonymous, port-free graphs by a single agent with no internal memory. To compensate for the lack of memory, the agent uses writable vertex colors as external memory. From every starting vertex, the agent must visit all vertices, return to its start, and terminate there. Throughout, recoloring is unrestricted, and the color count includes the common initial color. However, to our knowledge, no nontrivial color lower bound was known for unrestricted recoloring. We determine the optimal number of colors on two classes defined by block structure and prove the first nontrivial color lower bounds for unrestricted recoloring. First, a single three-color algorithm explores every tree and every simple cycle in $O(n)$ moves, and no algorithm with at most two colors explores $P_3$, the path on three vertices. Second, we give a four-color algorithm that explores every graph whose blocks are cycles or complete bipartite graphs in $O(n)$ moves, and we prove that no algorithm with at most three colors explores all subcubic pseudotrees. Hence four colors are optimal for every class between subcubic pseudotrees and this block-defined class. On cacti, this improves the previous five-color upper bound to a tight four. The lower bound reduces the possible initial actions by hand and rules out the remaining cases by a machine-checked SAT certificate on nine graphs with at most five vertices. Finally, we extend the known five-color algorithm for triangle-free graphs to graphs whose blocks are cliques or triangle-free, using $O(n\Delta)$ moves, where $\Delta$ is the maximum degree.

</details>


### [199] [Physically Partitioned KVCache Format for CPU--GPU Load Balancing in MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14507)
*Enda Yu,Dezun Dong,Xiangke Liao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出InplaceKVCache格式与WriteScope调度系统，通过在写入时固定KVCache的物理驻留位置（设备亲和性×访问模式），实现MoE模型单GPU长上下文推理中CPU-GPU之间的动态负载均衡，避免传统单状态KVCache抽象带来的钉住/布局矛盾与重组开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单GPU部署MoE模型进行长上下文推理时，KVCache必须溢出到CPU内存，而CPU侧KVCache既可传输到GPU做attention（受PCIe带宽限制），也可在CPU上就地计算（受CPU算力限制），二者最优比例随工作负载动态变化。但现有KVCache抽象仅提供单物理状态的存储语义，且两种用途对钉住状态和布局连续性的要求相反（pin seesaw与strided DMA带宽崩溃），传统方案只能二选一，AF overlap在MoE下又会因专家权重加载争用CPU/PCIe而失效，负载平衡因此成为必需而非优化。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) InplaceKVCache格式——按"设备亲和性×访问模式"两维度划分四个区域（CPU未钉住计算区、CPU钉住加载区、GPU ping-pong计算区、GPU D-window暂存区），每个字节在写入时即确定最终物理驻留，避免后续重组；(2) WriteScope调度——沿序列维度切分CPU/GPU份额，每256个decode条目作为一个驱逐批次，通过D-window分批路由至对应区域；(3) 可移植roofline性能模型——通过公式r(L)=min(1,max(0,B/(A+B)+Δ/((A+B)·L)))确定最优CPU份额，其中B为GPU每token传输成本、A为CPU每token读取成本、Δ为固定开销差，A通过在线滑动平均反馈追踪漂移，partial output通过LSE合并。

Result: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Qwen3-30B-A3B、Mixtral-8×7B三种MoE模型、32GB VRAM预算下，WriteScope支持1M-token聚合规模（bs=32×seq=32K）的端到端推理。在≥8K长上下文场景，相对四个复现baseline取得A100上1.5×–2.5×、V100上1.4×–1.7×的几何均值加速，而vLLM、SGLang、KTransformers即使KV预算翻倍仍普遍失败。DeepSeek-V4-Flash案例验证了与原生稀疏attention的组合能力。消融实验显示DynamicCache替代导致0.26–0.79归一化吞吐，验证四区域格式每一设计点均非冗余。多用户并发场景下自适应策略较固定r减少57%延迟（bs4/8K）。

Conclusion: 本文证明长上下文MoE推理无需多GPU服务器，可成为单GPU机器上的实用配置。核心贡献在于：将物理驻留从运行时机制提升为数据格式属性（write-time principle），消除pin seesaw与stride collapse两个底层障碍；通过四区域正交布局使动态负载平衡成为内建能力；通过roofline模型将负载平衡问题转化为纯调度问题。局限性在于目标场景为单用户独占访问，多用户并发仅为可行性验证；未来工作将联合调度专家预取与attention放置。

Abstract: Single-GPU long-context inference with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models requires spilling the key-value cache (KVCache) to CPU memory. The spilled KV serves two complementary purposes---transferring to the GPU for attention computation, or computing in-place on the CPU---which demand opposing physical states. The optimal split between them varies with workload, yet existing KVCache abstractions offer only storage semantics over a monolithic object of a single physical state, and cannot express dynamic load balancing. We propose InplaceKVCache, the first KVCache abstraction whose format fixes each byte's physical residency at write time, so that the CPU--GPU load balance can be adjusted without moving data after placement. It realizes this as a four-region layout along two dimensions---device affinity and access pattern---turning load balancing into pure scheduling. Built on this abstraction, WriteScope splits CPU--GPU shares along the sequence dimension, and a portable roofline performance model determines the optimal CPU share as sequence length evolves, with online feedback tracking CPU cost drift. On three MoE models (DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Mixtral-8$\times$7B) with a 32~GB VRAM budget, WriteScope supports end-to-end inference at the 1M-token aggregate scale. In the long-context regime ($\ge$8K), it achieves geometric-mean speedups of $1.5\times$--$2.5\times$ on A100 and $1.4\times$--$1.7\times$ on V100 over four reproduced baselines, while vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers fail even with a doubled KV budget. A DeepSeek-V4-Flash case study validates composition with native sparse attention.

</details>


### [200] [PaxosLease Revisited: A Checked Model of Diskless Distributed Leases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14640)
*Márton Trencséni*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对PaxosLease协议(一种无盘分布式租约协议)进行了机器检查的形式化重述、修订与实现审计,纠正了原2012年论文中安全关键规则的不一致表述,发现并修复了多个细微但可导致同时双主的漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PaxosLease作为Multi-Paxos的领导者优化机制,其磁盘无关的设计带来优雅性,但其安全性依赖于对时间间隔、quorum证书与重启隔离的精确推理。原文存在规则表述内部不一致,生产实现(Keyspace、ScalienDB)十余年未经形式化验证,隐藏着在普通故障-调度场景下可被触发的安全漏洞。

Method: 方法学层面:① 用TLA+形式化租约转换系统并由TLC穷举验证;② 用TLAPS机械化证明时钟漂移等算术命题;③ 用Python独立二次编码同一规则作为可执行参照模型;④ 编写单文件可读Python演示程序;⑤ 对实际生产实现做源码级审计并构建"实现投影"规约进行对比验证。每条不可去掉的规则均配有"机械生成的弱化变体+TLC自动找到反例"。

Result: 三项新结果:1. 重启隔离期下界恰为提议者尝试时长 D_P,而非更保守的 max(D_P,D_A),且在两个边界处均经双向机器验证(通过与一单位违反)。2. 计时器位置是安全关键的:若在prepare-quorum到达时才启动计时器(原2012论文伪代码的做法),无论多长隔离期都不够,TLC在27状态找到双主反例(附录给出完整调度)。3. 提议者放弃尝试后重试时,残留accept请求会覆写竞争者的记录,若将"自己拥有"的报告无条件视为开放响应,会直接得到同时双主;修复要求"续约限定词":仅当正在续约且ballot等于捕获的续约基准时才视为开放。审计发现Keyspace与ScalienDB共8处源码缺陷,包括使用了不安全的计时器规则、quorum按消息计数、读取gettimeofday未修正、双次时钟读取导致的uint64下溢race、远程learner的500ms保守性是未经说明的隐含假设等;其中第三与第七项在出厂常量与正常调度延迟下即可触发双主。

Conclusion: PaxosLease需以"尝试时刻存储截止时间"作为安全规则,并配合严格的重启隔离、续约限定词、身份化quorum计数与单调时钟。提出的工程方法论是:形式化+模型检查→实现→将实现再编码为规约并检查;前沿LLM使两轮编码与维护的成本降到常规可承受。本文取代2012年原论文作为PaxosLease的权威规范。主要局限:TLC仅穷举至2提议者/3接受者/3ballot的小配置,安全性论证结合算术引理、有限检查与人写论证,故并非对所有quorum系统规模的完整证明。

Abstract: PaxosLease is a protocol by which a quorum of acceptors grants time-bounded exclusive ownership with no durable acceptor lease state and no disk write on the lease acquisition path. This paper gives a precise, machine-checked statement of the protocol and of its standard use, electing a Multi-Paxos leader that recovers once per epoch and then commits with single-round appends. Three results are new. First, the restart quarantine an acceptor must observe after losing its volatile state is the proposer attempt duration, a bound tight in the checked model and machine-checked at the boundary in both directions. Second, timer placement is safety-critical: starting the attempt timer at prepare-quorum receipt can produce two simultaneous lease owners. Third, when a proposer abandons an acquisition attempt and retries, messages left over from the abandoned attempt can make acceptors report a lease the proposer itself appears to own; unless such a report counts as open only while the proposer is renewing that exact lease, two simultaneous owners follow at any quarantine length. The lease transition system is formalized in TLA+ and checked by TLC, and the timing arithmetic is proved in TLAPS. An executable reference model encodes the same rules a second time, independently of the TLA+, so that a wrong rule has to survive two separate encodings. A single-file runnable demonstration gives the algorithm in readable Python code.

</details>


### [201] [CATS: A Carbon-Aware Task Simulator for Reducing AI Data Center Emissions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14775)
*Dayuan Chen,Ziliang Zong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出CATS（碳感知任务模拟器），用于通过空间与时间调度策略降低AI推理数据中心的运营碳排放。研究整合了全球8大云服务商140个云区域与145个电网区域2022-2024年的五分钟级碳强度数据，并基于实测的6类AI推理任务在4种GPU上的性能数据，在24小时60万任务规模下评估了4种调度策略。结果显示空间调度可减少38.4% CO₂，时间调度可减少16.1%但伴随3.27%的SLA违约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI推动云数据中心快速扩张，2026年电力需求预计翻倍。由于电网碳强度在地域和时间上存在5.5倍以上差异，推理任务的执行位置和时间显著影响运营碳排放。然而当前云数据中心的选址与低碳电网存在错配（50%位于中高碳强度电网），且缺乏综合考虑硬件容量、排队延迟和真实负载特征的碳感知调度模拟器。

Method: 三方面方法：(1) 构建全球选址-电网对齐数据集，整合TeleGeography的347个数据中心元数据与WattTime的145个电网区域五分钟级MOER信号（2022-2024）；(2) 开发CATS离散事件仿真器，包含轨迹生成器、虚拟云基础设施（三级模型：数据中心→GPU池→单设备）、调度引擎、碳核算模块及四种可插拔调度策略（Speed-First和Carbon-First基线、Spatial Shifting和Temporal Shifting碳感知策略），使用min-heap实现最早空闲设备分配，用rate cap、capacity ledger和backlog cap三重防护约束时间调度；(3) 在A100/A6000/H100/GH200上实测6类推理任务（文本生成、TTS、T2I、I2T、I2I、T2V）的运行时与能耗，合成24小时60万任务轨迹，评估4种策略。

Result: 选址分析发现仅21%（29/140）的数据中心位于低碳电网（<900 lbsCO₂/MWh），50%位于≥1200的中高碳强度电网。在四区域260 GPU异构集群、平均利用率0.37的24小时仿真中：Speed-First基线排放251.45 lbs CO₂；Carbon-First降低14.7%至214.57 lbs；Spatial Shifting最优，减少38.4%至154.91 lbs（59.88%任务被跨区域调度），但任务运行时间从8.84s增至136.32s；Temporal Shifting减少16.1%至210.83 lbs（仅调度0.4%任务），但产生3.27%的SLA违约。统一65×A100单GPU对比实验证实空间调度仍有27.5%碳减排。

Conclusion: 碳感知调度可在现有数据中心上实现显著的运营碳减排：空间调度减排最显著（38.4%）但以延迟为代价；时间调度减排有限（16.1%）且引入SLA违约风险，两者调度开销均可忽略（<2.32 ms/任务）。建议未来数据中心优先选址低碳电网，并将碳感知调度作为现有设施的补充减碳手段。未来工作需整合碳强度短期预测、多目标优化（碳/能耗/延迟/成本）以及弹性容量管理。

Abstract: The rapid rise of generative AI is accelerating cloud data center expansion, with electricity demand projected to double by 2026. Because carbon-intensity varies by more than 5.5x across grids and times of day, where and when inference tasks execute significantly affects operational emissions. We address this issue with three aspects in this paper. First, we compile a global alignment dataset unifying 140 operational and planned cloud regions across 8 major providers with five-minute carbon-intensity traces for 145 grid regions from 2022 to 2024, revealing that 50% of current sites lie in medium-to-high carbon-intensity grids, indicating a siting-carbon mismatch and unrealized carbon reduction potential. Second, we develop CATS (Carbon-Aware Task Simulator), a flexible trace-driven framework that profiles six AI inference tasks across multiple GPU types, synthesizes realistic diurnal curve, geographical and task mixes, and SLA constraints, and evaluates spatial and temporal schedulers against two baselines while reporting comprehensive metrics including carbon emissions, energy consumption, runtime, queue delay, and hardware utilization. Third, we quantify achievable CO2 savings under realistic constraints: in a 24-hour trace with 600,000 tasks at fleet utilization of 0.37, spatial shifting reduces CO2 by 38.4% versus speed-first baseline, while temporal shifting yields 16% savings with bounded SLA violations at 3.27%. These results advocate locating future data centers in low carbon-intensity grids and demonstrate that carbon-aware scheduling on today's fleets can achieve substantial operational emissions reduction.

</details>


### [202] [Stability-Aware Proactive Autoscaling Using a Double Deep Q-Network in Cloud Computing Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14894)
*Bablu Kumar,Anshul Verma,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双深度Q网络(DDQN)的主动式自动伸缩方法DDQN+RRS,用于云计算环境中的容器化微服务应用。该方法通过将DDQN的决策智能与资源移除策略(RRS)的执行级控制相结合,在动态工作负载下实现更稳定、更高效的自动伸缩。实验表明,该方法在CPU利用率、SLA违规率、伸缩稳定性和Pod重启次数等指标上均优于反应式和现有主动式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云计算环境中动态工作负载和延迟敏感型应用对自动伸缩提出了更高要求。现有方法主要存在两大问题:(1)基于静态阈值的反应式机制(如Kubernetes HPA)响应滞后,在工作负载不确定时易导致伸缩振荡;(2)预测驱动方法受预测误差影响,缺乏自适应决策机制;(3)传统DQN存在Q值过估计问题,导致伸缩决策不稳定。亟需一种兼顾决策智能与执行稳定的主动式自动伸缩方案。

Method: 方法包含两大核心组件:(1)基于DDQN的决策层——将自动伸缩建模为MDP,状态空间涵盖CPU利用率、响应时间、等待时间、工作负载吞吐、活跃Pod数及其时序变化;动作空间为{-1,0,+1}(缩容/保持/扩容);通过解耦动作选择与价值评估降低Q值过估计;奖励函数综合CPU利用率奖励与SLA违规惩罚。(2)基于RRS的执行层——采用Pods需求管理服务(Algorithm 1)根据预测工作负载和单Pod服务能力估算所需Pod数;采用适应管理器服务(Algorithm 2)以β=0.60的调节因子在60秒控制窗口内渐进式调整Pod数量,公式为N_{t+1}=N_t+β(N_{t+1}^{req}-N_t),避免资源突变。三个算法通过统一闭环工作流(Algorithm 3)整合为完整的主动伸缩框架。

Result: 基于5000条云工作负载记录的仿真实验(7个逻辑节点,每节点2-8个Pod,SLA阈值4000ms)显示:DDQN+RRS实现CPU利用率52.23%(对比反应式49.75%、DQN 47.26%);SLA违规率仅11.81%(对比反应式19.68%、DQN 17.71%);伸缩事件2488次(低于反应式3139次和DQN 3785次);Pod重启1246次(低于Immediate 2894次和Reactive 2016次)。在0-60秒时间窗内,尤其在15-30s、40-45s和55-60s区间表现出最平滑的Pod数量变化。消融实验验证了DDQN(决策智能)与RRS(执行平滑)缺一不可——仅有DDQN无RRS时伸缩事件高达3785次,稳定性反而下降。

Conclusion: DDQN+RRS通过决策级强化学习与执行级资源调节的协同设计,有效平衡了资源效率、服务可靠性和伸缩稳定性,是动态云环境下自动伸缩的有效方案。当前局限在于基于仿真评估,未考虑Pod启动延迟、镜像拉取开销、调度延迟等实际Kubernetes部署因素。未来工作将面向真实Kubernetes部署验证、多资源优化以及多集群云边分布式环境扩展。

Abstract: Dynamic workloads and latency-sensitive applications require efficient autoscaling in cloud computing environments. However, most existing approaches rely on reactive mechanisms based on static thresholds, resulting in delayed responses and scaling oscillations under workload uncertainty. To address these limitations, we propose a double deep Q-Network-based proactive autoscaling approach (DDQN-Proactive) along with Resource Removal Strategy (RRS). The proposed (DDQN+RRS) enhances decision-making by decoupling action selection from value evaluation, enabling more stable and adaptive scaling. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms both reactive and existing proactive approaches. Specifically, DDQN+RRS achieves a lower Service Level Agreement (SLA) violation rate (11.81%), higher CPU utilization (52.23%), improved scaling stability, fewer scaling events (2,488), and reduced pod restarts (1,246). Furthermore, the approach ensures smoother autoscaling behavior by significantly reducing oscillations over time (0-60 s). While reactive methods exhibit substantial fluctuations in pod allocation, Reactive reduces these variations, and DDQN+RRS achieves the most stable and smooth scaling, particularly during the 15-30 s, 40-45 s, and 55-60 s intervals.

</details>


### [203] [Agentic Autoscaling through Worker-Pool Orchestration for LLM-driven Text Classification in Cloud Computing Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14898)
*Bablu Kumar,Anshul Verma,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文针对LLM驱动文本分类中突发性、高延迟工作负载的动态资源供给问题，提出了一种基于应用层信号量的弹性工作者池编排框架，通过优先级队列、指标监控器、自动扩缩容控制器和分类器无关的设计，实现对不同LLM分类器（BART、DeBERTa、RoBERTa、DistilBERT）的透明集成。实验在AG News和SMS Spam Collection数据集上进行，验证了在保持高分类精度的同时，动态扩缩容相比静态分配和独立执行基线显著提升了吞吐量、降低了延迟和资源浪费。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的智能体（agentic）工作负载具有高推理延迟、突发性任务到达和显著计算开销等特征，传统面向基础设施层指标（如CPU/内存）的Web服务自动扩缩容方案对此类工作负载响应不足。同时，模型选型（zero-shot vs. 微调）与基础设施供给常被耦合设计，但实际上二者是独立的设计维度。因此需要一个在应用层实现、分类器无关的弹性资源管理框架。

Method: 1. **五组件架构**：优先级任务队列（基于min-heap，按优先级+序列号排序）、动态异步工作者池（asyncio实现）、指标采集器（维护滑动窗口延迟、队列深度、利用率等）、应用层阈值型自动扩缩容控制器（含Knowledge/Experience Base存储历史状态）、异步编排器。\n2. **两个核心算法**：\n   - **算法1（Agent Worker Loop）**：每个worker以超时出队（try-dequeue, timeout=1s）方式获取任务，try-catch隔离异常以实现故障隔离，调用分类函数后记录延迟并返回结果。\n   - **算法2（Autoscaler Control Loop）**：以Δt为轮询间隔采样（q(t), U(t)），结合冷却期τ防止抖动，按规则调整池规模：扩容条件为 q(t)>θ_q ∨ U(t)>θ_U^+；缩容条件为 q(t)=0 ∧ U(t)<θ_U^-。步长受η和[n_min, n_max]约束。\n3. **形式化系统模型**：两阶段到达过程（burst+steady，β≈0.35–0.40，λ_burst约为λ_steady的4–7倍），工作池容量C(t)=n(t)μ，目标保持λ(t)≈C(t)。\n4. **分类器无关性**：分类函数f被抽象为可调用对象f(x_i)↦(ŷ_i, δ_i)，队列、worker池、指标采集器、扩缩容器均不依赖f的具体实现，支持BART-large-MNLI、DeBERTa-v3-large、RoBERTa-large-MNLI、DistilBERT的即插即用。\n5. **实验环境**：Google Colab（Python 3.12 + asyncio），BART/RoBERTa用CPU，DeBERTa推理与DistilBERT微调用T4 GPU；N=200分层采样，DistilBERT额外用4000条训练样本微调。

Result: **AG News数据集**：\n- Autoscaling+DeBERTa：90.5% 准确率（最高）\n- Autoscaling+BART：84.5% 准确率（vs. Static+BART 75.2%）\n- 延迟：Autoscaling+BART保持5–8s；Static+BART升至~80s\n- 工作者池：4→6（t₅）→8（t₉–t₃₆突发期）→7（衰减期）\n- 队列：静态配置累积至190–225任务未完成；自动扩缩容限制在~110并最终清空\n- 吞吐量：Autoscaling+BART由18升至35 tasks/min\n\n**SMS Spam Collection数据集**：\n- Autoscaling+DeBERTa：99.5% 准确率（最高）\n- Autoscaling+BART：84.5% 准确率，执行时间更低\n- 独立RoBERTa：仅47.5%准确率（spam类召回率仅1%），暴露zero-shot NLI在不平衡二分类上的局限\n\n**资源效率**（六维雷达图：吞吐、延迟、利用率、容错、可扩展性、成本）：\n- AG News上Autoscaling+BART得分(90,85,78,92,95,88)，Autoscaling+DeBERTa(70,65,70,95,90,85)\n- SMS Spam上Autoscaling+BART再次全面领先\n- 静态与独立执行基线在可扩展性和成本效率维度最差

Conclusion: 论文验证了两项关键结论：①worker-pool弹性与LLM分类器选型是相互独立的设计维度，分类器无关的自动扩缩容架构有效；②基于应用层信号（队列深度+worker利用率）的阈值型控制策略在突发性LLM推理工作负载下显著优于固定分配和顺序执行。未来工作将扩展到更大规模多样化工作负载、自动化参数优化、预测式扩缩容（提前预判负载变化）以及云-边分布式异构资源分配（轻量模型在边缘、计算密集型LLM在云端）。

Abstract: The growing adoption of large language model (LLM)-based systems for large-scale text processing has created a critical need for dynamic autoscaling to manage high-latency, bursty, and computationally intensive workloads. This paper proposes an agentic autoscaling framework through worker-pool orchestration for LLM-driven text classification. The framework integrates a priority task queue, a dynamic pool of agent workers, a real-time metrics collector, and an application-layer autoscaler. Its classifier-agnostic design supports both zero-shot and fine-tuned language models without modifying the autoscaling logic. The framework is evaluated using Autoscaling+BART and Autoscaling+DeBERTa against static allocation and standalone RoBERTa and DistilBERT baselines. On the AG News dataset, Autoscaling+BART achieves 84.5% accuracy, while Autoscaling+DeBERTa improves it to 90.5%. On the SMS Spam Collection dataset, Autoscaling+DeBERTa achieves 99.5% accuracy, whereas Autoscaling+BART attains 84.5% accuracy with lower execution time. Overall, the proposed framework consistently outperforms the baseline approaches in resource efficiency while maintaining high classification performance, demonstrating that elastic worker-pool orchestration provides an effective and cost-efficient solution for scalable LLM-driven text classification in cloud environments.

</details>


### [204] [Shared KV Caching for Replicated 27B Inference: Correctness Failures and Performance Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15021)
*Frank Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究两个单GPU 27B vLLM推理副本共享256 GiB LMCache KV缓存池的工程实践，重点关注共享KV缓存的**正确性验证**与**性能边界**。研究发现：(1) 采用packed-page补丁后，隔离出一个原始指针回退路径缺少CUDA流依赖的bug，并通过字节级测试复现和修复；(2) 通过混合分配器提供可用部署路径；(3) 跨副本TTFT在128k输入时从31.715秒降至0.605秒，256k时从92.047秒降至0.790秒；(4) 六轮会话在副本交替路由下改善约35%（32k）和45%（128k），但固定放置收益甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮推理请求中，先前轮次处理的上下文可在新轮次中被复用。同一副本可利用本地前缀状态，但跨副本迁移时需重计算前缀。部署选择包括：通过放置保留请求局部性、提供共享状态复用路径或两者结合。研究动机有两个：(1) 缓存可能在HTTP成功或命中计数正常时返回错误状态，命中不等于完整性检查；(2) 冷热对比可能掩盖本地复用基线。需建立正确性验证后再评估性能，并保留本地命中基线。

Method: 实验配置：两台单GPU NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell服务器版GPU（每卡97,887 MiB），双AMD EPYC 9455 48核CPU，vLLM 0.28.0 + LMCache 0.5.4 + PyTorch 2.13.0+cu129，模型为Qwen3-27B-NVFP4（64层混合架构：48层Gated DeltaNet + 16层全注意力，FP8 KV，HND布局），共享层为256 GiB RAM + 1568-token chunks + LRU。

**正确性验证方法（分层）**：
1. **Packed-page兼容性**：发现逻辑full-attention block由49个32-token packed kernel pages组成，采用上游f180b9ff补丁（需要HND布局）。
2. **流排序故障**：隔离`lmcache_memcpy_async`的原始指针分支调用`cudaMemcpy(..., cudaMemcpyDefault)`但未指定当前CUDA流，在PyTorch非阻塞流下隐式同步失效。
   - 字节级探针：1 MiB device-to-host和host-to-device复制，故意插入延迟，复现依赖缺失；无延迟时通过。
   - 三种控制方法（等待前置流工作、使用`cudaMemcpyAsync`指定当前流、同流张量复制）全部720项通过。
3. **全池pinned分配**：解决256 GiB + 4096字节请求被PyTorch分配器向上舍入到512 GiB的故障，设置`pinned_max_round_threshold_mb:128`。
4. **服务回归测试**：264个非预热请求通过。

**性能评估方法**：四块独立重启的OFF-ON-ON-OFF配置，形成两个ON/OFF块对，共768个测量请求（每块192请求+6预热），所有384个ON/OFF请求阶段对匹配payload SHA-256和目标GPU。指标：客户端测量的TTFT、解码率、会话墙时间。工作负载：8k/32k/128k/256k微基准、六轮交替路由会话、固定与交替放置对比、强制长度生成的并发窗口。

Result: **TTFT结果（跨副本复用 vs 冷启动）**：
| 输入 | OFF冷启动(s) | ON冷启动(s) | OFF本地(s) | ON本地(s) | OFF跨副本(s) | ON跨副本(s) |
|------|------------|------------|---------|---------|-----------|-----------|
| 8k | 1.157 | 1.162 | 0.050 | 0.052 | 1.161 | 0.095 |
| 32k | 5.254 | 5.265 | 0.181 | 0.184 | 5.252 | 0.221 |
| 128k | 31.755 | 31.774 | 0.484 | 0.492 | **31.715** | **0.605** |
| 256k | 92.108 | 92.188 | 0.557 | 0.574 | **92.047** | **0.790** |

**六轮会话结果**：
| 初始上下文 | 放置方式 | OFF中位(s) | ON中位(s) | 变化 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|------|
| 32k | 固定 | 10.706 | 10.742 | +0.36% |
| 32k | 交替 | 16.708 | 10.821 | **-35.26%** |
| 128k | 固定 | 40.465 | 40.605 | +0.34% |
| 128k | 交替 | 73.220 | 40.553 | **-44.61%** |

**关键发现**：
- 冷启动与本地复用条件下ON/OFF差异极小（2-17 ms）。
- 跨副本复用是主要收益来源。
- 固定放置收益甚微（<0.4%）。
- 交替放置在会话层面改善显著。
- 短并发窗口中交替放置吞吐量提升约87%（4会话）和78%（8会话）。
- 64个强制长度生成的ON/OFF对中，所有输出都不同，但冷热输出在每组内匹配，表明文本差异本身不能识别缓存传输故障。

Conclusion: 两个复制式27B推理引擎可在传输路径经验证后有效共享主机内存状态。此部署需要：(1) 现有表示补丁（packed-page），(2) 恢复流排序的分配器选择（混合分配器`--no-l1-use-lazy`），(3) 全容量pinned分配检查。**核心结论**：共享缓存的收益取决于局部性条件——当请求迁移到无前缀的副本时，长上下文TTFT和交替会话时间显著下降；固定放置增益很小。**工程贡献**：提供经验证的配置方案和区分缓存正确性（字节级探针验证传输路径）与局部性依赖性能（放置策略与命中模式影响）的方法论。**局限**：实验仅基于一个模型配置、一台主机、两个块对；主机非独占（另一GPU约24%利用率）；仅测试单字节对象而非所有已注册内核组；未测试饱和、跨主机共享和原生offload。

Abstract: Shared host-memory caching can avoid repeated prefill when a request moves between inference replicas. Its usefulness depends on both correct state transfer and lost prefix locality. We study two single-GPU 27B vLLM replicas sharing a 256 GiB LMCache pool. After adopting an existing packed-page patch, we isolate a raw-pointer fallback that omits the dependency on the current CUDA stream. Controlled byte tests fail under an imposed delay and pass when the dependency is restored; the existing mixed allocator provides a working deployment path. Full-pool allocation checks and service regression complete the validation. A four-block OFF-ON-ON-OFF comparison contains 768 measured requests within two block pairs. Median cross-replica time to first content token falls from 31.715 to 0.605 seconds at 128k input and from 92.047 to 0.790 seconds at 256k.
