Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.

</details>


### [232] [Leakage-Safe and Scheduler-Aware Machine Learning for Grid Job Runtime Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13701)
*Ashfaq Ali Shafin,Khandaker Mamun Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对网格作业CPU突发时间预测任务，重新审视了GWA-T-4 AuverGrid工作负载轨迹上的预测问题，将其重新定义为无信息泄露的预执行作业运行时预测。核心贡献不在于提出新算法，而在于构建了一种严格的部署感知评估范式：通过仅使用提交时可获取的特征、引入时序安全的历史基线、比较类别特征编码策略、对CatBoost进行时序验证调优，并加入极简调度模拟来连接预测质量与调度行为。实验表明随机划分严重高估性能，调优后的CatBoost在时序测试集上R²仅0.239，但预测驱动的SJF仍可在单服务器模拟中将平均等待时间相对FCFS降低50.92%，长作业低估仍是调度相关的核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格作业运行时预测研究多采用随机交叉验证进行评估，存在目标泄露（使用执行后变量）和时间信息泄露问题，导致报告的性能无法真实反映部署场景；同时预测结果与调度决策之间的联系未被充分建立。本文旨在建立一种无泄露、时序感知且调度相关的评估基准，以更真实地衡量模型在生产部署条件下的泛化能力。

Method: 方法体系包含六个关键设计：（1）泄露安全特征策略——仅保留SubmitTime、ReqNProcs/ReqTime/ReqMemory等提交时属性及UserID、GroupID、ExecutableID等类别标识符，排除RunTime、WaitTime、UsedMemory等执行后变量；（2）时序安全历史基线——为每个测试作业仅使用其提交时间之前的同实体训练作业，避免未来信息泄露；（3）多种评估划分——随机5折、时序80/20、用户冷启动、可执行文件冷启动；（4）类别编码策略对比——独热、序数、目标均值编码与CatBoost原生类别处理；（5）时序验证调优——在内层时序验证集上选择CatBoost超参数（树深度8、500轮迭代、学习率0.03、L₂正则5），仅在保留的时序测试集上评估一次；（6）极简单服务器非抢占式调度模拟——比较FCFS、预测SJF与Oracle SJF在全部69,523个保留作业上的等待时间。

Result: 主要实验结果：（1）随机划分下K-NN达R²=0.700、MAE=7,417，而时序80/20下调优CatBoost仅R²=0.239、MAE=27,019、RMSE=46,587、LogMAE=2.646，随机划分显著高估性能；（2）时序划分下User EMA基线从随机的R²=0.638跌至-0.157，时序一致性至关重要；（3）类别编码对比中CatBoost原生类别处理（R²=0.239）大幅优于其他模型的最佳目标编码结果（Gradient Boosting R²=0.107）；（4）特征消融显示全部特征配置最优（R²=0.239），仅标识符（R²=0.126）、仅请求资源（R²<0）均较差；（5）置换重要性表明UserID、GroupID、ReqTime为最关键特征；（6）误差分析揭示系统偏差——短/中作业高估、超长/极长作业严重低估（极长作业低估率100%，平均误差-105,448秒）；（7）调度模拟显示预测SJF将平均等待时间从82,926,590降至40,698,550，相对FCFS改善50.92%，Oracle SJF改善75.83%。

Conclusion: 结论强调三点核心发现：第一，随机划分严重高估部署性能，必须采用时序和冷启动划分进行严格评估；第二，类别原生梯度提升（CatBoost）在泄露安全约束下能恢复有意义的时序预测能力（R²=0.239），优于传统编码策略下的各类模型；第三，长作业系统低估仍是调度相关的关键局限，可能导致回填预留违例。论文的主要贡献是建立了无泄露、时序感知、调度连接的评估范式，而非追求更高的回归精度。未来工作方向包括：集成至完整调度模拟器评估回填策略、探索分位数回归与保形预测区间、设计惩罚长作业低估的非对称损失函数，以及跨工作负载轨迹的泛化验证。

Abstract: Accurate job runtime prediction can improve scheduling-aware resource management in grid and distributed computing environments, but prediction models must be evaluated under realistic deployment constraints. This paper revisits CPU burst time prediction on the GWA-T-4 AuverGrid workload trace and reformulates it as leakage-safe pre-execution job runtime prediction. We define the target as job-level runtime, use only submission-time attributes, exclude post-execution variables, and evaluate models under temporal and cold-start settings rather than relying only on random cross-validation. We compare standard regressors, chronological historical baselines, categorical encoding strategies, and CatBoost with native categorical handling. We further add temporal hyperparameter tuning, runtime predictability analysis, feature ablation, error analysis by job length, and a minimal scheduling simulation. After temporal-validation tuning, CatBoost achieves the strongest deployment-oriented result with R^2=0.239, MAE=27,019, RMSE=46,587, and LogMAE=2.646 on the held-out temporal test set. A single-server simulation over all 69,523 held-out temporal test jobs shows that prediction-informed SJF reduces average waiting time by 50.92% relative to FCFS. The results show that random-split evaluation overestimates performance, categorical-native boosting improves temporal generalization, and long-job underestimation remains a scheduler-relevant challenge.

</details>


### [233] [HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13739)
*Hongliang Wei,Xiaobing Tu,Yinggui Wang,Zhengxi Liu,Rongkun Xue,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Debin Zhao,Xiaopeng Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HarnessBandit：一种面向多 harness 智能体强化学习的在线调度器，在每个优化步骤中根据"可学习性"（learnability，当前 harness 的平均绝对优势）与"可迁移性"（transferability，当前梯度草图与其他 harness 指数移动平均余弦相似度）动态选择单个 harness 产生纯批次，从而替代静态混合批次训练。在 Qwen3.5-2B × 6 个 harness × ClawGym 训练中，在 PinchBench 与 ClawEval 上均优于两种混合基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一大模型代理在不同的 harness（系统提示、工具 schema、控制循环、轨迹格式差异）下表现不一致，对 harness 变化具有鲁棒性是重要目标。直接用多 harness 混合批次训练引入了调度难题：每一步既要保证当前 harness 提供有效学习信号，又要使更新方向能惠及其他 harness。静态分配无法响应这些非平稳信号。

Method: 将多 harness 训练建模为非平稳多臂赌博机，每个 harness 是一个臂。核心机制：(1) 每次 GRPO 更新后观测 learnability L_h（组内平均绝对优势）与 transferability T_h（当前 harness 的低维梯度草图与其他 harness 的 EMA 单位草图之间的余弦相似度均值）；(2) 经池化滑动窗口（W=32）min-max 归一化后融合为分数 S_h=α·L̃+(1-α)·T̃，α=0.5；(3) 维护每臂 Q 值 EMA（β=0.3）；(4) 采用 U_h=Q_h+c/√(n_h+1)，并通过带温度 τ=0.3 的 softmax 与 ε=0.15 的均匀下界混合采样；(5) 梯度草图采用最后 K=4 个 transformer 块的固定比例坐标子采样（d=65536），避免存储完整梯度；(6) 前 30 步轮询热身。整体作为 GRPO 之上常数级附加层，不修改策略目标。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B + Dr.GRPO、150 步、4 GPU 条件下，2,000 ClawGym 任务 × 6 harness。PinchBench（147 任务，分布内 OpenClaw）：HarnessBandit 均分 0.506，优于 OpenClaw+Codex 双 harness 混合（0.493）和 6 harness 混合（0.331，与基模 0.330 持平）。ClawEval（161 任务，分布外 harness，N=3）：Pass³ 与基模并列 26.7%（43/161），Pass@3 达 41.6%（67/161）vs 基模 36.0%（58/161）、6 harness 混合 38.5%（62/161）；平均分 0.556 vs 基模 0.534、6 harness 混合 0.510。PinchBench 子类目中 HarnessBandit 在 7/11 项领先。诊断显示 L 与 T 给出不同且随时间演化的排序（Pi 高可学习性但中等可迁移性，OpenCode 两项均高），最终采样概率为 0.127–0.204，访问次数 21–32，未坍缩到单一 arm。

Conclusion: 多 harness 智能体 RL 应当把"用哪个 harness 生成下一批数据"作为一个显式调度决策。HarnessBandit 表明，基于训练器内生的可学习性与跨 harness 可迁移性两个互补信号进行在线赌博机式分配，能够在固定 GRPO 预算下同时提升分布内与分布外 harness 的表现，避免静态混合批次带来的干扰或坍缩。两信号具备独立性与时变性，是合理调度依据。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.

</details>


### [234] [Finite-Time Node Separation in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks with Persistent Gaussian Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13920)
*Mostafa Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对带持续高斯扰动的循环图神经网络(GNN)，在无收缩性或平稳性假设下，给出节点表示两两分离的有限时间概率精化分析：证明精确的二阶矩分解(产生与拓扑无关的普适下界 2σ²d)、条件非中心χ²刻画导出动力学感知的固定时刻与有限时域近碰撞概率上界、几乎必然的两两不碰撞、以及随机动力学的分布置换等变性。实验在合成图上验证了这些理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作[1]已证明持续高斯扰动通过保证正的平稳Dirichlet能量可阻止渐近过平滑。但该全局渐近能量界无法保证有限深度下个体节点表示仍保持可区分。正的整体能量与某些节点对可能极近甚至重合是兼容的。本文因此问：在不依赖收缩性或平稳性假设的前提下，持续高斯更新本身能给出怎样的有限时间、逐对的概率分离保证？

Method: 研究对象是与[1]相同的后更新加性高斯噪声循环架构 H⁽ᵗ⁺¹⁾ = F(H⁽ᵗ⁾) + σΞ⁽ᵗ⁾。方法完全基于噪声的独立高斯结构：(1) 对条件差 ζᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁾ ∼ N(0, 2σ²I_d) 进行二阶矩展开，得到精确分解等式并由此给出 2σ²d 的期望下界；(2) 注意到条件差服从以确定性消息传递分离为非中心参数的非中心χ²分布，由此推出随 λᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁾ = ‖Fᵢ−Fⱼ‖²/(2σ²) 变化的固定时刻与有限时域近碰撞上界（含中心高斯上界作为 λ=0 最坏情形）；(3) 用非退化高斯密度的满维性证明精确碰撞概率为零，并对所有正时刻取交得同时不碰撞；(4) 用高斯噪声的可交换性证明动力学的分布置换等变性与图级读出的分布不变性；(5) 在3类合成图(n=30)、d=16、σ=0.1、T=40 的循环消息传递 tanh(AHWᵀ) 上做5组蒙特卡洛实验验证。

Result: 理论结果：(i) 引理3.1的精确二阶矩分解 ℰ[‖Δᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁺¹⁾‖²] = ℰ[‖Fᵢ−Fⱼ‖²] + 2σ²d；(ii) 定理3.2给出 t≥1 时普适期望下界 2σ²d；(iii) 定理3.4与推论3.5–3.6证明几乎必然两两不碰撞，且对有限图同时跨所有正时刻成立；(iv) 引理3.8给出条件非中心χ² CDF 形式的精确小球概率，定理3.10/3.14导出动力学感知的固定时刻与有限时域上界 ε_δ,T ∝ σ·T^{−1/d}·[Γ(d/2+1)/C(n,2)]^{1/d}；(v) 定理6.1–6.2与推论6.3证明分布置换等变与图级读出不变性。实验结果：在3种图(cycle, ER, BA)上 2σ²d 的实证均值 ≈0.319–0.320，与理论值0.32吻合；最小成对距离始终为正(T=40时中位数≈0.38)；实证近碰撞概率在非空洞区间内均小于理论中央上界；置换实验中保持同一数值噪声时配对差很大(均值绝对差1.47)但边际分布KS检验不拒绝同分布(p=0.77)；27组参数敏感性扫描中实证5%分位始终高于 ε_δ,T，中位经验/理论比1.44(范围1.36–1.93)。

Conclusion: 本文是对持续噪声GNN理论的有限时间概率精化，而非新架构或图级普适表达力定理。在不需收缩性或平稳性假设下，严格证明了期望下界 2σ²d、几乎必然两两不碰撞、动力学感知的高概率分离界以及分布置换等变性。中心高斯最坏情形界被恢复为非中心χ²精化的 λ=0 特殊情形。控制实验支持理论预测，但实证与理论界之间存在保守间隙(中位比1.44)，源于对节点对与时间步的并集上界。节点级分离不等价于图级普适性；连接有限时间随机分离与图级表达力仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Persistent Gaussian perturbations have been shown to prevent asymptotic oversmoothing in recurrent Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) by ensuring a positive stationary Dirichlet energy. However, this global energy bound does not guarantee that individual node representations remain distinct at finite depths. In this paper, we provide a complementary finite-time analysis of the same persistent-noise architecture. Let \(d\) denote the representation dimension and \(\sigma\) the noise standard deviation. We first prove an exact second-moment decomposition for the expected squared distance between any two node representations, yielding the universal lower bound \(2\sigma^2 d\) at every positive time step without contraction or stationarity assumptions. More precisely, conditional pairwise distances have a noncentral chi-square characterization: the noncentrality parameter is the deterministic message-passing separation normalized by \(2\sigma^2\). This yields dynamics-aware fixed-time and finite-horizon near-collision bounds that retain information discarded by the central worst-case analysis. The earlier central Gaussian bound is recovered as the worst-case zero-separation case. We additionally prove almost-sure pairwise noncollision, derive a uniform finite-horizon guarantee, and establish permutation equivariance in distribution for the stochastic dynamics and permutation-invariant graph outputs. Our results complement the asymptotic energy analysis of prior work and provide rigorous finite-time guarantees on node-level representation separation.

</details>


### [235] [Hardware-Aware Learned Representation Compression for Distributed In-Sensor Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13947)
*Chengwei Zhou,Abu Masum,Xuming Chen,Mehran Moghadam,Sreetama Sarkar,Arnab Sanyal,Md Abdullah-Al Kaiser,M. Hassan Najafi,Sercan Aygun,Gourav Datta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OASIS是一个面向分布式传感器内视觉（in-sensor vision）的硬件感知学习表征压缩框架，通过轻量级编码器在CIS近端生成紧凑、任务相关的表征，结合4-bit量化+Huffman编码或Sobol超维计算（HDC）两条部署路径，在VWW分类、手部追踪、眼球追踪任务上实现最高18,816×的通信压缩与约2×–4.5×的系统能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉系统在CIS与外部处理器之间传输高分辨率像素流，导致显著的通信与能耗开销。现有in-sensor/near-sensor方案受限于算力、内存与任务复杂度（多停留在MNIST/CIFAR-10），难以在传感器侧执行深层多通道网络；传感侧激活张量仍然过大，限制了通信压缩收益。

Method: 1) 双分支自编码器：轻量级ResNet/SwinViT编码器在传感侧逻辑芯片上运行，将图像压缩为紧凑latent；解码器仅训练时使用以提供重建监督；2) 端到端训练损失=重建MSE+熵正则+任务损失，并采用QAT+STE实现4-bit对称均匀量化；3) 两条部署路径：路径A为4-bit量化+Huffman编码（保留空间结构，支持分类与密集预测）；路径B为Sobol序列生成的准正交level超向量，将latent映射为固定维二进制超向量，通过关联存储（cosine相似度）分类；4) 硬件实现：编码器与后处理流水线在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA上实现，结合22nm FDSOI CIS电路仿真与7nm ASIC能耗投影建立完整系统能耗模型。

Result: VWW分类：SwinViT编码器3×3×8 latent映射到64维HDC超向量，相对原始8-bit图像传输实现18,816×通信压缩（相对128维HDC额外1.77×），精度损失<1pp；Quant+Huff路径最高11,985×压缩。任务精度：VWW 88.2%（SwinViT）、Hand Tracking 2D AUC 0.880、Eye Segmentation mIoU 0.974。能耗：基于FPGA实测+ASIC投影，系统总能耗相对非in-sensor基线降低约2×–4.5×（SwinViT VWW达4.5×）；HDC后端能耗比Quant+Huff低59.6%–70.7%，且省去分类器网络。FPGA资源：SwinViT编码器约37K LUTs/122 DSPs；HDC后端仅约3.3K LUTs、无DSP。效率达22.7 TOPS/W（DPCE为11.49 TOPS/W）。

Conclusion: OASIS通过硬件-算法协同设计，为资源受限的in-sensor视觉系统提供了一条通信高效、能耗友好的实用路径；通过多目标联合训练使编码器latent同时满足任务判别性、熵可控性与重建可恢复性，两条互补部署路径分别覆盖密集预测与极致压缩分类场景，为AR/VR、智能感知与自治系统中的低功耗视觉前端奠定基础。

Abstract: In-sensor computing reduces the cost of transmitting high-resolution image data by performing early-stage processing near the sensor. However, the logic chip integrated with a CMOS image sensor (CIS) is tightly constrained in compute and memory, limiting conventional deep neural network partitioning. We present OASIS, a distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission. The encoder is trained end-to-end using task, entropy, and reconstruction objectives, while the decoder is used only during training. OASIS supports two complementary deployment paths. The first applies 4-bit quantization and Huffman coding while preserving the spatial structure required by classification and dense-prediction tasks. The second uses Sobol-based hyperdimensional computing (HDC) to transform the encoder latent into a fixed-dimensional binary hypervector for associative-memory classification. For the SwinViT-based VWW model, mapping a $3\times3\times8$ latent to a 64-dimensional hypervector provides an additional $1.77\times$ communication reduction with less than one percentage point of accuracy loss relative to the 128-dimensional configuration, yielding an overall $18{,}816\times$ reduction compared with raw 8-bit image transmission. We implement the digital near-sensor pipeline on an AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA and characterize it using direct board-level power measurements and Vivado post-implementation analysis, together with circuit-simulated CIS models and a 7-nm ASIC projection. Across visual wake-word classification, hand tracking, and eye tracking, OASIS reduces total system energy by approximately $2\times$-$4.5\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy, demonstrating a practical hardware-algorithm co-design path for communication-efficient in-sensor vision.

</details>


### [236] [To do($x$) or not to do($x$): Medical Image Counterfactuals for Dataset Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14124)
*Yasin Ibrahim,Robin J. Evans,Konstantinos Kamnitsas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种用于医学图像合成数据增强的条件生成策略（Deterministic、Undirected、Causal），通过Morpho-MNIST受控实验和CheXpert/MIMIC临床数据实验，揭示了因果建模在缓解偏差、改善公平性方面的实际价值与适用条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像数据集常存在偏差（如性别与疾病的虚假相关），导致模型在临床部署中出现偏差和泛化能力受限。合成数据增强是缓解偏差的常用策略，但现有文献中"反事实"一词含义模糊——有的指基于结构因果模型（SCM）的因果干预，有的仅指非因果的图像编辑或条件生成。本文旨在厘清这一区别，并系统评估因果条件策略在数据增强中的实际收益。

Method: 作者将生成模型的条件策略分为三类：(1) Deterministic——设定目标变量值，其余变量固定；(2) Undirected——基于统计关联推断其余变量，不指定因果方向；(3) Causal——沿有向因果图传播干预（基于SCM的abduction-action-prediction）。同时区分两种图像生成方式：基于真实图像的反事实生成和潜空间直接采样。基于半监督因果层次VAE模型实现三种策略，并在Morpho-MNIST（已知数据生成过程，4种DAG）和CheXpert胸片（age→pleural effusion→lung volume的DAG）上分别验证。在CheXpert上通过人为注入性别-PE虚假相关偏差，评估不同条件下PE分类器的AUC和不同年龄子群的公平性差距，并扩展至MIMIC数据集测试分布外表现。

Result: 在Morpho-MNIST上：(1) Causal在所有正确指定的DAG上均表现最佳或与最佳无显著差异；(2) Deterministic因设计过于刚性，遗漏应传播的因果效应；(3) Undirected因双向传播，过度改变父变量；(4) 当因果图被错误指定（方向反转）时，Causal优势消失，性能与最差方法持平。在CheXpert上：(1) 所有增强方法均优于无增强基线；(2) 标签比例越低，Undirected和Causal相对Deterministic优势越明显；(3) 反事实图像质量更高（FID/MMD/SSIM/LPIPS均更优），而采样在低标签设置下多样性更高；(4) 在公平性方面，Deterministic和Causal能减少年龄相关的公平性差距，而Undirected因双向建模意外放大了PE与年龄在反因果方向的关联，反而加剧偏差；(5) MIMIC跨数据集测试中，Causal-CF取得最佳AUC (0.8967) 和F1 (0.6207)。

Conclusion: 研究得出以下核心结论：(1) 当因果图正确时，Causal条件在所有干预类型上表现稳健；(2) 因果建模带来的更强归纳偏置有助于在低标签和高度偏差场景下提升下游性能；(3) 反事实生成与潜空间采样之间存在质量-多样性权衡——高标签时反事实更优，低标签时采样更优；(4) Undirected的双向关联可能反向放大偏差，在涉及父变量的公平性考量时不如Deterministic或Causal；(5) 若因果图不确定，Deterministic或Undirected反而更稳妥。整体上，本文为设计合成数据生成协议提供了具体指导，证明了因果方法在适当条件下的实际价值。

Abstract: Medical image analysis is often hindered by biased datasets, which can lead to biased models and limited clinical applicability. A promising strategy for mitigating such biases is to augment training data with synthetic images. Counterfactual (CF) generation is one such strategy, though the term is used in two different senses: in some works, CFs are produced through causality-based interventions derived from structural causal models, whereas in others, they are produced by non-causal image edits or conventional conditional generative models, such as altering anatomy or adding pathologies. In this work, we study this distinction and evaluate its practical consequences for medical image augmentation. We compare three conditioning strategies: $\textit{Deterministic}$, which changes selected variables while holding the remaining variables fixed; $\textit{Undirected}$, which updates variables according to learned statistical associations without assigning causal directions; and $\textit{Causal}$, which propagates interventions along a directed causal graph. We analyse how these choices affect the resulting images, and explore when causally grounded methods improve dataset augmentation or bring limited benefit. In particular, we assess downstream performance and fairness, where fairness refers to reduced sensitivity to dataset biases across sensitive subgroups. Our experiments demonstrate that using a causal approach to synthetic training data generation can lead to tangible benefits, with these insights offering valuable guidance to machine learning practitioners for the effective design of data generation protocols.

</details>


### [237] [LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14138)
*Siddharth Sharma,Nilesh Prasad Pandey,Onat Gungor,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LIMBO提出首个在线推理时记忆与算力联合分配框架，将终身LLM智能体中的经验回放从固定预处理转变为可控决策，通过双头LinUCB上下文老虎机为每个任务动态选择回放策略（无回放/完整/压缩/检索）和计算预算，无需模型权重、离线训练或教师监督。在LifelongAgentBench上跨3种LLM骨干（Qwen 2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、GPT-4o mini）和2种环境（DB、OS）的实验中，以最高约83%（平均约53%）的推理成本降低实现与最强记忆增强基线相当的准确率，并在不同模型/环境间自动学习差异化的回放策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身LLM智能体依赖经验回放复用历史交互轨迹，但回放会与检索、推理、工具调用、验证竞争有限的提示和算力预算。现有方法使用固定回放策略，不论当前任务是否真正受益，造成成本-价值不匹配（例如Qwen2.5 7B在DBBench上将回放从k=8扩到k=16，成本增加1.7倍但精度仅提升0.35点）。本文将这一资源分配问题形式化为"推理时记忆分配"这一独立问题类别，挑战"固定回放策略+手动指定"的范式。

Method: LIMBO基于扩展LinUCB的双头参数化上下文老虎机：(1) 12维在线特征向量涵盖提示形状（prompt/user/system/scaffold的log归一化token数）、运行时状态（成本EMA、运行准确率、上次归一化成本）和上次结果（成功/错误指示符）；(2) 每个动作维护精度矩阵A_a∈R^{12×12}和两个参数向量（准确率头b_a^acc和成本头b_a^cost），前者经σ映射预测正确概率，后者经max(·,0)预测归一化期望成本；(3) 动作为{无回放/完整/压缩/检索}四种记忆模式×三档生成预算（≤512/768/≥1024 token）的笛卡尔积，检索评分为查询词、技能集、表标识的Jaccard加权和；(4) 选取规则score(a)=p̂_a - λĉ_a + α√(xᵀA_a⁻¹x)，λ=0.5平衡精度与成本；(5) 每任务后用Sherman-Morrison秩一更新维护A_a⁻¹；(6) 满足四个设计属性：黑盒兼容（D1，无需权重/梯度）、单遍在线学习（D2）、O(d²)=O(144)控制器开销<0.5ms（D3）、显式精度-成本权衡（D4）。在LifelongAgentBench（DB/OS各500任务）上评估三种骨干×两种环境共六组配置，对比基线包括无回放、固定k∈{1,4,8,16}回放、LongLLMLingua压缩、Group Self-Consistency。

Result: 六组配置下LIMBO均位于成本-精度Pareto前沿：Qwen DB 74.4%/$0.050 vs 固定k=16基线74.85%/$0.290（-82.8%成本）；Qwen OS 51.4%/$0.226 vs 固定trim k=1基线51.5%/$0.343（-34.1%）；Llama DB 66.2%/$0.144 vs 固定k=16基线70.0%/$0.316（-54.4%，但比无回放20.8%高45.4点）；Llama OS 43.0%/$0.224 vs 固定k=1基线44.4%/$0.304（-26.3%）；GPT-4o mini DB 67.4%/$0.292 vs LongLLMLingua 69.0%/$1.654（-82.3%）；GPT-4o mini OS 62.4%/$0.833，严格Pareto支配LongLLMLingua基线（+0.6点且-40.5%成本）。相同超参数在六组配置中学到显著不同的动作分布：Qwen DB和GPT DB约78%任务选无回放（低回放价值场景）；Llama DB约85%任务转检索回放以挽救20.8%的无回放崩塌（记忆必需场景）；Qwen OS采用约70%检索+约25%完整回放的混合策略；GPT OS约88%检索且成本仅比无回放高约6%。在线适应证据：Qwen OS上第一个50任务窗口无回放占17.3%，收敛后稳定在3.8%；UCB探索奖励从0.347降至0.115（-67%），交叉种子标准差<0.017。所有实验三种子（42/43/44）平均。

Conclusion: LIMBO验证了有效推理时记忆分配可在单遍在线流中习得，无需离线训练、模型权重访问或教师监督。它是终身智能体场景中首个将记忆视为可控推理时资源的框架，并同时联合优化记忆策略与推理预算。该工作建立了一类新的"推理时记忆分配"问题，指出针对固定骨干/环境的差异化回放策略存在显著收益，并指出改进记忆表示方法（如MemRL）可自然作为附加动作整合到LIMBO的动作空间中。未来工作包括成本结构直接消融、动作空间扩展及更复杂终身场景的验证。

Abstract: As LLM agents become integrated into increasingly complex workflows, they must continually acquire new capabilities while retaining competence on previously learned tasks. Lifelong agents address this through experience replay, injecting past interactions into the prompt to leverage prior experience during inference. However, replay is not free: every replayed trajectory competes with retrieval, reasoning, tool use, and verification for the same limited prompt and compute budget, making effective resource allocation essential. Existing approaches allocate these resources using fixed replay policies, regardless of whether replay is beneficial for the current task. We identify this as inference-time memory allocation, a distinct problem class for lifelong agents, and introduce LIMBO: the first online framework to our knowledge that treats memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly optimizes memory strategy and inference budget for each incoming task. Unlike prior approaches that fix the replay policy or require model weights, teacher supervision, or offline retraining, LIMBO learns this allocation online in a single pass, explicitly balancing task performance and inference cost without modifying the underlying agent. Across three LLM backbones on LifelongAgentBench, LIMBO achieves better cost-accuracy tradeoffs than state-of-the-art memory-augmented baselines and nearly matches all strongest such baselines at up to ~83% lower inference cost (~53% on average). LIMBO adapts its policy across models and environments without retraining, demonstrating that effective allocation can be learned online rather than manually specified.

</details>


### [238] [Signatures of Steerability in Activation Space of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14151)
*Prajjwal Bhattarai,Tuka Alhanai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究发现简单的激活空间分离度指标（特别是信噪比SNR）能强预测语言模型中对比激活添加（CAA）引导向量的下游可引导性，并在合成叠加实验中验证这些指标实质上追踪的是恢复方向与真实特征方向的对齐程度而非全局叠加几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导（steering）是一种无需更新模型权重即可控制语言模型行为的有效方法，但其效果在不同概念、提示模板、数据集和干预层之间差异很大，且泛化能力通常被视为训练数据集的函数。本文旨在将"数据集依赖性"这一经验性观察严格化，探索是否存在某种激活分布的几何性质可预测引导效果，从而为判断引导向量何时有效提供实用诊断工具。

Method: 1. 数据集与模型：使用26个角色数据集（Perez et al. 2023）、5个真实性数据集（Ying et al. 2026）和7个安全性数据集（Zhang et al. 2024），覆盖Qwen、Gemma、Llama三个模型家族共6个指令调优模型（1B-4B及7B-14B参数规模）。2. 引导向量构建与可引导性度量：采用对比激活添加（CAA, Rimsky et al. 2024）方法构建引导向量μ，可引导性定义为引导强度λ与平均倾向性之间的最佳线性拟合斜率。3. 四种分离度指标：信噪比（SNR = ‖μ‖²/(Tr(Σ⁺)+Tr(Σ⁻))）、均值对齐（个体对比对与μ的余弦相似度均值）、流形容量（基于随机投影可分性的维度数）和内禀维度（Two-NN估计器）。4. 合成叠加实验：在已知真实特征方向v₀的受控设置中，系统变化字典相干性ϵ、活跃噪声特征数k和特征恢复度π，分析各分离度指标与这些结构性属性的关系。5. 偏相关分析：通过对层或数据集指示变量做线性残差化，控制混杂变量后计算偏相关。

Result: 1. 在真实LLM中：SNR是最佳预测指标，跨所有模型和数据集的Pearson/Spearman相关系数达0.69-0.82（r=0.76聚合）；均值对齐次之（0.63-0.82）；流形容量中等（0.47-0.76）；内禀维度最弱且在人格数据集上甚至出现符号翻转（-0.07至-0.29）。2. 控制混杂后：SNR在控制数据集（r=0.74）和控制层（r=0.74）后仍保持最强预测力；内禀维度在控制层后几乎消失（r=0.07）。3. 合成实验揭示机制：SNR与均值对齐与特征恢复度π强相关（ρ≈0.91和0.90），与活跃特征数k弱负相关（ρ=-0.33），与相干性ϵ几乎无关（ρ≈-0.01）；内禀维度呈现相反模式，与k正相关（ρ=0.37）但与π负相关（ρ=-0.42）。4. 验证：分组内相关分析确认SNR和均值对齐的恢复度关联在各配置中一致（组内中位数ρ≈0.92），而内禀维度的关联消失（中位数ρ≈0.006）。5. 层分析：分离度相关性最高的层通常接近模型最可引导的层（5/6模型在4层以内）。

Conclusion: 简单的分离度统计量（尤其是信噪比）可作为预测语言模型CAA引导向量下游效果的实用诊断工具。这些指标之所以有效，主要因为它们追踪的是恢复的引导方向与真实线性特征方向之间的对齐程度（特征恢复机制），而非全局叠加结构的几何属性。SNR在控制数据集和层效应后仍保持稳健的预测力，为实践中预判引导是否可行提供了低成本的几何探针。局限包括：仅验证CAA方法、相关分析非因果、仅测试多选格式且未评估流畅度退化，以及可能被滥用于对抗性操纵。

Abstract: Steering language models using a set of contrastive representations has been a canonical and computationally efficient method for controlling model behavior. Despite this success in controlling certain model behaviors, the effectiveness of activation steering varies markedly across concepts; the generalization properties of steering vectors are often considered a function of the dataset used to construct them. We make this dataset-dependence claim more rigorous and show that simple separation metrics strongly correlate with the downstream steerability of language models across diverse settings, even after controlling for layers and dataset effects. Beyond prediction, we provide evidence from a synthetic superposition experiment that separation metrics are strongly correlated with alignment between the empirical and true feature direction. Our results suggest that simple separability statistics can serve as practical diagnostics for when steering vectors are likely to work.

</details>


### [239] [Entropy-Punctured Bloom Filters for Memory-Efficient Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14187)
*John Cartmell,Mihaela Cardei,Ionut Cardei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"熵穿刺布隆过滤器"（Entropy-Punctured Bloom Filters, PBF）的内存感知编码策略，用于机器学习中的回归任务。该方法通过移除基于经验熵识别出的低变异性比特位置，在保留预测结构的同时显著减少编码表示的大小。实验表明，PBF在保持与经典降维方法（如PCA、随机投影）相当预测性能的同时，显著提高了预测效率（每字节R²）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在存储、传输、带宽或隐私约束限制访问原始数据的机器学习场景中，需要内存高效的特征表示。布隆过滤器（BF）编码可提供紧凑的概率表示，但其在结构压缩下的行为及在回归任务中的适用性尚未得到充分探索。此外，传统降维方法主要评估预测准确度，未能充分捕捉预测性能与表示大小之间的折衷。

Method: 1. 布隆过滤器特征编码：将分位数化后的特征通过k-哈希映射为固定长度的二进制向量表示。2. 熵穿刺：基于经验熵计算每个比特位置的边际熵Hj，移除熵低于阈值τ的低变异性比特位置，保留高变异性位置。该过程遵循无信息泄漏的评估协议（仅使用训练数据估计熵）。3. 评估指标：定义"预测效率"PE = R²/B（B为每样本编码字节数），用于衡量单位存储所保留的预测信号。4. 对比方法：与原始特征、PCA、随机投影（RP）以及标准特征哈希（FH）在近似匹配的表示大小下进行比较。5. 模型：使用岭回归、XGBoost和神经网络（MLP）。6. 数据集：涵盖表格、时间序列、生物医学和文本等多种模态的8个回归数据集。

Result: 1. 预测保真度：PBF在大多数数据集上保持与原始特征和经典压缩方法相当的R²性能。2. 预测效率：在8个数据集中的7个上，PBF实现了最高的预测效率（例如，Boston数据集从0.0082提升至0.0380；Parkinson's从0.0105提升至0.0720）。3. 结构鲁棒性：移除低熵比特比移除高熵或随机比特的损害更小；适度的熵穿刺（τ=0.15-0.35）可移除大量低变异性位置同时保持预测保真度。4. 折叠实验：OR折叠可将64字节压缩至32字节而几乎不损失R²。5. 与特征哈希对比：在存储匹配条件下，PBF在California Housing（R²=0.7622 vs 0.0844）和Parkinson's（R²=0.8830 vs 0.3654）上均显著优于标准有符号特征哈希。

Conclusion: 熵穿刺布隆过滤器提供了一种有效的表示级压缩方法，适用于内存受限的机器学习场景。该方法在保持预测保真度的同时显著减少了编码表示大小，在大多数评估的数据集上实现了优越的预测效率。熵作为标签独立的近常数比特位置指标，其指导下的结构压缩具有实用价值。但该方法也存在局限性：熵是边际的无监督度量而非与目标互信息的度量，低熵位置仍可能具有预测性。未来工作可探索有监督的比特选择准则、自适应参数选择及隐私敏感场景中的应用。

Abstract: Memory-efficient feature representations are increasingly important in machine learning settings where storage, transmission cost, bandwidth, or privacy constraints limit access to raw data. Bloom Filter (BF) encodings provide compact probabilistic representations of engineered features, but their behavior under structural compression and their applicability to regression tasks remain underexplored. In this work, we propose entropy-punctured Bloom Filters, a memory-aware encoding strategy that removes low-variability bit positions identified using empirical entropy. Starting from fixed-length BF encodings of quantized features, the proposed approach produces reduced representations that preserve predictive structure while improving predictive efficiency relative to encoded representation size. We evaluate the approach on diverse regression datasets, comparing raw features, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Random Projection (RP), and Bloom Filter variants under leakage-free evaluation protocols and approximately matched representation sizes. Performance is assessed using ridge regression, XGBoost, and neural networks, with predictive efficiency measured as R2 relative to encoded representation size per sample. Results show that Bloom Filter encodings remain competitive with classical compressed representations while achieving substantial storage savings. Entropy-based puncturing further reduces representation size with minimal loss in predictive fidelity, yielding improved predictive efficiency. These findings demonstrate that entropy-punctured Bloom Filters provide an effective representation-level compression approach for memory-constrained machine learning.

</details>


### [240] [Data-free On-policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14193)
*Gengsheng Li,Mao Zheng,Mingyang Song,Jie Sun,Zeyuan Liu,Ruiqi Liu,Qiyong Zhong,Haiyun Guo,Junfeng Fang,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示在线策略蒸馏（OPD）对训练数据极不敏感，并据此提出完全无需外部数据的DF-OPD（由教师自行出题），在单教师和多教师蒸馏设置下均匹配或超越真实数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为前沿大模型后训练流水线的标准组件，但其训练数据的实际贡献从未被系统审视。实践中常面临两个难题：（1）预算应投向数据采集还是算法优化？（2）当教师权重可获取、但其后训练数据不可获取时，如何蒸馏？因此需要量化OPD对数据数量、难度、信息量的依赖程度，并探索能否完全摆脱外部数据。

Method: 在两类常见师生配对（RL微调教师 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B → JustRL-1.5B；同族大参数教师 Qwen3-1.7B → Qwen3-30B-A3B）上，沿数量（|D|=1/8/64/256/1k/17k）、难度/信息量（DAPO/DeepMath/ORZ/DeepCoder）三个轴扫描OPD训练曲线；定义"信号覆盖率"（signal coverage）衡量已访问状态暴露教师修正的比例；提出DF-OPD——教师按简单指令自出题、无种子、无检索、无过滤；并扩展到Open-MOPD的三领域（数学/代码/指令遵循）多教师蒸馏，由各领域教师自行生成带领域标签的提示。

Result: （1）8个提示即匹配17k数据集（RL配对56.3 vs 56.4；大参数配对49.9 vs 47.4），单个提示仍在3.6分以内；（2）DAPO/DeepMath/ORZ虽难度与师生KL差异达数倍，训练曲线几乎重合；（3）单问题信号覆盖率随采样预算从0.114升至0.507，每翻倍增加约0.04，但问题数从1增至8后边际贡献骤降约30倍；（4）用DeepCoder（编程题）替换数学训练数据仍保留92–96%的域内收益；（5）DF-OPD自生成题在RL配对达56.4–56.6，大参数配对48.6–49.5（均超真实数据）；（6）自生成题在top-k KL、top-k重叠、学生重叠质量三个训练动力学诊断上与教师后训练数据DAPO同组，而DeepMath/ORZ/DeepCoder均偏离；（7）多教师蒸馏中1k自生成题（仅真实数据13%）恢复98.5%上限，超过7k真实后训练例的96.6%，且数学与指令遵循均领先。

Conclusion: OPD对训练数据数量、难度、信息量均不敏感，根源在于：（1）在线策略采样+逐token密集监督使少量提示转化为大量监督信号；（2）OPD传递的是教师的推理模式，而非数据中的知识。这两点共同推动出DF-OPD——只需教师与学生两个策略，无需任何外部数据或过滤，单教师与多教师蒸馏均匹配或超越真实数据。该工作重新审视了数据在OPD中的角色。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a standard component of frontier post-training pipelines, yet how much its training data actually contributes has gone largely unexamined. On the two teacher-student pairings most common in practice, we find OPD almost indifferent to its data: eight prompts already match a 17k-problem dataset, and three independently built datasets whose difficulty and teacher-student KL differ several-fold produce nearly indistinguishable training curves. Two causes account for this. First, the unit of data in OPD is the state a prompt leads to, not the prompt itself: a single prompt keeps exposing new teacher correction as sampling continues, while the marginal value of additional prompts collapses after eight. Second, replacing mathematics with competitive programming still recovers over ninety percent of the in-domain gain, indicating that OPD transfers the teacher's mode of reasoning rather than knowledge related to the data. We take this to its limit with Data-free On-policy Distillation (DF-OPD), in which the teacher writes its own training questions under a simple prompt -- no external data, no filtering -- leaving a system of just two policies. DF-OPD matches and even surpasses real data, and the questions it produces track the teacher's own post-training data on three key diagnostics of training dynamics, which other real datasets do not. Applied to multi-teacher distillation, where the (prompt, domain) pairs normally have to be derived from post-training data that is often out of reach, 1k self-generated questions close 98.5% of the available headroom, even surpassing the 96.6% reached with 7k real examples. Moreover, together these results invite a reassessment of the role data plays in OPD.

</details>


### [241] [Graph-Transformer Fraud Detection with Self-Supervised Pretraining and Conformal Risk Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14234)
*Sergei,Komarov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GTFD是一种面向企业交易网络中协同欺诈检测的图-Transformer混合模型，通过融合图注意力网络、门控Transformer和跨模态门控层，并结合保形风险控制和自监督预训练，实现了高准确率与强鲁棒性的欺诈检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于规则引擎和经典学习模型的欺诈检测方法将每笔交易孤立看待，难以应对日益协同化、复杂化的企业交易网络欺诈行为，亟需融合结构与时序证据的新方法。

Method: 1. 使用多头图注意力网络（GAT）对企业支付图进行结构编码；2. 使用门控Transformer对有序交易序列进行时序编码；3. 通过跨模态门控层融合两种视图；4. 采用保形风险控制（conformal risk control）头输出无阈值异常分数并提供有限样本覆盖保证；5. 训练采用自监督链接掩码预训练与对抗增强。

Result: 在包含协同欺诈环的企业交易基准上，GTFD达到AUROC 0.990、F1分数96.1%（精确率96.3%、召回率95.9%）、准确率98.4%；相较最强基线，假阳性率降低约29%，协同欺诈环召回率从85.1%提升至96.5%；消融实验显示自监督预训练贡献约2.0个AUROC点，保形头贡献约1.9个AUROC点；在扰动幅度0.20的对抗压力测试下保持89.2%准确率，次优模型仅76.4%。

Conclusion: GTFD通过图结构与时序序列的跨模态融合，配合保形风险控制和自监督预训练，在企业交易欺诈检测中显著优于现有基线方法，尤其在协同欺诈环检测与对抗鲁棒性方面表现突出，为复杂金融欺诈检测提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Financial fraud in corporate transaction networks has grown more coordinated and harder to detect with rule-based engines and with classical learning models that treat each transaction in isolation. This paper presents GTFD, a graph-transformer fraud detector that fuses structural and temporal evidence from a corporation's payment graph. GTFD encodes the graph with a multi-head graph attention network, encodes ordered transaction sequences with a gated transformer, and combines both views through a cross-modal gating layer. A conformal risk-control head converts the fused representation into threshold-free anomaly scores with finite-sample coverage guarantees, and the network is trained with self-supervised link-mask pretraining plus adversarial augmentation so it remains stable under scarce labels and under adversarial perturbation. On a corporate transaction benchmark enriched with coordinated fraud rings, GTFD reaches an AUROC of 0.990, an F1-score of 96.1% (precision 96.3%, recall 95.9%), and an accuracy of 98.4%. It reduces the false-positive rate by about 29% relative to the strongest baseline while raising coordinated fraud-ring recall from 85.1% to 96.5%. Ablations attribute roughly 2.0 AUROC points to self-supervised pretraining and 1.9 AUROC points to the conformal head, and adversarial stress tests show GTFD retains 89.2% accuracy at perturbation magnitude 0.20 where the next-best model falls to 76.4%.

</details>


### [242] [Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14279)
*Rushan Geng,Cuicui Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BSCA模型,将双四元数空间与复数注意力结合用于时序知识图谱补全,在GDELT数据集上MRR提升约37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序知识图谱嵌入(TKGE)方法存在两大局限:单一几何空间难以表示多样化的关系模式,以及将实体表示视为静态而无法捕捉实体语义随时间的变化。

Method: BSCA模型包含两大核心组件:(1)利用双四元数的Hamilton乘积,在统一代数框架中同时建模循环旋转、双曲旋转和缩放变换;(2)采用复数值注意力机制动态融合时间条件与关系条件的实体表示,使实体表示随时间戳和关系上下文变化。模型通过N3正则化、互逆学习(每个关系引入逆关系)和时间正则化进行训练。

Result: 在五个基准数据集(ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15、GDELT、YAGO11k、Wikidata12k)上,BSCA在四个数据集的所有指标上取得最优,YAGO11k上Hits@3和Hits@10最优。最显著提升在GDELT:MRR达52.1%,相比最强基线TuckERTNT的38.1%提升约37%。模型参数量38.41M,ICEWS14训练时间9.5分钟。消融实验验证了各组件贡献。形式化证明显示模型可表示对称、非对称、逆和时序演化四种关系模式。

Conclusion: BSCA通过双四元数空间统一循环与双曲变换,并结合复数注意力实现上下文相关的实体表示,在时序知识图谱补全任务中取得了强性能与适中计算成本的良好平衡,支持对超复数表示在TKGE中进一步研究。

Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) models infer missing facts in knowledge graphs that evolve over time. Many existing models use a single geometric space, which can limit their ability to represent diverse relational patterns, or treat entity representations as static. We propose Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention (BSCA), a TKGE model that combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework. A complex-valued attention mechanism adaptively fuses time-conditioned and relation-conditioned entity representations, allowing them to vary with temporal and relational context. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show competitive performance across datasets, with the largest improvement on GDELT: BSCA achieves an MRR of 52.1\%, compared with 38.1\% for the strongest baseline in our comparison.

</details>


### [243] [Follow the Geometry, Not the Model: Cold Start Semi-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14451)
*Itai David,Daphna Weinshall*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VAST提出了一种冷启动半监督学习方法，通过将伪标签推断与分类器训练解耦，利用冻结自监督嵌入的几何结构构建Veracity Matrix传播标签证据，生成软伪标签后再蒸馏到归纳分类器中。该方法在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet100上显著优于图基SSL基线，并产生可部署的归纳分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代SSL方法将伪标签生成与分类器训练耦合，依赖分类器自身置信度选择伪标签。但在冷启动场景下（每类最多4个标签），分类器尚未校准，无法可靠地监督自身，导致过自信但错误的伪标签或置信度门控失效，这正是SSL最有价值却最难应用的场景。

Method: 1. Veracity Matrix：在冻结自监督嵌入的稀疏k-NN图上，通过密度归一化RBF核传播标签证据，每行形成Dirichlet后验参数（解释为per-observation powered-likelihood的推广）；2. Veracity Propagation：自终止的迭代信念传播，将已置信的无标签点作为辅助证据源，将信念扩散到核邻域之外；3. 类别平衡自适应门控与软伪标签蒸馏：基于peakedness分布的双峰特性自动设置阈值，使用归一化Veracity向量作为软目标进行蒸馏训练分类器。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet100上，VAST在所有9个对比中均领先最强的图基SSL基线，其中7个具有统计显著性（配对t检验）；相比*Match系列端到端置信度门控SSL，VAST在CIFAR-100 100标签下达到39.2%，而FreeMatch仅为9.8%（甚至低于纯监督MLP的29.4%）；计算成本约为FreeMatch的1/20；保持归纳性部署，而Poisson和C&S等基线需要转导重解。

Conclusion: VAST通过将伪标签推断视为独立于分类器训练的问题，从嵌入几何直接构建概率信念，成功解决了冷启动SSL中分类器自监督的循环依赖问题。其核心贡献在于：(1)将SSL重构为先推断后学习的范式；(2)以不确定性形式而非决策形式承载标签证据；(3)在控制协议下全面领先基线并保持归纳部署。未来方向包括学习核、流式扩展以及在高标签预算下与一致性正则化结合。

Abstract: Modern semi-supervised learning (SSL) couples pseudo-label generation and classifier training, using the classifier's own confidence to select the pseudo-labels that are then used to update the model. In the cold-start regime, where at most a few labels per class are available, this coupling is ill-posed, since the classifier cannot supervise itself before it has learned. To address this problem, we propose VAST (Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training), which decouples these two stages. Probabilistic beliefs over the unlabeled set are first inferred directly from the geometry of a frozen self-supervised embedding and only then distilled into an inductive classifier. The construction rests on the Veracity Matrix, a kernel-based structure that aggregates label evidence across the data manifold and admits an interpretation as a Dirichlet posterior under a per-observation powered-likelihood model. Additionally, we introduce Veracity Propagation, a self-terminating belief-spreading step that extends coverage beyond the kernel neighborhood of the labeled set. Under a controlled protocol in which all methods receive identical frozen embeddings and labeled sets, VAST outperforms the strongest graph-based SSL baselines at every operating point across three datasets, with statistically significant gains in 7 of 9 comparisons, while producing a deployable inductive classifier rather than requiring transductive graph inference. Compared with end-to-end confidence-gated SSL, we further find that these methods underperform in this setting and, in our experiments, do not consistently exceed labeled-only performance.

</details>


### [244] [EdgeHAR: An Edge-Native Compact Sensor Foundation Model for Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14498)
*He Zhang,Siyu Yuan,Siyu Liu,Sizhen Bian,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeHAR 提出了一种面向可穿戴边缘设备的紧凑型传感器基础模型，通过将传感器信号分解为活动语义、运动动态和采集上下文三个潜在因子，实现对未见用户、设备、采样率和佩戴位置等场景分布偏移的高效迁移与轻量化适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有传感器基础模型主要面向云端部署，模型规模大、计算开销高，难以满足可穿戴设备在算力、内存、时延和隐私方面的严格约束。同时，传感器信号中活动知识与采集条件（设备、采样率、佩戴位置等）相互纠缠，导致在真实分布偏移下迁移性能下降且难以进行高效的设备端个性化适配。

Method: EdgeHAR 采用两阶段框架：(1) 多数据集传感器预训练阶段，通过共享编码器提取通用表示，并利用分解函数 F 将其映射为三个互补的潜在因子——活动语义码 zs（捕获可复用的活动知识）、运动动态码 zd（建模时序模式）和采集上下文码 za（表示传感器特异性变化）；预训练目标结合因子学习损失、一致性损失 L_cons 和互补性损失 L_comp。(2) 边缘高效适配阶段，采用类似 LoRA 的轻量适配器对语义表示进行个性化微调（z̃s = zs + Wuσ(Wd·zs)），仅更新少量参数；部署时仅保留紧凑的识别路径 f_edge(X) = g(S_φs(E_θ(X)))，实现低开销的端侧推理。

Result: 在跨数据集、跨用户和跨位置三类分布偏移场景下，仅使用 2% 目标域样本进行微调，EdgeHAR 在多源跨数据集迁移中准确率达 86.28%~92.45%，单源跨数据集迁移中最高达 97.53%，跨用户迁移平均准确率 93.31%，跨位置迁移最高达 95.71%。边缘效率方面，部署版模型仅 1.086M 参数、4.14MB 存储、18.42MB 内存。在 PAMAP2 的少样本新兴活动适配中，每类 100 样本时 Macro-F1 达 91.86%，显著优于 SDMix、ContrastSense、UniHAR、LLM4HAR 等基线。

Conclusion: EdgeHAR 验证了通过结构化解耦表示学习可以在紧凑模型规模下实现基础模型级别的迁移能力，为面向普适感知系统的边缘优先基础模型提供了一种实用范式，在准确性与边缘部署效率之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) is fundamental to ubiquitous and wearable computing, yet existing foundation models are largely designed for cloud-scale deployment and struggle with real-world sensing shifts, including unseen users, devices, sampling rates, and sensor placements. We present \textbf{EdgeHAR}, an edge-native compact sensor foundation model designed for wearable intelligence. Unlike conventional models that entangle activity knowledge with acquisition variations, EdgeHAR learns transferable representations by factorizing sensor signals into three latent codes: an \textbf{(i)Activity-Semantic Code} capturing reusable activity knowledge, a \textbf{(ii)Motion-Dynamics Code} modeling temporal patterns, and an \textbf{(iii)Acquisition-Context Code} representing sensor-specific variations. This disentangled design enables efficient adaptation to new users, devices, placements, and activity classes with limited target-domain data. By incorporating lightweight adaptation modules, EdgeHAR achieves foundation-model-level transferability while satisfying edge constraints in computation, memory, latency, and privacy. Experiments across heterogeneous HAR datasets demonstrate that EdgeHAR maintains competitive recognition performance under distribution shifts with substantially reduced deployment cost. EdgeHAR establishes a practical paradigm for compact, edge-first foundation models for ubiquitous sensing systems.

</details>


### [245] [Diagnosing Temporal Misalignment in Multichannel Time-Series Classification with Minimum Description Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14595)
*Sebastian Buschjäger,Michael Frichert,Daniel Kuhe,Jian-Jia Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于最小描述长度(MDL)的无分类器、无标签诊断方法，用于检测多通道时间序列分类中的时间错位问题，无需可信的对齐基线即可审计训练和部署数据中的同步问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道时间序列分类通常假设传感器流已同步，但实际中延迟、时钟漂移和预处理会引入相对时移。现有同步方案多为硬件特定且难以追溯应用，导致同步问题常被忽视而分类性能不佳。需要一种能估计数据集对跨通道时间对齐依赖程度的方法。

Method: 基于最小描述长度(MDL)原理：对传感器组施加候选时移τ，用固定补集的秩一PCA锚定表示作为共享表征，通过线性重建模型(非负权重)从锚定表示重建移位组。对比独立编码码长ℓ_ind与共享表征码长ℓ_sh之差得到压缩增益R_G(τ)，定义逐点对齐代价Q_G(τ;Δ)=R*_G(Δ)-R_G(τ)，以最差组的平均代价作为数据集级对齐损失A(Δ)。最优时移τ*_G即MDL诊断的对齐校正建议。

Result: 在两个合成任务上正确区分了对齐敏感和对齐鲁棒任务，并恢复了正弦周期性。在9个真实世界数据集上，该度量能暴露对齐结构并在引入部署漂移后恢复分类器精度。在FordChallenge、Opportunity、PAMAP2和UCIActivity四个基准中发现稳定的非零MDL最优值，揭示了潜在的系统性偏移。与SyncNet相比，尽管SyncNet在6/11数据集上表现更优，但MDL度量在3个数据集上胜出，且无需可信对齐基线。

Conclusion: 该MDL诊断方法无需分类器、标签和训练即可检测多通道时间序列中的共享时间结构，是对齐审计和调试数据采集流程的有用工具。其非零最优值表明部分公开基准可能存在系统性偏移，干预应在数据采集阶段进行。代码已开源。

Abstract: Multichannel time-series classification commonly assumes synchronized sensor streams, although latency, clock drift, and preprocessing can introduce relative delays during data collection or after deployment. Existing synchronization solutions are often hardware-specific and difficult to apply retrospectively. Consequently, synchronization problems may remain undetected while classification performance is suboptimal. We introduce a classifier- and label-free diagnostic based on minimum description length (MDL). Our method applies candidate temporal shifts to sensor groups and measures how efficiently one group can be encoded through a representation of the remaining channels. An increased codelength indicates that the shift destroys shared temporal structure, whereas the minimum identifies the alignment most strongly supported by the data. Unlike learned synchronization methods, the diagnostic requires neither retraining nor a trusted aligned reference and can therefore test both training and deployment data for misalignments. Experiments on two controlled synthetic tasks and nine real-world datasets show that the metric exposes alignment structure and can recover accuracy under induced deployment drift. A whole-dataset audit further identifies stable nonzero MDL optima in established benchmarks including FordChallenge, Opportunity, PAMAP2, and UCIActivity, revealing potential systematic offsets that conventional model evaluation does not expose. Our method thus provides a general-purpose tool for detecting, understanding, and correcting temporal misalignment throughout the time-series learning pipeline. Our code is available under this https URL .

</details>


### [246] [WaterKron and FlipFlop Hessian: Information-Theoretically Grounded Quantization with Kronecker-factored Hessians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14706)
*Johann Birnick,Rayan Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对后训练量化中Kronecker分解Hessian近似的选择问题，提出了WaterKron算法和FlipFlop Hessian近似。理论核心是推导出一个显式的Kronecker-Hessian失配因子Φ，量化因Kronecker近似带来的渐近失真惩罚，并证明最小化Φ可导出经典的flip-flop高斯协方差拟合迭代。实验上在Llama和Qwen系列模型上以2 bit/权重的低比特率量化，FlipFlop Hessian在KL散度和困惑度上均一致优于仅输入侧、边际、Frobenius等既有Hessian选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）需要在低比特率下逼近全精度权重矩阵W。GPTQ及其两-sided扩展以Kronecker分解Hessian A⊗B形式组织误差传播，但如何最优选择因子A、B一直缺乏信息论指导。已有工作使用仅输入侧Hessian、Marginal、Frobenius匹配等多种选择，但理论上不清楚哪种最优。本文从率失真角度回答"Kronecker分解Hessian应如何选择"。

Method: 1）将信息论水填充（waterfilling）框架扩展到两-sided GPTQ，得到WaterKron算法，推导行/列尺度 α_j ∝ 1/L^(A)_{j,j}、β_i ∝ 1/L^(B)_{i,i} 的最优率分配（Corollary 3.2），相比信息论极限仅有约0.25 bit渐近差距。2）在全Hessian几何下刻画WaterKron的高率失真（Theorem 4.1），显式给出Kronecker-Hessian失配因子 Φ(H, A⊗B) = tr(H(A⊗B)⁻¹)/(mn) / (|H|^{1/(mn)} · |A⊗B|^{-1/(mn)})，其等于广义特征值的算术均值/几何均值之比，与KL散度有对数关系。3）证明最小化Φ等价于高斯协方差拟合问题，由此导出交替固定点迭代 A_{k+1} ∝ 𝔼[(g^T B_k^{-1} g) xx^T]、B_{k+1} ∝ 𝔼[(x^T A_{k+1}^{-1} x) gg^T]，即经典的flip-flop算法。实验在Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-1.7B/4B上以2 bit/权重、256序列×2048 token校准，对比Input(WaterSIC)/Marginal/Frobenius/FlipFlop四种Hessian选择的KL散度与PPL。

Result: 理论方面：建立了两-sided GPTQ的率失真界（信息论下界Corollary 3.1与可达成界Corollary 3.2，两者仅差0.25 bit）；证明了全Hessian失真与两-sided失真通过tr(H(A⊗B)⁻¹)/(mn)因子相联系；Φ≥1且在H与A⊗B成比例时取等；最小化Φ自然导出flip-flop迭代。实验方面（2 bit/权重）：FlipFlop在四个模型、两个数据集上一致优于所有基线。以Llama-3.2-1B (WikiText-2)为例，Input: KL=1.52/PPL=45.3，Marginal: 0.88/23.9，Frobenius-1: 0.88/23.7，而FlipFlop-2达0.71/20.1；FlipFlop通常2次迭代最优（3次对Qwen略退化），而Frobenius迭代次数增加反而变差，甚至在Qwen3-4B上劣于纯输入侧Hessian，验证了‖H-A⊗B‖_F并非合适的优化目标。

Conclusion: 本文从信息论视角系统化了Kronecker分解Hessian在两-sided GPTQ中的选择问题。核心贡献是建立了失配因子Φ作为衡量Hessian近似质量的准则——它比Frobenius范数在率失真意义上更恰当——并证明其最小化等价于高斯协方差拟合的flip-flop迭代。提出的FlipFlop Hessian近似在多个LLM、多个数据集上一致取得最佳KL/PPL，为量化实践中Hessian因子的选择提供了理论依据与实用方案。

Abstract: How should a Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation be chosen for post-training quantization? We address this question through WaterKron, which combines two-sided GPTQ with row- and column-dependent waterfilling scales and entropy coding. We derive its high-rate distortion with respect to the full Hessian using an explicit Kronecker-Hessian mismatch factor $\Phi$. This factor quantifies the asymptotic distortion penalty due to the Kronecker Hessian approximation and provides a criterion for selecting the factors optimally. Minimizing $\Phi$ leads to a Gaussian covariance-fitting problem with classical ``flip-flop'' updates. We thus give a rate-distortion justification for using the resulting FlipFlop Hessian in quantization. We evaluate it empirically, finding that the FlipFlop Hessian consistently improves KL divergence and perplexity over input-only, marginal, and Frobenius-based Hessian choices.

</details>


### [247] [Carryover Drafting: Recycling Rejected States for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14717)
*Jahyun Koo,Sunghyeon Woo,Jaeeun Kil,Jeongtae Lee,Sungjae Lee,Kyomin Jung,Minsub Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Carryover Drafting，通过回收推测解码中被拒绝的目标模型隐藏状态作为下一轮草稿的临时 KV 上下文，从而提高 LLM 推理速度；同时设计了并行的 draft–verify–draft 训练方法，避免顺序 rollout，在两个目标模型和两种草稿器（DFlash 和基于 DSpark 的 Markov）上取得显著的接受长度和端到端加速提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码中，目标模型在验证阶段已为被拒绝的 token 计算了隐藏状态，但传统草稿器仅保留已接受 token 的表示，造成大量验证计算浪费。这些被丢弃的隐藏状态可能包含关于未来 token 的有用信息，可用于改进下一轮草稿。挑战在于：推理时回收开销可能抵消接受长度带来的加速；训练时标准并行草稿训练不会产生推理对齐的拒绝状态，而顺序 rollout 会牺牲并行性。

Method: Carryover Drafting 将被拒绝的目标隐藏状态回收为下一轮草稿的临时 KV 上下文，复用草稿器现有接口，仅添加一个可学习的嵌入 E_carry 来区分拒绝状态与已提交上下文，每轮替换以保持 KV 长度有界（不超过一个提议块 B）。训练方面，提出并行 draft–verify–draft 流程：在记录的目标响应上随机采样锚点，无梯度地生成提议→冻结目标验证→获取拒绝状态与新锚点位置→有梯度地在偏移锚点处进行第二次草稿训练，所有锚点并行处理，保持跨位置并行。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Gemma 4 12B 两个目标模型、DFlash 和 Markov（DSpark 衍生的半自回归草稿器）两种草稿方案上，Carryover 在 8 个数据集上一致改进：平均接受长度提升 6.5–14.7%，端到端 vLLM 加速比提升 7.9–14.4%，翻译任务加速比增益高达 28.8%。吞吐量在并发 1–32 范围内也持续优于基线。消融实验表明回收目标隐藏状态优于回收 token 提示，单嵌入方案与独立投影器效果接近但更轻量。分析表明，Carryover 增益与"再收敛"（拒绝轨迹中预测与最终提交 token 一致的比例）高度相关（r=0.96），而非简单的拒绝状态数量或拒绝后接受率。

Conclusion: Carryover Drafting 通过一个简单机制——一个学习嵌入和单轮附加上下文——有效回收了推测解码中被浪费的目标隐藏状态，显著提升了草稿质量和推理速度。并行 draft–verify–draft 训练在保持训练并行性的同时使草稿器暴露于推理对齐的拒绝状态。该方法在不同草稿方案上具有普适性，且更强的草稿器（Markov）产生更多可回收的拒绝状态，暗示随着草稿器改进 Carryover 的收益可进一步增长。未来工作包括与置信调度、树形解码以及多轮回收的结合。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by verifying multiple drafted tokens in parallel, allowing a single target forward pass to accept several tokens. By construction, verification computes representations for both accepted and rejected tokens. Yet, conventional drafters retain only the representations of accepted tokens, leaving the substantial verifier computation spent on rejected tokens effectively wasted. We find that these discarded hidden states generated during target forward retain useful information about future tokens that can improve subsequent drafts. However, realizing this opportunity poses two distinct challenges. At inference, recycling overhead can increase drafting latency, diminishing the speedup gained from increased acceptance length. During training, standard parallel drafter training does not produce inference-aligned rejected states, while obtaining them through sequential rollouts would sacrifice parallelism across training positions. We introduce Carryover Drafting, which addresses both challenges. Carryover recycles rejected target hidden states as temporary KV context, allowing the drafter to selectively attend to them. It reuses the drafter's existing interface and adds only a single learned embedding to distinguish rejected states from committed context. The additional KV context is replaced each drafting round, keeping its length bounded by one proposal block. We introduce parallel draft--verify--draft training that exposes the drafter to inference-aligned rejected states while preserving parallelism across training positions. Experiments with DFlash and a DSpark-derived semi-autoregressive drafter across two target models show that this simple Carryover mechanism improves average acceptance length by 6.5--14.7% and end-to-end vLLM speedup by 7.9--14.4% over the corresponding baselines, with speedup gains reaching 28.8% on translation.

</details>


### [248] [OCT-FedSIR: Toward Trustworthy Federated Ophthalmic Learning under Annotation Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14734)
*Sina Gholami,Abdulmoneam Ali,Tania Haghighi,Rashadul H. Badhon,Behafarin Emam,Sally S. Y. Ong,Atalie C. Thompson,Theodore Leng,Ahmed Arafa,Jennifer I. Lim,Minhaj Nur Alam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OCT-FedSIR，一种面向眼科OCT图像联邦学习的可靠性感知频谱框架。该框架通过类别平衡频谱估计、Stage-I logit调整、互补频谱描述子和选择性频谱重标注技术，在客户端标签噪声与异构数据分布共存场景下区分标注错误与合法的临床异质性，并在三个眼科数据集（Kermany、UIC、WF）共117个实验条件下取得86.73%的平均准确率，显著优于RoFL和FedCorr等现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽然避免了患者数据集中化，但无法保证各参与机构标注的可靠性。在眼科影像中，合法的疾病患病率和类别组成差异可能与标注错误引起的特征变化相似，传统方法难以区分。此外，简单地剔除被识别为噪声的客户端可能丢失有价值的信息。需要一种能够区分标注相关干扰与合法临床异质性、并能恢复而非丢弃被污染标注的框架。

Method: OCT-FedSIR框架包含三个阶段：(1) 频谱客户端识别——通过类别平衡频谱估计、Stage-I logit调整以及三个互补的频谱描述子（均值μ_k、能量e_k、最大相似度s_k^max）构建客户端描述空间，利用双分量GMM区分干净与噪声客户端；(2) 选择性频谱重标注——基于干净客户端构建类特定的代表性子空间和残差子空间投影器，仅当两种子空间预测一致时才接受标签修改；(3) 噪声感知联邦优化——结合logit调整(LA)、知识蒸馏(KD)和距离感知聚合(DaAgg)进行训练。在三个数据集（Kermany多分类、UIC序数DR严重程度、WF二元GA分类）上，使用Dirichlet分布(α∈{2.0,0.5,0.1})模拟非IID异质性，对称和结构化非对称标签噪声(30%-90%)进行评估。

Result: 在117个实验条件下，OCT-FedSIR平均准确率达86.73%，超过RoFL(79.94%)和FedCorr(78.75%)约6.79和7.98个百分点。客户端识别方面，在所有数据集、噪声机制和异质性设置下达到100%的F1分数，而原始FedSIR在非对称噪声下F1降至68.5%-74.6%。样本级频谱重标注平均恢复77.2%的被污染标注，修正精度91.3%，误修正率仅3.5%。保留修正客户端比频谱剪枝策略平均高9.30个百分点。消融研究显示重标注组件贡献最大（去除后降低7.26个百分点），其次为KD(1.82)、LA(1.05)和DaAgg(0.52)。

Conclusion: OCT-FedSIR将标注可靠性确立为可信眼科联邦学习的重要考量，证明了通过频谱特征可以有效区分标注相关干扰与合法的临床异质性。框架能够恢复大部分被污染标注且对原始正确标签损害较小，保留并修正被识别为噪声的客户端优于直接丢弃。该研究强调标注可靠性与数据价值不应等同对待，但结果基于受控仿真场景，需在自然标注差异和真实多中心临床数据下进一步验证。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model development without centralizing patient data, but annotation reliability at participating institutions cannot always be assumed. In ophthalmic imaging, differences in disease prevalence and class composition can resemble changes caused by corrupted supervision. We introduce OCT-FedSIR, a reliability-aware spectral framework for federated OCT classification under client-dependent annotation noise and heterogeneous data distributions. OCT-FedSIR combines class-balanced spectral estimation, Stage-I logit adjustment, complementary spectral descriptors, selective spectral relabeling, and noise-aware federated optimization. We evaluated the framework on the Kermany, University of Illinois Chicago, and Wake Forest datasets under symmetric and structured asymmetric noise and three levels of non-IID heterogeneity. Across 117 experimental conditions, OCT-FedSIR achieved a mean accuracy of 86.73%, compared with 79.94% for RoFL and 78.75% for FedCorr. It correctly separated clients with original and corrupted annotations across all evaluated conditions, while the original FedSIR identification procedure was less robust, particularly under asymmetric noise. Spectral relabeling recovered 77.2% of corrupted annotations with 91.3% correction precision and a 3.5% false-correction rate. Retaining corrected clients outperformed spectral pruning by 9.30 percentage points on average. These findings show that annotation noise can often be identified and corrected without discarding informative client data.

</details>


### [249] [Calibrating Interpretability Instruments Before Trusting Their Verdicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14754)
*Orion Reblitz-Richardson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型因果可解释性研究中六类常见的"测量仪器失效"问题,提出了一套校准与验证协议。每种失效模式都能产生看似合理的数值而非明显错误,导致"坏仪器读数被误认为发现"。论文给出每种失效的识别信号(tell)、触发条件与修复协议,并汇总为四条核心原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果可解释性中的机制断言(如"拒绝方向由某头写入")完全依赖于投影、余弦、消融差值、互换补丁等测量。这些测量会以特定、可诊断的方式失败——不返回错误,而是返回一个看起来合理的数字。在massive-activation、reordered-norm、饱和读出等情形下,坏仪器极易伪装成研究发现。作者主张:任何机制性断言都必须先校准测量仪器本身。

Method: 本文是方法论说明,基于一个针对"拒绝(refusal)"与"道德表征"的因果可解释性项目,在四款开源模型(OLMo-3-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、GPT-OSS-20B)上识别出六类仪器失效,并为每类提供:
1) 失效复现:它最初如何伪装成发现;
2) tell(识别信号):一个可检测的触发条件;
3) protocol(协议):具体的修复步骤;
4) certifying check(验证检查):确认修复后的仪器给出稳定读数。
核心原则归纳为四条:正对照阶梯校准、正交单元证书、计算先于花费的统计功效、读出深度相对模型承诺层声明。

Result: 六类失效及对应协议如下:
1) **Band-below-null位置无效**:决策位点(如final_pre_assistant)的参与比(PR)极低(OLMo 14.7、Qwen 8.6、Llama 10.2、GPT-OSS 12.8),正对照带落在协方差匹配零分布之下,致使内容投影分数测试在该位置丧失判别力。协议:要求每个方向记录参与比,以零分布参考(列洗牌参考、样本秩上限、内容位置)而非绝对阈值为门控;改用决策方向余弦(对投影零分布免疫)。
2) **Massive-activation异常值的位置依赖性**:Llama 788维占32%残差方差,Qwen 458维占59%——但这是内容位置统计量;决策token位置实际上是干净的(PR约13)。协议:分别检查决策token与内容位置,不做跨位置假设。
3) **协方差匹配零分布在massive-activation家族中退化**:在Qwen/Llama上,投影零分布q95高达0.92(配对余弦q95 0.995),每个方向都投影得像典型方向。协议:在去除外形位置后按维度z-score重算,稳健变体逐维投影掉方差>5%的维度;以干净模型(如OLMo)在raw与标准化前后得出相同结论来验证。
4) **重排归一化(reordered-norm)架构的per-head OV归因过冲约3倍**:OLMo-2/3使用后置块RMSNorm,朴素逐头分解跳过块归一化,残差写重建值达3.05而非1.0。协议:检测post_feedforward_layernorm后将每层RMSNorm增益精确折入per-head归因(单元测试到1e-9);改用双向重建门(0.90≤recon≤1.10),单向地板会漏掉过冲。
5) **审议/预填充不对称统计被操作点混淆**:当一侧臂处于饱和天花板(如GPT-OSS的解除参与臂基线已拒绝0/7),统计量A=1.0的"零宽度CI"是退化的而非精确的。协议:若门是阶梯且边界带为空,改用分级干预(弱→强exculpatory预填充系列)并连续读出(决策通道残差在拒绝方向上的投影);分别报告行为翻转与分级读出。
6) **读出层深度伪影**:跨模型不对称在读层(第16层)A_Llama=+0.82看似Llama特有硬锁向,但Llama在第12层早已承诺(解参与在第8/12/14层连贯,在第16层不连贯)。协议:深度匹配跨模型比较到承诺前连贯层;在匹配层12处,A_Llama=-0.28、A_OLMo=-0.54,差异从+1.03坍缩至+0.26。
附加发现:作者对自身已发表论文执行冷启动复审,发现一项抽象级发现(原始σ*深层/浅层比为7-15×)在RMS归一化后坍缩为约1.8-2×,即激活尺度伪影。
样本量与覆盖限制:每种失效模式仅在一到两个模型上建立,非全部四模型;单研究项目、单模型面板,外部复制列为未来工作。

Conclusion: 本文将测量仪器失效的研究方法学提升为一类正式产出。核心结论是:因果可解释性的机制性断言必须先经过仪器校准,否则坏测量会被读成发现。具体落地的四条原则为:
(1) 用正对照阶梯校准仪器;
(2) 用正交单元证书验证;
(3) 花费计算资源前先计算统计功效;
(4) 每个读出判断都声明相对于模型承诺层的深度。
论文以可复用清单(九个"ship-blocker gates")、声明账本(claim ledger)、共享补充材料与Zenodo数据存放形式给出可执行协议,并强调该纪律来自单一研究项目,需在更多项目与任务上做外部复制。

Abstract: Causal claims about large language model (LLM) internals rest on measurements. Those might include a projection, a cosine, an ablation delta, or an interchange patch among others. These measurements fail in specific, diagnosable ways that return a plausible number instead of an error, so a broken instrument can easily read as a finding. A covariance-matched null can saturate until every direction looks typical, a per-head attribution can overshoot the true residual write threefold on reordered-normalization architectures, an interchange patch can go sign-chaotic because its outcome is pinned at a ceiling, or a read-from verdict can be an artifact of measuring past the layer where the model already decided. This note documents six such failures from a causal interpretability program on refusal and moral representation, spanning several papers and a four-model open-weight panel; each mode is established on one or two of the four. For each we give the tell that catches it and a protocol keyed to a detectable trigger (reordered normalization, massive activations, a low-dimensional decision channel), so we and readers can check whether a given setup is exposed. The discipline reduces to four moves: calibrate against a positive-control ladder, certify with an orthogonal cell, compute power before spending compute, and state every read-from verdict at a depth referenced to the model's commitment. The evidence is four architectures across three families within a single program; external replication across programs is future work.

</details>


### [250] [Refusal Reads Only a Slice of What the Model Knows: Harm-Keyed Routing and Its Exceptions Across Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14759)
*Orion Reblitz-Richardson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过机制可解释性方法研究大语言模型拒绝行为背后的表征基础，发现拒绝决策仅读取"伤害感知"（一个低秩切片），而非模型广泛的道德理解子空间，并跨四个开源模型（OLMo-3、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、GPT-OSS）揭示了"读取什么"与"如何承诺"两个可分离的轴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于解释一个已知的实证现象：通过对齐训练安装的拒绝行为可以被极低成本地移除（rank-one edit 即可消融）。现有研究（如 Arditi et al., 2024）证明了拒绝的脆弱性，但未回答"拒绝决策究竟在读取什么"这一机制性问题。本文要区分的是：模型理解了什么（comprehension） vs. 拒绝决策实际读取了什么（control），并探究后者的浅层性是否源于其读取范围的狭窄。

Method: 方法学包含五个层面的机制可解释性工具：（1）表征提取——在残差流中通过均值差方法提取道德子空间（三源正交化秩3）、拒绝方向、道德判断方向、伤害方向（基于 Zhao et al., 2025）；（2）校准测量协议——每次投影都对照协方差匹配零分布 q95 与 held-one-out 道德族带（积极对照）；（3）控制令牌瓶颈分析——通过参与比（participation ratio）在决策令牌处量化有效维度（4个模型均为8–15维）；（4）因果干预——以 OLMo-3 为核心模型进行 interchange patching（Meng et al., 2022）的嵌套秩扫描（k∈{1,3,8,16}），在 n=42 个请求双胞胎上对比限制转移系数 R_refusal(k) 与 R_judgment(k)；（5）跨模型面板——四模型架构对比，配以方向移除、预填充（prefill）可逆性测试与决策位点扫描。方法学上的严格性体现在：每个零分布都附带检测阈值，每个定量形容词都附带数字，所有判定均为预注册（pre-registered）。

Result: 核心结果包含六层结构化发现：（1）道德理解是预训练原生且跨越对齐存活——OLMo-3 的秩3道德子空间在预训练期间结晶至 checkpoint-to-final 余弦 0.999，对齐仅做单次刚性旋转（约40度）至 0.757 后保持不变；（2）拒绝门是后训练新构建——proto-refusal-to-gate 余弦仅 0.155（约为匹配零分布 q95 的两倍），占据最低方差通道（方差百分位 0.0）；（3）决策位点是控制令牌瓶颈——四个架构的有效维度为 8.6–14.7（OLMo 14.7、Qwen 8.6、Llama 10.2、GPT-OSS 12.8），导致基于投影分数的仪器在该位点失效（积极对照低于零分布）；（4）拒绝决策正交于道德判断——OLMo 余弦 0.10（零 q95 0.41）、Llama 0.08（零 0.51）、Qwen 0.32（零 0.42，依赖标准化）；（5）核心因果结果——嵌套秩扫描显示判断转移系数随 k 单调上升（0.05→0.46→0.59→0.66），而拒绝转移系数升至 k=3 后趋于平坦（0.03→0.27→0.22→0.24），单参数拟合 R_refusal(k) ≈ min(伤害天花板=0.25, R_judgment(k)) 的 RMSE 为 0.023，约76%的拒绝因果输入位于秩16道德基之外；（6）跨模型两轴结果——Llama 读取广泛道德内容（转移 0.85≈判断 0.79）并早期承诺（在第16层之前已固定）；GPT-OSS 读取伤害但作为可逆读者（指控预填充 7/7 翻转为拒绝，开脱预填充 6/10 翻转为合规）；Qwen 读取超出伤害秩1但 n=19 下判定未定。

Conclusion: 本文得出"浅层对齐"的具体机制：道德理解是预训练原生的宽广低秩子空间，对齐后被旋转一次而保持；而拒绝决策构建于其上，是一条新鲜的后训练窄门，读取秩1的伤害切片，约四分之三的因果输入位于道德基之外。这一几何结构解释了为何秩1编辑可干净移除拒绝——拒绝控制本身就不读取模型的道德理解。跨模型面板分离了两个可分离的维度："读取什么"（伤害 vs. 广泛道德内容）与"如何承诺"（读取层、早期、可逆），提出"拒绝读取的有效维度预测其可逆性"作为可证伪的待检验假说。GPT-OSS 作为存在性证明：审议性模型可读取伤害但仍可被推理论据说服拒绝，揭示了一种与反射式门控不同的、更具可审计性的安全属性形态。前瞻性方向：若将写入决策通道的注意力头扩展读取道德判断已读取的方向，则 R_refusal(k) 将跟随 R_judgment(k) 而非被伤害天花板截断——这是深化对齐的精准解剖学靶点。

Abstract: Alignment applied after pretraining is shallow in a measurable way: a single direction in a model's residual stream can be edited out, and the model stops refusing harmful requests. That fact says how easily refusal can be removed, not what the refusal decision was reading in the first place. We ask what it reads, and we separate that from what the model comprehends. Across four open-weight models spanning three families, moral comprehension is native to pretraining: a low-rank moral subspace crystallizes during pretraining, and alignment rotates it once without rebuilding it. The refusal gate, in contrast, is a fresh post-training construction with only a weak pretraining precursor, written into a narrow control-token channel where the refusal decision is orthogonal to the moral-judgment decision. The central result is causal and comes from one model, OLMo-3. A nested interchange rank sweep patches successively larger slices of the moral subspace between matched requests and reads how much of refusal's response transfers: as the basis widens, moral judgment keeps reading more of it, while refusal levels off at the level of a single harm direction, and about three-quarters of refusal's causal input lies outside the moral subspace altogether. Refusal reads the harm percept, not the moral content that judgment reads on the same patches. The picture is not uniform across families. Llama reads broad moral content; Qwen reads beyond the single harm cue but is unresolved at our sample size; GPT-OSS reads harm, and its refusals can be argued in either direction by its own reasoning trace. Where refusal reads only a low-rank slice and routes around the bulk of what the model knows, a rank-one edit removes it. Whether widening what refusal reads would also deepen the behavior is the open question this raises.

</details>


### [251] [Semantic Fibers and Cross-Gram Interference: A Calculus of Safety Drift in Overcomplete Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14861)
*Mohammed Ahnouch,Lotfi Elaachack*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将语言模型跨语言安全漂移（拒绝有害请求的英文提示却顺从其忠实翻译的现象）形式化为可审计的线性代数问题。它定义了语义纤维（semantic fibers）、写入器（writers）和读取器（readers）的框架，引入本征校准暴露度量 χ（由杠杆对偶 χ²=1/ℓ−1 支配），将观察到的漂移分为三种诊断上截然不同的机制：可通过重新校准消除的读取器故障、因病态而不可靠的精确修正、以及表征级碰撞（任何仅读取器干预都无法消除）。该框架还提出了无序交换恒等式作为因果接口诊断，并提供了两种闭式修复和理论极限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的语言模型可能在英文中拒绝有害请求，但顺从其忠实翻译——这种跨语言安全失败无法仅通过输出行为可靠地表征。现有的多语言红队测试和行为测量无法区分具有相同观察暴露但需要根本不同补救策略的机制。动机在于：(1) 将跨语言安全漂移转化为可审计的线性代数问题；(2) 区分"读取器问题"（可通过调整读取器解决）与"表征问题"（需要修改表征本身）；(3) 提供精确的诊断、修复和极限边界。

Method: 方法围绕六个核心组件展开：(1) 语义纤维——外部审计的等价关系，将同义但跨语言的提示分组；(2) 写入器 W 和读取器 R 的分解，其交叉 Gram 矩阵 C=R⊤W 测量方向性读/写串扰；(3) 漂移的精确线性代数刻画（同纤维漂移是纤维内对比的交叉 Gram 泛函，边界不变性是零化条件）；(4) 三种度量特定灵敏度常数（ρ_κ_σ）对应不同的威胁度量；(5) 本征校准暴露 χ_B 和不变读取器范数 ∥r_inv∥ 区分三种补救机制；(6) 无序交换恒等式（定理 8）作为线性控制接口的因果一致性测试。修复包括正则化最小方差读取器（命题 10）和最小变化投影（命题 11）。极限由定理 12 给出：列置换移动块暴露但固定 Gram 谱，读取器优化交叉串扰遵循锐利秩下界 n(n−r)/r。

Result: 核心结果包括：(1) 定理 6 的杠杆对偶 χ²=1/ℓ−1，将统计杠杆赋予操作性安全含义；(2) 命题 7 证明相同的当前暴露可对应完全相反的可修复性；(3) 无序交换残差在 8 个独立读/写系统上以中位 Spearman 0.964 预测三控制合成误差（对比静态交叉 Gram 基线的 0.269）；(4) 66 个独立旋转几何中，χ/ρ 预测残差漂移下界（Spearman 0.972），对数 ∥r_inv∥ 预测可用修复（Spearman 0.889）；(5) 真实多语言编码器上的审计进入病态机制——精确不变读取器范数 4.9 在测试纤维上提升 47% 漂移，而验证选择的 λ=3.16 正则化读取器在审计和非审计语言上分别降低 7% 和 13% 漂移。

Conclusion: 该论文提供了一个完整的审计工作流，可将跨语言安全漂移从黑盒行为观察转化为精确的几何诊断。结论强调：(1) 相同症状（高暴露）可对应三种截然不同的机制和补救策略；(2) 关键判据：低 χ 配合适度 ∥r_inv∥ 是读取器问题，高 χ 是表征问题，低 χ 配合大 ∥r_inv∥ 是病态问题；(3) 聚合量（水平、全局相干性）从不揭示块暴露的位置，必须直接测量；(4) 总交叉串扰有读取器优化无法逾越的秩下界；(5) 该框架适用于任何显式分数读取共享表征的场景，且其协方差形式已在一个真实多语言编码器上验证为病态机制。

Abstract: A deployed language model may refuse a harmful request in English yet comply with its faithful translation, revealing a cross-lingual safety failure that cannot be characterized reliably by output behavior alone. We formalize this phenomenon through an audited equivalence relation and show that, for a declared quotient, representation, metric, feature dictionary, scoring head, threshold, and contrast model, the resulting safety drift admits an exact linear-algebraic characterization. Specifically, the drift is a cross-Gram functional of the within-fiber contrast; its worst admissible value is a support function, while margin invariance is characterized by an annihilator condition. We introduce an intrinsic calibrated exposure measure, governed by the leverage duality $\chi^2=1/\ell-1$, which separates observed drift into three diagnostically distinct regimes: a reader fault removable by recalibration, an exact correction that is too ill-conditioned to be reliable, and a representation-level collision that no readout-only intervention can remove. Thus, identical observed exposure can lead to fundamentally different remediation verdicts. The framework also extends to cone-valued safety heads. An untied order-swap identity provides a diagnostic for the linear control interface; its calibration-state residual predicts a distinct three-control composition error on unseen states and targets, achieving median Spearman correlation $0.964$, compared with $0.269$ for a static cross-Gram baseline. etc.....

</details>


### [252] [Interpolation Is Not Invariance: Pair Count Is Not Coverage in Transformation Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14870)
*Mohammed Ahnouch,Lotfi Elaachak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统地揭示了变换不变性审计中"对数量≠覆盖率"的根本问题，将原始边数分解为四个具有独立作用的量，并据此提出基于轨道拓扑的审计与安全部署框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变换不变性审计（transformation audit）通常以"等价对数量（pair count）"作为覆盖率报告指标，但这一做法存在严重误导：来自同一语义对象的不同变换对高度相关，且完整轨道图中大部分边在代数上冗余。这导致名义上的大样本审计实际上对模型施加的约束远小于其表观规模，从而高估了审计强度、带来虚假的部署安全性。

Method: 论文将审计形式化为"每个语义对象一张图"的轨道图结构，分离出四个互补量：(1) 边数 m（仅反映计算/标注成本）；(2) 有效对比秩 s（独立审计对比维度，决定插值几何）；(3) 总体支持秩 r（未观测风险维度）；(4) 图谱间隙 η（轨道连通性/条件数，决定局部边漂移能否推广到整个轨道）。核心方法包括：(a) 在秩-r 高斯对比模型下推导秩感知有限样本定理（定理1），给出 s<r 时未观测风险服从 1/Beta((r−s)/2, s/2) 的逆Beta律；s≥r 时精确校准插值不可行。(b) 锐图Poincaré不等式（定理3）将边级漂移以 1/η 因子传递为轨道级证书。(c) 圈泄漏命题（命题4）揭示成对留一可在无任何语义对象被排除时报告零误差。(d) 精确块Woodbury留一轨道更新（命题5）与有限候选源分离部署门（定理6）。

Result: 合成实验（1000次审计，d=256，q=32）：树形、环形、完整图分别含31/32/496条边，但连通设计的有效秩均为31；最优风险比 U = R⋆/minR 严格服从 Beta((256−31)/2, 31/2)，理论与经验吻合（最小KS p=0.0286，经验均值比1.1362对理论1.1390），且树与完整图的零空间投影器最大差仅 2.0×10⁻¹⁵。冻结数字实验（5个种子，8×8光学数字，parity任务，16状态四比特变换）：在480对预算下，4-立方体图相对单位元检验的效用岭方法方向性减少全状态平方漂移 0.1880（95% 配对层次区间 [−0.2949, −0.0969]）；单位元检验 η=0（不连通），连接图均饱和轨道秩 q−1=15，但密集图减少可覆盖源数。机械验证：图关联矩阵秩与零空间等式误差 ≤2.0×10⁻¹⁵，块Woodbury与暴力重拟合相对误差 2.0×10⁻¹⁶。

Conclusion: 论文得出四点核心结论：(1) 应计数语义对象而非边；(2) 报告对比秩；(3) 连接轨道并报告谱间隙；(4) 整轨道留出，并在源级不确定性边界证明部署读出器在清洁效用预算内具有更低漂移时才替换。配数本身不能证明任何上述性质。算法贡献包括源分离部署门与精确块Woodbury更新，方法局限在于高斯假设、固定设计矩阵 A、不交换作用与多语/基础模型未涵盖。

Abstract: Counting equivalent pairs is a common way to report transformation-audit coverage, but it can substantially overstate the constraints imposed by an audit: pairs generated from the same semantic object are correlated, and complete orbit graphs contain algebraically redundant edges. We therefore distinguish four complementary quantities---edge count $m$, effective contrast rank $s$, population support rank $r$, and graph spectral gap $\eta$---and characterize their roles in audit coverage and deployment reliability. Under a rank-$r$ Gaussian contrast model, a population-invariant calibrated reader exists exactly when the anchor has a component in $\ker T$. When an audit has rank $s < r$, its unobserved risk is $R^\star/U$, with $U \sim \operatorname{Beta}((r-s)/2,s/2)$; when $s \ge r$, exact calibrated interpolation is infeasible. The same distinction appears in orbit topology: a spanning tree imposes the same exact-null constraints as a complete graph, while a sharp graph Poincare inequality propagates edge-level drift to an entire orbit at a cost proportional to $1/\eta$. Cyclic audits can additionally yield zero pair-level leave-one-out error without holding out any semantic object. To address these failures, we derive exact block-Woodbury leave-one-orbit-out updates and introduce a source-disjoint deployment gate over finitely many candidate readers. The gate retains the original reader unless uncertainty bounds certify lower drift within a prescribed clean-utility budget. etc..

</details>


### [253] [SeqMaestro: From nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses through interpretable machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14882)
*Evgeny S. Saveliev,Krzysztof Kacprzyk,Charlotte Capitanchik,Neelanjan Mukherjee,Kate Matlin,Ryan Sheridan,Srinivas Ramachandran,Jernej Ule,David L. Bentley,Mihaela van der Schaar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SeqMaestro是一个无代码机器学习框架，通过两层接口将核苷酸序列与可解释机器学习模型连接起来，以生成可检验的生物学假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统生物信息学方法灵活度有限，深度学习模型难以解释。SeqMaestro旨在弥合这一差距，使研究者无需深度编程或机器学习专业知识即可从核苷酸序列中提取可解释的预测性生物假设。

Method: 框架包含三层：(1) 数据集准备，将原始序列转化为二分类预测任务；(2) 模型拟合，使用稀疏线性模型、加性模型和决策树等可解释模型，结合三类特征表示（位置特征、模式特征如k-mer/基序、程序化特征），并采用one-shot、迭代式和联合式三种程序化特征生成策略；(3) 分析与合成，将模型缩减至10个特征，并通过三层可靠性评估面板（稳定性、关联性、必要性）评估发现特征的稳健性。系统还支持无代码工作流和AI代理驱动。

Result: 框架在四个生物学问题（多梳蛋白成核、RNA聚合酶II暂停、eIF4E依赖性、PTBP1外显子调控）上得到验证，能够恢复已知生物学知识（如CpG密度与多梳蛋白成核的关系、Kozak序列与翻译起始、PTBP1的CU基序结合机制），并提出新的可检验假设（如CpG密度阈值效应、eIF4E与密码子最优性的偶联、PTBP1共调控因子候选）。可解释模型的AUROC接近梯度提升树黑箱模型。

Conclusion: SeqMaestro将序列预测问题转化为对显式、可读生物假设的搜索，提供从核苷酸序列到可检验假设的通用路径。其核心贡献是构建了一个接口，使更广泛的可解释机器学习生态系统能够应用于核苷酸序列分析，其中特征表示、模型类别和提取策略均被视为假设搜索的一部分。

Abstract: Nucleotide sequence analysis is central to problems spanning regulatory genomics, evolutionary biology, and phenotype prediction. Classical bioinformatics methods extract interpretable sequence properties such as motifs and k-mer composition, but their flexibility is limited. In contrast, modern deep learning models can learn powerful predictive representations directly from raw sequences, yet their internal representations and decision mechanisms are difficult to inspect. Interpretable machine learning methods (e.g., sparse linear models and decision trees) provide human-understandable representations of predictive relationships but are not designed to operate directly on nucleotide sequences. Here, we introduce SeqMaestro, a machine learning framework that proposes biological hypotheses from nucleotide sequences using interpretable models. Our solution is centered around a two-layer interface that connects nucleotide sequences with the broader ecosystem of interpretable machine learning. SeqMaestro uses this interface to fit diverse combinations of interpretable models, feature representations, and extraction strategies, leveraging variability across transparent models to identify robust biological signals and richer predictive relationships than feature importance alone can provide. The system also supports data transformation and cleaning, model fitting, hyperparameter tuning, reliability analysis, and synthesis of results into a contextualized written report. By providing these capabilities through a no-code workflow, SeqMaestro is designed to make interpretable sequence analysis accessible to researchers without requiring extensive programming or machine learning expertise. SeqMaestro thereby provides an accessible route from nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses.

</details>


### [254] [Cross-Block Conditioning in Deep Boltzmann Machines for Statistical Data Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14934)
*Junichiro Niimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对统计数据融合场景（两个面板共享协变量但观察互斥的结果块）提出了OBMP（observed-block multi-prediction）训练准则，将多预测目标限制在每个样本真实观察到的维度上，使其在任意缺失模式下均有定义。该方法在两个消费者面板数据集（Instacart和Bank Marketing）上的35个网格单元、875次运行中均取得最优，但优势的主要来源不是生成式预训练，而是推理时跨结果块的条件化——这一贡献在所有单元中均为正且不随样本量增大而衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在统计数据融合中，传统设置下没有任何一行同时观察两个结果块，导致MP-DBM的多预测判别准则无法使用。论文希望：(1)提出一种在融合设置下仍有定义的判别训练准则；(2)借助该准则，量化联合模型（DBM）相较判别模型所提供的增益，并将其分解为"表示贡献"与"推理贡献"两部分，以判断联合模型是否必要。

Method: 提出OBMP准则：在每行引入条件掩码c_i与目标掩码t_i，要求二者不相交且目标必须在观察集合内，通过可微的均值场展开（固定T=10次迭代）在条件掩码下推断可见层边际，以行内归一化的二元交叉熵作为损失。融合场景下采用确定性划分：固定以X为条件、以观察到的结果块为目标。两阶段训练：阶段一以掩码感知边际似然（ML-DBM）进行生成式预训练，阶段二以OBMP在阶段一参数基础上微调。推理时区分跨块条件化（c=1_X+1_YB）与仅X条件化（c=1_X），二者之差即"跨块条件化贡献"。在两个数据集上对样本量n_train∈{500,…,10000}与公共块宽度k进行网格搜索，每单元5个种子，共875次运行，与15种方法比较。

Result: 在所有35个单元中微调后的OBMP均优于15种对比方法（含10种填充基线）。但生成式预训练的贡献极小：Instacart上平均仅+0.046pp，且仅在最小样本量（n_train=500）下显著（+0.193pp），Bank Marketing上几乎为零（-0.005pp）。跨块条件化贡献则普遍存在：Instacart上+0.188pp，Bank Marketing上+0.065pp，35个单元全部为正；该贡献不随n_train衰减（对数斜率≥0），不需第二隐藏层（RBM上同样存在且Instacart更大），也不需更多推理迭代（T=1即显著）。通过置换Y_B行破坏块间关联后，跨块项单调下降至零甚至微负（Spearman ρ=-0.93），而预训练贡献保持平稳。边际虽小（绝对值<0.4pp），但其不衰减的特性表明这是判别模型在结构上无法获得的信号。

Conclusion: 联合模型在数据融合中真正贡献的不是生成式预训练，而是推理时跨结果块条件化的能力。该贡献在小但非平凡，且因其所利用的证据形式（另一结果块的观察值）是任何映射X→Y的判别模型在结构上无法接受的，故不会随样本量或模型容量增大而消失。该增益受限于两结果块之间的实际关联；在第三个数据集（极窄伙伴块）上机制消失并转为微负——增益是有限的。本文将OBMP确立为多预测训练在任意缺失模式下的严格推广，为在融合设置下比较联合与判别模型提供了公平的脚手架。

Abstract: Statistical data fusion combines two panels that share a block of covariates but observe disjoint outcome blocks, and in its traditional form no row observes both outcomes at once. That rules out the discriminative criterion one would rather train a Deep Boltzmann Machine with, since multi-prediction training needs ground truth for whatever it holds out. We propose observed-block multi-prediction, which restricts the multi-prediction objective to targets drawn from what each row actually observes. It is well defined for any missingness pattern and reduces to the original criterion when rows are complete. Having a discriminative criterion that survives the setting lets us ask whether the joint model is needed at all, by separating what it contributes into a representation part and an inference part. On two consumer panels, on grids over sample size and covariate width spanning 35 cells and 875 runs, the fine-tuned DBM is the best of fifteen methods in every cell; but almost none of that advantage comes from generative pre-training, which is confined to the smallest sample size on one dataset and absent on the other. It comes from conditioning on one outcome block when predicting the other. This term amounts to +0.19 and +0.07 percentage points, is positive in all 35 cells, and, unlike every other contribution we measure, neither decays as the panels grow, nor requires a second hidden layer, nor requires more inference. Permuting one outcome block to destroy its association with the other removes the gain entirely, which is what the account predicts. The margins are small. But a small effect that does not decay is a different object from one that does, because it rests on evidence that no model mapping covariates to outcomes can accept.

</details>


### [255] [LiftGCN: Efficient Energy-Preserving Graph Learning via Joukowski Spectral Lifting for Finite Element Stress Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14977)
*Chen Zeng,Qiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LiftGCN，一种基于Joukowski谱提升的图卷积网络，专为有限元应力预测设计。该方法通过Joukowski变换将归一化图算子的实谱映射到单位圆，并实现为二阶线性递推，从而以O(ed)的传播复杂度（每次层仅需一次稀疏邻域聚合）保持单位模态的谱动力学，避免了矩阵指数和高阶多项式逼近。实验证明LiftGCN在整体精度与应力集中区局部重建之间取得了有竞争力的权衡，同时显著降低了计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限元应力场在孔洞、缺口和载荷区域附近表现出强烈的局部非光滑性，存在尖锐空间梯度和高频图分量。传统GNN的消息传递本质上具有平滑性，会逐步衰减高频信息；酉传播（unitary propagation）虽能保留谱幅值，但依赖矩阵函数和高阶近似，传播复杂度高达O(Ked)，难以应用于大规模有限元网格。核心动机在于：能否以普通消息传递的局部性和成本获得单位模态的谱动力学，从而同时保留应力场的整体分布和局部高频细节。

Method: 核心方法是Joukowski谱提升（Joukowski spectral lifting）：利用Joukowski变换J(z)=(z+z⁻¹)/2将归一化图算子的实特征值x=ρc·λj映射到单位圆上的一对共轭模态z±=x±i√(1-x²)=e^(±i·arccos x)。该映射的二次特征方程被实现为一个实值二阶线性递推：H̄_{l+1}=2ÃH_lR - H_{l-1}，其中R=diag(ρ_1,...,ρ_d)，ρ_c=ρ_max·tanh(θ_c)为可学习的通道级谱缩放系数（深度共享）。该递推的线性骨干具有单位模态的特征根，并在正定度量G_ρ下保持能量守恒——即∥Z_{l+1}∥²_{G_ρ}=∥Z_l∥²_{G_ρ}，其中二次能量由∥h_l∥²+∥h_{l-1}∥²-2ρ·h_lᵀÃh_{l-1}给出。架构方面，每个传播步骤后附加节点级残差非线性更新：H_{l+1}=H̄_{l+1}+α_l·GELU(LN(H̄_{l+1})W_l+b_l)，最后通过双状态读出[H_L, H_{L-1}]映射到节点应力。传播复杂度为O(ed)，仅需一次稀疏邻域聚合。

Result: 在Mines_Paris_Biaxial_Specimen数据集（100个有限元仿真）上，10次重复实验均值显示：LiftGCN (large, 16.4M参数) 在SNR (16.821 dB)、R² (0.89022) 和应力集中区指标上均优于UniGCN和CayleyNet等谱方法；峰值PSNR@1%达到22.201 dB（最佳），HSG-NMSE@1%降至0.053120（最佳）。在自建的Connecting Lug（225样本）和Elbow Bracket（288样本）数据集上，large版本LiftGCN同样在多数指标上领先——例如Elbow Bracket上SNR达24.019 dB，HSG-NMSE@1%降至0.038466，相对于CayleyNet延迟降低约3.25倍（12.714 ms vs 41.259 ms）。深度敏感性实验表明LiftGCN在更深时整体与局部指标均持续提升，而GCN趋于饱和。消融实验验证：移除Joukowski递推导致HSG-NMSE@1%从0.072548恶化至0.275960；固定ρ=0.9与完整模型接近；仅移除GELU使HSG-NMSE@1%升至0.120570；纯Joukowski（无非线性）性能最差（HSG-NMSE@1%=0.407700），证明Joukowski传播与局部非线性变换互补。

Conclusion: LiftGCN通过简单的实值二阶递推实现Joukowski谱提升，其线性骨干在正定度量下保持能量守恒，每层仅需一次稀疏邻域聚合。10次重复均值实验证明该设计在高效推理的同时实现了应力集中区与局部梯度的精确重建。模型能有效利用更多容量和深度，消融实验验证了提升传播与局部非线性变换的互补价值。这支持谱提升作为基于图的应力预测的高效基础。更广泛地，该方法将信息保持动力学与有限元网格的稀疏通信结构相连接，为在更大空间上下文中保留局部物理细节提供了可行路径。未来工作可推广至更广泛的几何形状、材料模型和物理预测任务。

Abstract: Finite element stress fields often exhibit strong local non-smoothness, where stress concentrations near holes, notches, and loading regions induce sharp spatial gradients and high-frequency graph components. Although graph neural networks naturally operate on irregular finite element meshes, conventional message passing is inherently smoothing and progressively attenuates such high-frequency information. Unitary propagation alleviates this problem by preserving spectral magnitudes, but typically relies on matrix functions and high-order approximations with $O(Ked)$ propagation complexity. We propose LiftGCN, an efficient spectrally stable graph network based on Joukowski spectral lifting. LiftGCN maps the real spectrum of a normalized graph operator onto the unit circle through the Joukowski relation and realizes the resulting spectral transformation as a simple second-order recurrence, avoiding matrix exponentials, eigendecomposition, and high-order polynomial truncation. We show that the linear Joukowski backbone has unit-modulus characteristic roots and admits an energy-preserving structure under a positive-definite metric, preventing exponential attenuation of graph-frequency components with depth. Each layer requires only one sparse neighborhood aggregation, yielding $O(ed)$ propagation complexity, while lightweight local nonlinear residuals provide expressive feature transformations. Experiments on finite element stress prediction demonstrate that LiftGCN achieves competitive overall accuracy while improving reconstruction of stress concentrations and local high-gradient structures with substantially reduced computational cost. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [256] [Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15029)
*Aashiq Muhamed,Mona T. Diab,Virginia Smith,Andrew Ilyas,Matthew Jagielski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了LLM后门投毒攻击中"毒集选择"这一被忽视的组合优化问题。研究表明，在固定模型、干净数据、毒样本数量的条件下，仅毒集的选择不同就可使攻击成功率从3%到80%不等，传统的随机或影响力函数基线严重低估了最坏情况下的脆弱性。作者提出SAILS方法（Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection），通过propose-score-audit框架学习集合级评分器，从数百次微调评估中训练，对数百万候选集排序，仅审计少量高质量候选集。在三个LLaMA-3-8B后门任务上，SAILS比最强影响力基线平均提升30个百分点，并可迁移到代码生成、智能体和仅API微调等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击评估固定毒样本数量后随机采样毒集，隐含假设毒集选择不重要。但研究表明相同条件下不同毒集的攻击成功率差异巨大（3%-80%），意味着仅随机评估会严重低估漏洞。攻击者只需精心选择毒集就能大幅提升攻击效果，而防御方因评估方法不当而低估风险。点式影响力代理（influence functions、TRAK等）假设单点效应可加，但毒样本间存在冗余或互补的集合交互效应，导致加性方法失败。

Method: 将毒集选择形式化为oracle预算约束下的集合优化问题。SAILS方法核心：(1) 用DistilBERT文本编码器+MLP回归头作为集合评分器，输入为按索引排序拼接的毒样本文本，输出预测的触发损失；(2) 初始用随机采样的数百个毒集及其oracle标签训练评分器；(3) 每轮提出N=50万候选k-元组，评分器快速打分，取top-m=10用ϵ-greedy策略审计（80%利用+20%探索）；(4) 将审计结果加入训练集重新训练评分器，实现迭代精炼。关键设计：评分器在文本上操作，无需白盒访问；用触发损失而非ASR作为训练目标（连续、方差更低）；审计小名单以缓解Goodhart效应。理论上通过Shortlist Regret定理证明短名单策略的近似最优性，并通过Proposition 3证明模块化top-k选择可任意次优。

Result: 在三个LLaMA-3-8B后门任务上：refusal/command/compliance的mini基准上SAILS达到72%/92%/67% ASR，比最强影响力基线TRAK+representer平均高+30pp，比oracle贪心构造在refusal和compliance上更优。匹配预算（B=1500）下比TRAK+representer高+21pp平均。mini到full的评分器迁移在full基准上比随机均值高+41pp，比TRAK贪心高+20pp。SmolLM上SAILS以1/18的oracle成本达到oracle引导RL 92%的效果。扩展到代码生成（67% ASR vs 随机47%）、WebShop智能体后门（91%）、Kimi-K2.5仅API微调（72%）。消融表明~500个oracle标签足够，触发损失优于ASR作为训练目标，Goodhart效应在池扩展时使TRAK从36%降至16%而SAILS从60%升至68%。跨模型迁移在6/9个目标模型上有效。

Conclusion: SAILS证明基于学习集合评分器的propose-score-audit框架在有限oracle预算下显著优于点式影响力代理，且可跨规模、领域和访问模式迁移。核心启示：仅用随机或影响力引导评估的防御测试远低于攻击者能力上限，指定攻击者优化预算对漏洞评估至关重要。集合评分优于点式归因适用于三个条件：目标存在强集合交互、oracle评估昂贵但数百次可行、内容特征预测集合级结果。局限包括单目标优化（未兼顾隐蔽性）、未对主动防御基准测试、未评估预训练投毒和RLHF投毒。

Abstract: Backdoor poisoning attacks add poisoned examples to otherwise-clean finetuning data, pairing a trigger with a target behavior that the model learns to produce when the trigger appears. Existing evaluations typically fix the number of poisoned examples and sample them at random from a candidate pool. We show that this can severely underestimate worst-case vulnerability: across three LLaMA-3-8B backdoor settings, holding the model, clean data, and poison count fixed, attack success ranges from 3% to 80% depending only on which poison set is chosen. We formalize poison selection as oracle-budgeted set optimization and introduce SAILS (Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection), which learns a set scorer from a few hundred finetune-and-evaluate runs, ranks millions of candidate sets, and audits only a small shortlist. SAILS improves held-out attack success by 30 percentage points on average over the strongest influence baselines, transfers from small-scale to full-scale finetuning, and extends to code-generation, agentic, and API-only backdoors.

</details>


### [257] [Ensemble Complexity in Photovoltaic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15049)
*Sun Ze,Zhou Liguo,Xu Yuqing,Yu Lei,Jiang Mingming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对光伏功率短期预测中集成学习的组件复杂度问题，通过匹配对比与消融实验评估各组件的增量贡献。在GEFCom2014及三个额外公开数据集上，研究发现静态融合在OPSD数据集上具有经多重比较校正后的统计支撑优势，但天气门控（weather gating）未呈现稳定增量效益；探索性成员移除揭示组级依赖与个体冗余并存；15分钟级成员替换案例以推理延迟为代价获得1.72%相对误差下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
