TL;DR: 本文提出"Bypass Observation"（旁路观察）架构——一种非侵入式的逐层语义读取架构，通过在选定 Transformer 层并行附加只读观测头（不影响主干计算），将 LLM 中间隐藏状态投影为词表分布或语义摘要。文章给出了封闭式计算开销公式 V/(12d)、典型模型 30%~240% 的开销估算、三种架构变体、bypass CoT 与常规 CoT 的因果差异、强化学习中的非对称角色，以及在循环 Transformer 中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在推理过程中仅暴露最终输出，中间数十至数百层的高维隐藏状态难以观测，导致：（1）难以回答模型在各阶段的具体计算内容；（2）潜在的欺骗性内部状态、幻觉或异常激活直到最终输出才可见；（3）仅依赖终端奖励的强化学习存在稀疏信用分配和语言奖励漏洞问题。现有可解释性方法（探针、Logit/Tuned Lens、SAE、CoT 忠实性研究）均存在结构性局限，未能提供持续性、可控性的逐层观测通道。

Method: 在 Transformer 主干推理路径之外，于各选定层并行附加只读观测头 O_ℓ，对隐藏状态 h_ℓ 进行解码。三种架构变体：(a) 跨层共享 LM 头，(b) 每层独立 LM 头，(c) k 自适应 LM 头（以层索引或推理步为条件）。定义三条公理——A1 非干扰（观测输出永不反馈回主干）、A2 参数共享（可选设计）、A3 条件读取。开销分析推导 ρ≈V/(12d)，并扩展为通用 GQA+SwiGLU 公式。提出五种降本策略：稀疏层观察、低秩分解、缩减语义词表、top-k 与关键位置采样、异步部署。针对循环 Transformer，提出迭代级收敛/振荡观测、潜在停机准则、差分观测 Δh_t。

Result: 理论分析得出：在标准近似下，全词表旁路读取每层额外开销约 V/(12d) MACs；代表性模型 GPT-3 175B ~+34%、Llama-2 7B ~+65%、Llama-2 70B ~+31%、Llama-3 8B ~+241%、Qwen2.5 7B ~+234%。推导了更一般的 GQA + FFN 精确公式。在解释性方面提出四个收益（P1-P4）与三条基本边界（L1 信息损失、L2 相关非因果、L3 "白箱幻觉"）；区分 bypass CoT（只读开环）与常规 CoT（闭环）的因果差异；分析 RL 中两种训练模式（冻结观测头 vs 联合训练）的奖励漏洞风险；提出保守训练协议七步流程。针对循环深度模型提出三种特殊观测价值（时空轨迹、潜在停机信号、迭代级审计），同时指出成本放大、时间步校准必要性及反馈风险。

Conclusion: Bypass Observation 是概念与分析性提案，未进行系统实证。主要结论：(1) 全词表逐层读取开销约 30%~240%，可通过稀疏/低秩/缩减词表等策略优化；(2) 架构将黑箱推向"半透明"，但仍为有损投影，面临"白箱幻觉"风险；(3) bypass CoT 在推理时为开环只读，但仍可作为 RL 监督信号，需警惕观测头博弈；(4) 循环 Transformer 是特别适用的场景，可暴露收敛轨迹并支持停机决策。论文明确指出现有局限：无自证忠实性、对抗脆弱性、始终开启部署成本过高、缺乏实证工作。

Abstract: Large language models reason in high-dimensional hidden-state spaces, while users observe only final outputs. We introduce Bypass Observation, a non-intrusive layer-wise readout architecture that attaches read-only observation heads to selected Transformer layers without feeding their outputs back into the backbone. We consider three variants: a shared LM head across layers, layer-specific heads, and a layer- or step-adaptive head. For full-vocabulary readout, we derive a closed-form overhead approximation governed primarily by V/(12d), with representative estimates ranging from about 30% to 240%, and discuss cost reductions via sparse observation, low-rank factorization, reduced vocabularies, top-k readout, and selective positions. We argue that Bypass Observation can make model computation more observable while remaining only a partial, potentially misleading projection of hidden states. We further distinguish bypass chain-of-thought from conventional chain-of-thought: conventional reasoning tokens enter the autoregressive computation, whereas bypass readouts remain causally external at inference time, although they can still provide training signals in reinforcement learning. Finally, we discuss applications to looped and recurrent-depth Transformers, where iteration-wise readout may expose convergence, oscillation, and potential halting signals. The proposal is conceptual and analytical; systematic empirical validation remains future work.

</details>


### [483] [ViperQ: Order Flow Pattern Recognition via Auction Market Theory for Reinforcement Learning Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13825)
*Asser Moustafa,Rares-Mihail Neagu,Jugal Kalita*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ViperQ，首个将拍卖市场理论（AMT）特征作为显式状态表示的同行评审强化学习交易系统。该系统使用20维状态向量结合PPO算法，在TSLA和NVDA上取得了显著的超额收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL交易系统多依赖价格聚合特征（OHLCV）或限价订单簿深度特征，而从业者广泛使用的拍卖市场理论（AMT）和市场轮廓（Market Profile）等微观结构模式理论缺乏同行评审的计算实现，存在方法论空白。

Method: 1. 状态表示：构建20维Z标准化状态向量，包含三个模块：A块（AMT/微观结构模式：VPOC、价值区域位置、LVN标志、CVD背离、tape速度等9维）；B块（动态仓位状态：未实现PnL、持仓时间2维）；C块（9个滞后对数收益率）。2. 算法：使用PPO算法，配置为双智能体（TSLA高频剥头皮策略、NVDA趋势跟随保守策略）。3. 奖励函数：基于前景理论的非对称奖励（损失规避系数λ≈2.25），包含6个组成部分：已实现PnL、非对称未实现PnL塑形、趋势奖励、时间衰减、止损、回撤冲击。4. 风险控制层：波动率调整仓位、日损限制、单笔止损、收盘前平仓等断路器。

Result: 在严格保留的12个月测试集上（零杠杆，含监管费用）：TSLA实现+163.6% ROI（最大回撤-27.5%，27,019笔交易）；NVDA实现+116.5% ROI（最大回撤-47.8%，12,892笔交易）。这些结果显著高于Pippas等人调查的167篇RL金融论文中[5%, 40%]的典型ROI范围。

Conclusion: 研究表明，AMT微观结构先验作为RL状态表示具有以下优势：(i)样本效率高；(ii)可解释性强；(iii)经过三十年实盘检验的特征筛选；(iv)跨奖励泛化能力（同一状态向量支持两种不同盈利策略）。未来工作包括：正式的奖励组件敏感性分析、更广泛的资产范围、以及将AMT状态表示迁移到其他策略类别。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning trading systems published in the academic literature overwhelmingly rely on price-aggregate state representations (OHLCV bars) or limit-order-book depth features, leaving microstructure pattern theories from the practitioner literature, namely Auction Market Theory and Market Profile, without a peer-reviewed computational instantiation. We present ViperQ, a reinforcement learning system whose state representation is built explicitly from Auction Market Theory primitives: Volume Point of Control, Value Area position, Low Volume Node flags, Cumulative Volume Delta divergence, and tape-velocity signatures, assembled into a 20-dimensional Z-normalised vector. Two Proximal Policy Optimisation agents are trained with a prospect theory-grounded asymmetric reward function that penalises losing holds at a magnitude consistent with Kahneman and Tversky's loss-aversion coefficient. Evaluated on a held-out twelve-month partition of institutional tick data the agents have never seen, ViperQ achieves +163.6% ROI on TSLA (-27.5% max drawdown, 27,019 trades) and +116.5% ROI on NVDA (-47.8% max drawdown, 12,892 trades) under zero leverage. The results establish Auction Market Theory features as a tractable structured input modality for sequential decision-making on financial time series and motivate further work on microstructure-aware policy learning.

</details>


### [484] [UniCAR-RL: Seeing Better before Thinking Deeper in Visual Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13849)
*Yuzhe Li,Hao Yan,Hao Wang,Xingchen Liu,Ya-Qi Yu,Jihao Wu,Minghui Liao,Wei Chen,Yuliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCAR-RL，一个无需标注数据的强化学习框架，通过解耦视觉感知与逻辑推理的优化过程，解决多模态大语言模型在视觉数学推理中因细粒度感知不足而导致的级联推理失败问题。该框架包含三个协同分支：Caption-RL（纯视觉描述优化）、Reasoning-RL（基于黄金描述的纯逻辑推理）、QA-RL（端到端问答对齐），在多个数学基准和通用视觉任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在复杂视觉数学推理任务中表现不佳，核心瓶颈并非逻辑推理能力不足，而是缺乏细粒度的视觉感知能力。模型在处理复杂数学图形时容易误读关键视觉细节（如刻度值、几何标记），导致后续推理建立在错误的视觉前提上，造成级联失败。现有方法存在两方面问题：（1）依赖专家标注的感知增强 CoT 数据蒸馏，成本高且受限于教师模型的幻觉；（2）传统端到端 RL 的稀疏奖励无法区分感知错误与逻辑错误，导致感知优化效率低下。

Method: UniCAR-RL 采用三个共享策略参数 θ 的协同分支，通过统一 GRPO 目标联合优化：

1. **Caption-RL 分支**：模型仅基于图像生成 G 条图像描述（不输入问题），由纯文本代理求解器 𝒱 评估每条描述是否足以推导出正确答案，将评估结果作为感知奖励 r^cap。这种"信息抑制"设计迫使模型进行整体性、无偏见的视觉描述，将主观的感知评估转化为基于任务效用的二元信号。

2. **Reasoning-RL 分支**：选取 Caption-RL 中奖励最高的描述作为"黄金描述" c*，模型在仅给定 c*、问题 q 和提示的条件下进行纯文本推理。视觉被完全屏蔽，推理错误无法归因于感知失败，从而实现纯净的逻辑优化。该分支还形成自然课程学习——感知越强，黄金描述越丰富，推理难度越大。

3. **QA-RL 分支**：标准的端到端问答训练（图像+问题→答案），保持模型在测试场景下的原生能力。

三个分支的奖励在各自 rollout 组内独立进行优势归一化，通过单一反向传播联合更新：θ ← θ + η∇_θ(J_cap + J_rsn + J_qa)。这种"局部解耦、全局协同进化"的范式是 UniCAR-RL 的核心特征。

Result: **主要数学推理基准（平均分）**：
- Qwen2.5-VL-3B：42.9 → 52.2（+9.3）
- Qwen2.5-VL-7B：48.3 → 58.2（+9.9）
- Qwen3-VL-4B：61.5 → 65.9（+4.4）
- Qwen3-VL-8B：67.8 → 70.0（+2.2）

在 7B 规模上达到开源模型最优（58.2 vs. 前最佳 Perception-R1-7B 的 57.2），在 3B 上优于 Shuffle-R1（49.9）、PAPO（49.6）、MMR1（47.2）等强基线。8B 配置的 UniCAR-RL 在 WeMath（82.5）和 MathVerse（63.4）上甚至超越 GPT-4o（68.8/50.2）和 Claude-3.7-Sonnet（72.6/52.0）。

**视觉感知评估**：描述质量使统一验证器的解题准确率从 71.4% 提升至 75.9%（+4.5），远超标准 GRPO 的 +1.4。

**通用视觉任务**：ChartQA +6.5、HallusionBench +1.8、V*Bench +2.1、HR-Bench 8K +2.8，表明增强的细粒度感知可迁移到数学以外的多种任务。

**消融实验**：任一分支缺失均导致性能下降；三个分支全部协同贡献 +3.1% 增益（vs. 仅 GRPO 的 +1.3%）。验证器能力有边际影响但非关键（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Gemini 3 Pro 差距较小）。

**训练效率**：单次迭代耗时约为 vanilla GRPO 的 3.75×，但所需迭代步数减少（约 70 vs. 150），整体训练时间约 1.75×。

Conclusion: UniCAR-RL 通过将感知与推理的优化解耦为三个协同分支，在无需任何人工标注或教师蒸馏的前提下，有效打破了 MLLMs 在视觉数学推理中的感知瓶颈。该方法仅依赖原始简答题数据即可同时增强感知与推理能力，并在不同架构（Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL）和不同规模（3B/4B/7B/8B）上均展现出一致且显著的泛化能力。其增强的细粒度感知能力可自然迁移至 ChartQA、HallusionBench、V*Bench、HR-Bench 等通用视觉任务，验证了"先看清，再深思"这一核心洞察的广泛适用性。局限性在于训练成本约为 vanilla GRPO 的 1.75×，且主要在数学及有限通用视觉任务上验证。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical visual reasoning primarily due to a lack of fine-grained perception, causing initial visual hallucinations to directly trigger cascading reasoning failures. In traditional end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL), sparse rewards fail to decouple perceptual hallucinations from logical missteps, hindering targeted perception optimization. Alternatively, fine-tuning with perception-enhanced CoT data incurs high costs and hallucinations. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing UniCAR-RL, an annotation-free RL framework. By explicitly decoupling the optimization of perception and reasoning during the training process, it achieves isolation and optimization of both capabilities. Specifically, UniCAR-RL consists of three synergistic branches: 1) a Caption-RL branch that optimizes perception capabilities through verifier-guided reasoning validation; 2) a Reasoning-RL branch that performs logical reasoning based on a gold image description to halt cascading errors; 3) a QA-RL branch that retains native end-to-end alignment to ensure robust question-answering performance. Experiments show that UniCAR-RL substantially improves MLLMs' mathematical and visual reasoning using only raw short-answer data. Furthermore, it demonstrates strong generalization across diverse architectures and scales.

</details>


### [485] [ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13860)
*Antonino Vaccarella,Riccardo Cantini,Domenico Talia,Paolo Trunfio,Marianna Talia,Rosamaria Lappano,Marcello Maggiolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClinAgent是一个基于ReAct范式的智能体RAG系统，允许临床医生和研究人员通过自然语言对话查询临床试验信息，集成了ClinicalTrials.gov搜索、PubMed检索和Python分析三种工具，并对比评估了三种LLM后端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验注册库的查询仍依赖手工操作，效率低且易出错；现有LLM存在幻觉问题，标准RAG又无法处理多源信息合成和迭代优化，因此需要一种支持自然语言交互、跨源整合的智能体方法。

Method: 基于ReAct范式构建LLM智能体，通过推理-行动-观察循环动态选择三种工具：ClinicalTrials.gov API搜索（LLM提取结构化参数并Pydantic验证）、Python REPL（Pandas分析本地缓存数据）和PubMed（NCBI Entrez API）。使用LangChain和LangGraph实现，支持MemorySaver多轮对话状态持久化。

Result: 三阶段评估显示：Gemini 3.0 Flash目标达成率1.00，综合得分0.80最高；DeepSeek V3.2（thinking模式）规划质量最优（0.97）但事实性较差（0.28）；DeepSeek V3.2非思考模式在清晰度和完整性上表现良好但相关性较低（0.45）。Gemini在工具使用效率（0.56）和专家评分上均领先。

Conclusion: 智能体RAG是临床试验信息检索的可行方案；后端选择需权衡推理深度与事实可靠性，Gemini 3.0 Flash为推荐部署选择，DeepSeek思考模式在多步规划上有优势但牺牲了事实准确性；未来工作将扩展至监管数据库和电子健康记录等额外数据源。

Abstract: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. To address this, we introduce ClinAgent, a conversational system based on agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that enables clinicians and researchers to query clinical trial information in plain language and receive grounded, up-to-date responses across multi-turn interactions. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a this http URL search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). Results reveal complementary strengths, with DeepSeek (thinking mode) excelling in planning quality, while Gemini achieves the highest overall performance and strongest expert ratings. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of agentic AI systems to improve the accessibility and synthesis of clinical trial information, supporting more efficient and user-centered biomedical research workflows.

</details>


### [486] [Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13879)
*Yiling Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个五部分的归因表（attribution table），用于精确界定从"获取性表征"（acquired representation）所能合理归属的认知能力范围及其边界。核心论点是：完整的应用能力（application competence）并不能逻辑蕴涵获取能力（acquisition capacity），即"使用地图者"无需具备"制作地图者"的能力。该框架被应用于评估Andrew Ng对Othello-GPT的"世界模型"解读以及Beckmann与Queloz关于机器概念的具体指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于大语言模型是否"理解世界"、"拥有概念"的讨论中，存在一种倾向：将一个被证实有效的表征所支持的应用能力，错误地扩展到该表征的获取能力上（即从产品推断生产者能力）。例如，Othello-GPT被证明能有效表示棋盘状态并预测合法走法，但Ng将此解读为LLM"构建世界模型"乃至"理解世界"，这一跳跃需要精确的逻辑审查。本文旨在提供这样一个精确的工具。

Method: 1. **论证策略**：先承认最强的表征成就（有意义内容、因果有效性、可推广推理），再考察获取能力的归属边界。2. **概念区分**：区分"应用"（application，从已有表征推理）与"获取"（acquisition，从证据获得新表征）；区分"从规范获取"（acquisition from specifications）与"从观察获取"（acquisition from observations）；区分"观察学习"与"自主信息选择"；区分"情节内获取"与"保留与复用"。3. **形式化构造**：使用有限集上的映射和计算过程，构建形式化反例（命题A1、A2及其推论），逻辑证明应用能力与获取能力可分离。4. **思想实验**：以"地图使用者vs制图者"和"六准则范畴家族"为核心案例。5. **具体应用**：将框架逐行映射到Ng的Othello-GPT解读、Templeton等人关于金门大桥特征的研究、Nanda等人的模加法电路研究、ARC任务的程序合成等具体案例。

Result: 1. **核心反例**：两个系统可共享完全相同的表征和完全的应用解释器，在关于该表征的所有应用查询上答案一致，却对从新证据获取表征具有完全不同的能力。穷尽所有应用测试无法区分二者的获取能力。2. **五部分归因表**：第一行（因果有效的跨情境追踪→识别与同追踪，但获取新区分需要额外支持）；第二行（操作性的准则/结构评估器→域内分类与推理，但发现该准则/结构需额外支持）；第三行（从完整规范重复获取→规范提供条件下的获取与应用，但无规范从样例获取需额外支持）；第四行（从识别性观察重复获取→观察条件下的获取，但选择信息性观察需额外支持）；第五行（经证实的中断后保留与复用→该条件下的保留复用，但更持久积累需额外支持）。3. **对Othello-GPT评估**：干预证据支持应用层面的归因（第二行），但未确立部署的检查点能否从样例推断新游戏规则。4. **对ARC评估**：成功的程序合成提供第四行的正面证据，但限于被评估的完整系统而非孤立的模型组件，且不确立自主信息选择或跨情节保留。

Conclusion: 从获取性表征进行的认知归因是条件性的、多维度的，而非一个统一的"理解"或"概念拥有"标签。论文确认了已被证实的应用与推理能力，同时精确指出了哪些获取能力的归属需要额外的证据桥梁。该框架不解决"概念拥有的构成条件"这一独立问题，而是为已有证据所支持的归属范围提供精确规范。这避免了通过"表征"或"世界模型"等标签无声地导入比证据所支持的更广泛的认知能力库。

Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring additional support. The argument deliberately grants meaningful content, causal efficacy, and productive inference, so that its conclusion does not depend on treating representations as inert encodings. Map and category examples show why even complete application competence leaves acquisition capacity undetermined, and why acquiring a criterion from its description differs from finding it in examples. Short formal proofs appear in an appendix. The framework is applied to Andrew Ng's world-model interpretation of Othello-GPT and to the specific indicators discussed in contemporary accounts of machine concepts. It preserves demonstrated recognition, classification, inference, and qualified acquisition while specifying what remains unestablished about criterion discovery and accumulation. The result concerns the scope of cognitive attribution rather than the constitutive conditions of concept possession: cognitive achievements deserve credit for the capacities they establish, without silently importing a broader repertoire through the labels attached to them.

</details>


### [487] [LoRA Fine-Tuned Models for Control Systems Course Q\&A: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Model Scale and Rank Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13918)
*Shaowen Lu,Chengxu Liu,Ping Zhou,Tao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究针对控制理论课程问答场景，系统比较了不同模型规模（3B vs 7B）与不同 LoRA 秩（r=4/8/16）对课程参考答案相似度和结构化教学输出稳定性的联合影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业课程（尤其是依赖数学推导的控制理论）对回答的术语、符号、推导步骤和教学组织有严格要求。通用大语言模型的输出难以稳定对齐课程参考答案格式，而现有 LoRA 教育应用研究多将其视为固定工具，缺乏对模型规模与 LoRA 秩联合效应的系统考察。

Method: 基于《线性控制系统》课程习题与参考答案，构建 360 条 system-user-assistant 三轮对话结构化数据集（Solution-Method-Teaching Points 三级结构），采用分层随机划分（270/36/54）。对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 分别以 LoRA 秩 r=4、8、16 在 q/k/v/o_proj 上进行 SFT，统一超参与随机种子。用 ROUGE-1/2/L、BERTScore-F1（bert-base-uncased）和 has_solution/method/teaching_points 结构化特征进行测试集评估，并通过 10,000 次配对 Bootstrap 估计 95% 置信区间。

Result: LoRA 在两种规模上均提升了参考答案相似度与结构化输出稳定性；7B-r16 取得最高 ROUGE-L（0.4093）与 BERTScore-F1（0.8643）；r=8 提供性能与参数效率的较优平衡；3B-r16 的 ROUGE-L 增益为 0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915]，7B-r16 为 0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042]，置信区间均不跨零；Solution/Method 覆盖率从接近 0 提升至 1.00，Teaching Points 在 7B 上从 0.56 提升至 0.96；增大 LoRA 秩带来绝对增益但单位参数边际收益递减。

Conclusion: LoRA 能在小数据与有限算力条件下将开源指令模型对齐到课程的语言与教学组织风格，但所采用的指标主要衡量文本相似度与格式稳定性，并未直接评估领域推理与数学正确性，仍需专家评审与任务专用评分量表进行补充验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in specialized university courses, but control-systems questions require coordinated terminology, notation, derivations, and stepwise explanations. Direct general-purpose responses may be inconsistently structured and hard to verify. Using exercises and reference solutions from a Linear Control Systems course, we built a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 360 system-user-assistant conversations. We applied LoRA to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. With identical data splits, inference settings, and evaluation protocols, we compared base and fine-tuned models and tested LoRA ranks r=4, 8, and 16. Evaluation used ROUGE, BERTScore, and structured-output features to measure reference-answer similarity and stability of the Solution-Method-Teaching Points format. LoRA improved both similarity and structured-output stability at both sizes. On the current test set, 7B-r16 achieved the highest ROUGE-L (0.4093) and BERTScore-F1 (0.8643), while r=8 offered a better balance between performance and parameter efficiency. Bootstrap resampling showed ROUGE-L gains of 0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915] for 3B-r16 and 0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042] for 7B-r16; both intervals exceeded zero, indicating stable textual-similarity improvements on the current test set. These results suggest LoRA can align open-source instruction-tuned models more closely with the language and pedagogical organization of course reference answers. However, the metrics mainly capture textual similarity and formatting consistency, not domain-specific reasoning or mathematical correctness, which require expert assessment and task-specific rubrics.

</details>


### [488] [SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13945)
*Shaghayegh Sadeghi,Stephen L. Smith,David C. Del Rey Fern'andez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAILOR是一个概念验证系统，用于在自然语言描述的不完整优化问题中检测LLM翻译时引入的未支持的数值（如成本、容量、需求、边界、惩罚），通过有针对性的追问来恢复缺失的关键参数。它结合不确定性（高斯信念模型）和求解器衍生的参数重要性来优先排序问题，并在每次回答后通过AST编辑重写生成的代码并重新求解。在七个基准测试共1,723个实例上的评估表明，在理想化模拟器下，目标值一致性从27.0%到87.6%不等，平均每个实例1.4-5.7个问题。但消融实验表明，翻译模型的选择对结果的影响远大于问题优先级策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自然语言到优化模型的转换系统通常假设输入已包含所有必要数值，但普通用户往往不知道哪些数值是必须的，常遗漏关键参数（如加班成本、产能、未满足需求的惩罚）。LLM在遇到缺失值时要么停止、要么猜一个默认值，这可能导致生成的代码可执行但解决的却是不同的问题。因此需要一种交互式的数值补全机制，让系统在建模过程中主动发现并询问关键的缺失信息。

Method: SAILOR的工作流程为：(1) LLM初始化翻译——将自然语言描述转换为可执行的Gurobi代码，并记录所有引入的数值；(2) AST参数识别——通过抽象语法树解析将字面量分为"已知"（文本中出现）和"猜测"（LLM补充）；(3) 高斯信念模型——对每个未解析参数建立均值=LLM初值、方差与范围成比例的截断高斯先验，定义三种更新操作（精确更新、二进制更新、软更新）；(4) 求解器重要性评分——通过对每个参数在信念范围内扰动并重新求解，组合目标值摆动、有限差分梯度、影子价格幅值、约束绑定变化四个分量（权重0.40, 0.30, 0.15, 0.15）得到重要性分数；(5) 问题生成与评分——生成直接问、二分范围问、确认问三种候选问题，按信息增益ΔH与重要性缩放因子g(s_i)的乘积评分，使用g(s_i)=α+(1-α)s_i，α=0.5；(6) 答案处理与代码重写——通过AST编辑更新字面量、重新求解、重新计算重要性、可选的LLM精化；(7) 停止准则——所有参数后验标准差<10⁻⁸、总熵<-40、连续5轮无进展、或预算用尽（K=30）。

Result: 在七个基准（NL4OPT、NL4LP、ReSocratic、EasyLP、ComplexLP、IndustryOR、ComplexOR）共1,723个实例上，使用GPT-5.2做掩码、GPT-5.3-Codex做恢复翻译：精确目标值一致性范围27.0%（ComplexLP）到87.6%（NL4LP），平均每个实例1.4-5.7个问题；所有数据集上交互式配置均优于无交互基线。消融实验显示：(a) 移除求解器重要性评分后宏平均仅从66.4%变为66.1%，无明确收益（故发布的默认设置禁用了它）；(b) 移除精化步骤宏平均从66.4%变为64.2%，效应混合；(c) 先验范围和预算消融效应不一致且较小；(d) 翻译模型换为GPT-4o-mini导致NL4LP从87.6%降至44.4%、IndustryOR从64.3%降至9.5%，是最大的影响源。基准构建采用扰动分析×{0.5, 0.8, 1.2, 2.0}来选择掩码参数，但这与恢复时的重要性评分存在循环依赖。

Conclusion: SAILOR在受控的理想化模拟器下展示了交互式优化建模恢复的可行性：目标值一致性在所有数据集上均优于初始猜测基线。然而，消融实验将瓶颈定位在翻译质量而非问题排序策略上：翻译模型更换带来的影响（27.8-54.8个百分点）远大于任何问题优先级消融的影响。主要局限包括：(1) 模拟器提供的是确定性、精确的"分支并揭示"反馈，不反映人类用户行为；(2) 重要性评分与基准掩码标准存在循环；(3) 高斯信念模型不适合负值、零值或整数值参数；(4) 交互无法修复翻译错误的结构性问题；(5) 未在完整输入与交互输入之间做严格隔离的比较。未来的工作应评估真实用户、模糊或区间回答、独立的字面量/目标值/可行性指标，并解耦问题排序与答案价值。

Abstract: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [489] [Synthetic Data in Marketing Research: How to Evaluate and When to Trust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13995)
*Oded Netzer,Rajan Sambandam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对营销研究中合成数据（尤其是基于LLM的数字孪生）的有效性争议，提出应从"是否有效"转向"何时有效"的核心问题。文章区分了三类合成数据，构建了四类准确性度量分类法，并提出"被遗忘问题"场景下的事前可答性诊断方法，通过R²筛查显著提升数字孪生与人类响应的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前营销研究领域对LLM生成合成数据的态度两极分化：一方认为LLM可取代人类受访者，另一方则主张完全回避。作者认为这种争论遮蔽了更有价值的问题——合成数据在何种条件下有效——因此需要系统性地厘清合成数据的类型、准确性度量方法以及适用场景。

Method: 1. 概念框架：区分三类合成数据（无依据LLM响应、分群级persona、个体级数字孪生），并将其映射到不同决策场景。
2. 测量分类法：构建四类准确性度量家族（聚合计量、相关性度量、分布度量、判别度量），分析不同度量导致结果差异的原因。
3. 诊断方法：提出"被遗忘问题"（forgotten question）作为数字孪生数据增强的应用场景。
4. 事前诊断工具：基于随机森林R²的事前可答性诊断——无需真实答案，仅通过孪生构建数据预测孪生输出的R²来筛查问题。
5. 实证检验：在全国代表性调查（N=3,063）的108个态度问题上验证诊断方法，比较R²筛查与嵌入相似度、专家判断的效果。

Result: 1. 聚合计量即使在向LLM提供极少信息的情况下也表现良好，可能掩盖受访者级别差异的完全缺失。
2. R²高于0.7的筛查标准使孪生-人类个体级相关性均值提升15%，将回答不佳问题的比例从25.9%降至4.3%。
3. 嵌入相似度和有经验研究者判断作为筛查工具与R²相关但效果较弱。
4. 准确性度量的广泛差异主要反映测量对象不同而非方法质量差异。

Conclusion: 合成数字孪生的价值高度依赖于具体问题与构建数据的匹配程度。事前可答性诊断（R²筛查）能够在没有真实答案的情况下有效识别孪生可可靠回答的问题，为合成数据在营销研究中的条件性应用提供了实用框架。营销研究者应放弃"是否使用"的二元争论，转而关注"何时使用"以及如何选择合适的合成数据类型和准确性度量。

Abstract: Debate over synthetic data in marketing research has polarized between claims that large language models (LLMs) make human respondents obsolete and calls to avoid them entirely. We argue that both positions obscure the more useful question: not whether synthetic respondents work, but when. Building on Brand, Israeli, and Ngwe (2026), we make three contributions. First, we distinguish three types of synthetic data (ungrounded LLM responses, segment-level personas, and individual-level digital twins) and map each to the decisions it can support. Second, we develop a taxonomy of four families of accuracy measures and suggest that the wide range of reported twin accuracy, from near-perfect to near-chance, largely reflects differences in what is being measured rather than in method quality. Aggregate measures often perform well even when little information is supplied to the LLM, and can mask a complete absence of respondent-level differentiation. Third, we introduce the forgotten question problem, in which a question is omitted from a fielded study, as a setting for twin-based augmentation of existing data. We propose an ex-ante answerability diagnostic that requires no ground truth: the R^2 of a random forest predicting twin outputs from the data used to construct the twins. Across 108 attitude questions from a nationally representative survey (N = 3,063), screening at R^2 above 0.7 raises the mean twin-human individual-level correlation by 15% and reduces the share of poorly answered questions from 25.9% to 4.3%. Embedding similarity and experienced-researcher judgment provide correlated but weaker screens.

</details>


### [490] [Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14011)
*Nathan Breslow,Seungwook Han,Daniel Hyunsoo Lee,Aayush Mishra,Anqi Liu,Daniel Khashabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"汇聚涌现假说"(Convergent Emergence Hypothesis),即少样本上下文学习(ICL)作为一种能力,在不同模态数据上训练的自回归模型中都会涌现,并共享相似的任务难度结构。作者设计了一个跨模态受控评估框架,将同一套100个比特串转换任务通过模态特定的编码映射实例化到六种模态(语言、基因组、整数序列、图像、蛋白质、时间序列)中,并通过"clean vs deranged"(打乱标签对照)实验来衡量真实的配对映射能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICL此前主要在语言模型中被研究,近期在基因组模型中也观察到该现象。作者旨在回答两个核心问题:(1) ICL是否会广泛涌现于不同模态?(2) 不同模态的ICL是否共享某些基础能力结构?若假说成立,将证明ICL是一种更普遍的、由next-token预测产生的通用能力,提示工程等技术可跨模态迁移到蛋白质、基因组、时间序列等非语言领域。

Method: 核心方法包括:(1) 共享任务套件:定义100个{0,1}^8→{0,1}^8的比特串转换函数(30个原语+70个复合函数),作为模态不变的抽象任务集;(2) 模态特定编码:为每种模态定义编码映射ϕ_M,将比特映射到该模态的词汇表中(如数字、核苷酸、氨基酸、像素簇、正弦半波等);(3) Deranged对照:对演示样本的输出标签进行置换,保持输出多重集不变但破坏输入-输出配对,用以区分模型是否真正利用了映射关系(而非仅依赖输出分布适应);(4) 跨模态相关性分析:通过计算每模态100个任务的clean-minus-deranged准确率差异的Spearman秩相关,衡量任务难度结构的一致性;(5) 模型涵盖:Qwen3、Evo2、NextTerm、ImageGPT、TimesFM 2.5、ProGen2等公开模型,以及国际象棋和音乐作为反例对照。

Result: 主要结果:(1) ICL在六种主要模态中均涌现,clean准确率随示例数增加而提升,而deranged对照组基本平坦,六种模态在最大shot数时的配对差距从9.9pp(蛋白质)到31.4pp(整数序列),经Holm校正后均显著;(2) 五种非图像模态的逐任务配对效应高度正相关(Spearman ρ=0.35-0.89),基因组与蛋白质相关性最高(ρ=0.89),但ImageGPT与其他模态相关性较弱(ρ=0.06-0.15,与语言除外ρ=0.44),表明收敛不具普遍性;(3) ICL效应通常随模型规模增强,但不单调(如ProGen2在base处达峰);(4) 反例:国际象棋无配对映射效应(p=0.640),音乐效应极弱(0.0107,仅在n=32显著)。

Conclusion: 论文支持"汇聚涌现假说"的有保留版本:六种模态均涌现配对映射ICL,其中五种共享共同的逐任务效应结构,表明ICL具有跨模态共享的基础。但图像模态的异常说明涌现与汇聚并非等同:获得ICL能力(如ImageGPT)并不意味着其效应剖面与其他模型一致。理论上,研究表明少样本学习是next-token预测在复杂数据上的通用属性,而非语言模型专属;图像和连续时间序列的涌现表明离散一维标记序列并非必需。实践上,提示技术可跨模态迁移到基因组生成、价格预测等高价值应用。但相对ICL能力难以跨模态公平比较(受模型先验影响)、任务难度标量化、ICL涌现的可预测理论等仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL), the capacity of a model to infer abstract patterns from input-output examples provided in its prompt and apply them to new inputs, has been extensively studied in large language models trained for next-token prediction on human text. Recently, few-shot ICL has been demonstrated in autoregressive genomic models as well. This raises a question: does ICL emerge broadly across domains, and if so, what common structure is shared? To address both, we develop a controlled cross-modality framework that instantiates the same task suite in a variety of modalities to test what we call the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis: the idea that few-shot ICL, when it emerges, shares a common cross-modality difficulty profile - i.e., tasks that benefit from ICL in one modality tend to benefit in others. We show that paired-mapping ICL emerges across six modalities (language, genome, integer sequences, time series, images, and proteins), surpasses controlled baselines, and has correlated per-task effects across five of them. Together, these results provide support for the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis in some modalities, but not all.

</details>


### [491] [Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14015)
*Abtin Shafiei,Mohsen Hooshmand,Majid Ramezani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于EEG频谱图与CNN-Transformer混合架构的精神分裂症自动检测框架，在ASZED-153数据集上采用主体级别划分进行评估，最佳模型CST-SZ达到AUC-ROC 92.88%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于EEG的精神分裂症分类研究普遍存在数据集规模小、预处理策略不一致以及评估协议可能未能有效防止主体级数据泄露等问题，亟需一种标准化、可复现且泛化性强的检测框架。

Method: 1）使用ASZED-153数据集（153名受试者，16通道静息态EEG）；2）标准化预处理（重采样至256Hz、0.5-45Hz带通滤波、陷波滤波、共平均参考、伪迹剔除）；3）通过短时傅里叶变换（STFT，Hann窗，75%重叠）生成128×128频谱图图像；4）提出三种深度模型（C-SZ纯CNN、CT-SZ CNN+Transformer、CST-SZ CNN+SE+Transformer）并与SVM、RF、XGBoost等传统机器学习方法对比；5）采用70%/15%/15%主体级别分层划分防止数据泄露。

Result: 在独立测试集上：C-SZ的AUC-ROC为88.41%、F1为0.7532；CT-SZ的AUC-ROC为91.51%、F1为0.8026（最高F1）；CST-SZ的AUC-ROC为92.88%、AUPRC为0.8209（均最高）；传统机器学习方法中Random Forest表现最佳（AUC-ROC 90.04%，F1 0.7943）；重新实现的DWT-CNN基线为AUC-ROC 82.40%。CNN-Transformer混合架构整体优于纯CNN和传统方法。

Conclusion: 实验证明EEG频谱图包含可有效区分精神分裂症患者的判别信息，主体级别的数据划分提供了比样本级验证更可靠的泛化性评估；未来工作将聚焦于更先进的时频表示、自监督与Transformer架构、多模态EEG特征融合以及多中心大规模数据集验证。

Abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. To ensure reliable evaluation, all data partitions are performed at the subject level. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive classification performance, with the CNN-Transformer (CT-SZ) model achieving an AUC-ROC of 88.41% and the CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer (CST-SZ) achieving an AUC-ROC of 92.88% on the independent test set.

</details>


### [492] [VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14018)
*Zhong Cao,Shuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VeriDx提出了一种以疾病为中心的验证框架，将自由形式的诊断推理链接到结构化的疾病剖面，检查每个疾病假设是否满足、未解决或违反了临床义务，从而暴露缺失检查、未解决的鉴别诊断、忽略的矛盾、未经支持的声明和过早闭合等推理失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学大语言模型的评估主要关注最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实，忽略了疾病假设所引发的临床义务（如关键证据检查、替代诊断排除、矛盾解决、必要检查考虑、闭合正当性），导致"以错误理由得出正确答案"的问题难以被发现。诊断错误往往源于推理过程中对临床义务的破坏，而非孤立的医学知识缺失。

Method: 方法包括四个核心组件：(1) 纵向诊断任务建模，将诊断定义为三阶段序列决策过程；(2) 疾病剖面构建，从2,563份呼吸系统指南中自动提取结构化剖面（核心表型、支持证据、反对证据、重要鉴别诊断、缺失信息、关键检查、闭合条件）；(3) 疾病中心验证，将模型生成的推理轨迹映射到疾病剖面，将每个义务标记为满足、未解决或违反；(4) 有界验证引导修订，进行局部修补式修改而非完全重新生成。评估覆盖六个维度：初始假设生成、动态诊断修订、检查规划、最终诊断精度、推理透明度和治疗规划质量。

Result: 在188个专家标注的纵向呼吸病例上评估了14个前沿模型。关键发现：(1) 在完整信息下表现良好的模型在顺序临床推理中性能显著下降；(2) DDx-only验证主要改善动态诊断修订，Exam-only验证主要改善检查规划；(3) 完整VeriDx在跨模型（GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Claude-Opus-4.6）上均取得最强综合性能；(4) 消融实验显示DDx剖面对多维度性能贡献最大；(5) 使用LLM提取的剖面与专家构建的剖面性能差距较小，表明自动提取剖面已保留大部分临床结构。

Conclusion: VeriDx将临床推理评估从答案中心准确性转向疾病中心验证，将每个疾病假设视为结构化承诺，通过验证假设诱导的义务是否被满足来审计推理过程。这代表了医学LLM评估范式的转变——从"模型是否得出正确答案"转向"模型是否通过临床负责任的推理过程赢得了诊断的权利"。该框架作为神经符号桥梁，结合了符号临床知识的可解释性与LLM推理的灵活性，具有跨专科和跨高风险多步推理任务推广的潜力。

Abstract: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.

</details>


### [493] [MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14399)
*Zhenyu Zhang1,Jiudong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOSCOPT是一种文本原生、无参数的框架，用于联合优化LLM代理的技能池和门控调度器。它通过"技能混合"架构、基于编辑Adam的集体进化和文本原生路由，在5个基准和3个目标LLM上持续优于所有基线，证实多策略协同对复杂任务至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的提示/技能优化方法均仅优化单一文本模板，无法捕捉多种互补策略间的协同效应。然而现实任务常需要多种策略（如数学计算、检索、验证）在同一轨迹中协作，单一技能无法同时胜任这些多样化角色。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1)技能混合架构——维护N个互补技能的技能池和一个门控技能G，每步通过渐进披露选择K个技能；(2)EditAdam双状态文本优化器——维护一阶拒绝缓冲区(局部动量)和二阶长期记忆(跨epoch战略先验)，通过三阶段交错更新(技能编辑→门控编辑→集体进化)实现单调改进；(3)集体进化机制——通过淘汰(按Q-score)、繁殖(基于顶级技能突变)和协同育种(合并高协同C(i,j)技能对)维持技能池多样性，无需梯度或参数调优。

Result: 在SearchQA、GPQA-Diamond、HLE、AIME、LiveMathematician五个基准上，使用Qwen3.6-Plus时MOSCOPT平均得分74.1，优于所有9个基线(包括SkillOpt的71.5和EvoSkill的72.1)。跨3个LLM测试均显示显著提升(平均+11.8至+15.8)，且较弱模型(StepFun 3.5 Flash)受益最大。消融实验证实三阶段交错更新贡献最大(移除后降至67.3)，门控优化和EditAdam双状态设计均为关键。技能组合多样性比技能合并更重要：完全混合模式(74.1)优于静态路由(70.6)和单技能蒸馏(71.2)。

Conclusion: MOSCOPT是首个完全文本原生、无参数的技能池与门控调度器联合优化框架，扩展了单技能优化范式。其技能混合架构、EditAdam集体优化和文本原生路由三大贡献在多个基准和模型上证明一致有效。当K=1、N=1时MOSCOPT退化为SkillOpt，构成严格超集。代码已开源。

Abstract: Natural language prompts and skills serve as the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents. Recent advances in prompt and skill optimization have achieved notable gains, yet all existing methods optimize a \emph{single} text template---missing the synergy among multiple complementary strategies. We propose MOSCOPT, a text-native, parameter-free algorithm that jointly optimizes a pool of $N$ skills and a gating skill $G$ that dynamically selects $K$ skills per step. To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released this https URL .

</details>


### [494] [Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14408)
*Siddhanth Sridhar,Shreya Chaurasia,Baddela Sai Yaswantha Reddy,Deepak Parmar,Shylaja S S*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自动化流水线，能够将NCERT教科书PDF转化为针对用户查询的交互式个性化教育视频。系统结合了针对NCERT结构优化的RAG模型、Stable Diffusion图像生成、DynamiCrafter动画和Google TTS语音合成，最终通过MoviePy合成同步的多模态教育视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统静态教育材料难以有效传达复杂概念，尤其对以NCERT教科书为主要学习资源的印度学生而言，存在将文本内容转化为更易理解的多媒体形式的迫切需求。

Method: 流水线分为五步：①基于LangChain的RAG系统（使用PyPDFLoader、GPT4All嵌入、Chroma向量库、Llama-3.1/Ollama作为LLM），并针对NCERT结构做了文本清洗和图表引用优化；②正则表达式提取"the visuals of"提示词；③Stable Diffusion在潜在空间中逐层硬编码生成图像；④DynamiCrafter将静态图像动画化；⑤Google TTS生成多语言（英、印地、卡纳达、泰米尔、泰卢固）旁白并计算时长对齐；⑥MoviePy合成最终视频。

Result: 系统在NCERT教科书查询上能够生成连贯的多场景视频解释，Stable Diffusion生成概念相关的图像，DynamiCrafter产生动画序列，TTS提供同步旁白。学生和教师的用户反馈显示视频形式相比纯文本更易理解、更具吸引力，可作为补充教学工具。

Conclusion: 该流水线验证了将教科书内容自动转化为多媒体教学视频的可行性。未来工作将聚焦于：①将检索层升级为Agentic RAG架构以处理多步推理和跨章节综合；②引入情境感知的生成式音频模型替代标准TTS，实现情感化、节奏自适应的旁白。

Abstract: We present an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into interactive video explanations that respond directly to user queries. A user uploads a PDF and asks a question; the system then generates a video-based explanation as output, handling both text and visual elements from the PDF for multi-modal retrieval and response generation. The pipeline combines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model with generative multimedia components. The RAG stage is optimized for the structure of NCERT textbooks and performs best on content from those books. Given a user query, the RAG model retrieves relevant content from the PDF and generates a multi-scene script containing narrative explanations and structured visual prompts aligned with the textbook's explanatory style. These prompts are passed to a Stable Diffusion module, implemented layer by layer for interpretability and control, which generates contextually relevant images. The images are then processed by DynamiCrafter to produce animated sequences. Finally, a Google Text-to-Speech module generates synchronized narration, aligning speech with the visual scenes through time-based control. The result is a coherent video explanation integrating animation, narration, and textbook-aligned visuals, transforming static educational material into an engaging learning experience. By combining multi-modal document retrieval, generative visual models, animation frameworks, and speech synthesis, this pipeline demonstrates a scalable approach to delivering interactive, personalized digital education content.

</details>


### [495] [Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14412)
*Radin Hamidi Rad,Amin Bigdeli,Negar Arabzadeh,Sajad Ebrahimi,Charles L. A. Clarke,Benjamin C. M. Fung,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Question's Gambit，一种针对深度研究智能体（deep research agent）的"首步检索模块"，通过将复杂问题分解为独立线索（clues），分别检索并融合重排，为智能体提供一个高质量的"开局上下文"，从而解决智能体在迭代搜索-推理循环中面临的冷启动问题。该模块无需重训智能体或检索器，可即插即用集成到现有 ReAct 智能体框架中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理密集型问题具有多线索（multi-clue）特征：目标隐藏在多个异质线索（部分描述、日期、地点、标题、机构等）之中，需要跨文档验证才能回答。然而现有深度研究智能体直接从空历史开始迭代搜索，首轮检索结果（开局证据）质量决定整个轨迹走向——差的种子证据会导致"冷启动"，智能体被引入无关路径并难以恢复，造成搜索预算浪费、上下文杂乱、重复查询等问题。该瓶颈并非检索不到相关证据，而是智能体如何高效利用已检索到的证据。

Method: Question's Gambit 作为智能体的首次动作执行一次，包含三个阶段：(1) 问题分解：由智能体自身模型将问题拆分为多个独立线索（平均 9.6 条），每条线索代表一个独立可验证的事实约束；(2) 逐线索检索：对每条线索先用 BM25 检索得到反馈文档，再由固定 GPT-4.1 扩展模型（MUGI）结合语料库反馈生成扩展查询，最终查询为"线索 ⊕ 扩展 ⊕ 原始问题"的拼接，每条线索检索 top-1000 文档；(3) 问题条件重排：将所有线索的检索列表合并去重（约 2500 篇），用 Cohere Rerank4 Pro 对每篇文档针对完整问题进行点式重排，取 top-5 作为开局上下文 O=o₁。该模块集成到 Pi-Serini 框架中，开局上下文进入轨迹后，后续 ReAct 循环（Preview/Read/Paginate/Retrieve）保持不变。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 基准上（830 题，100195 篇文档）：(1) 答案准确率显著提升——GPT-5.5 从 83.1% 升至 90.5%（+7.4pp，p=9.7×10⁻⁶），GPT-5.4-mini 从 68.1% 升至 79.0%（+10.9pp），DeepSeek-v4-pro 从 71.4% 升至 76.9%（+5.5pp），且校准误差大幅下降；(2) 召回率全链路提升——GPT-5.5 的金标文档召回从 surfacing 94.4→98.1，preview 72.9→85.9，behavior 56.1→75.9；(3) 搜索调用次数与强基线相当，新增开销集中在开局动作和文档阅读；(4) 开局开销约 28.5 秒、$0.05，仅占总轨迹的 29% 和成本的 10%；(5) 在 MultiHop-RAG 控制基准上同样稳定提升（GPT-5.5: 81.0%→81.5%）。错误分析显示，剩余错误主要源于证据选择与合成（67.1% 的错误在 gold 文档被检索出后未进入行为轨迹），而非检索覆盖不足。

Conclusion: Question's Gambit 验证了一个新设计方向：深度研究智能体的有效性不仅取决于循环内的工具，**首步检索的质量同样至关重要**。通过将问题分解为线索并构造有证据支撑的开局上下文，可将冷启动转化为暖启动，使智能体将后续预算用于验证候选答案与填补证据缺口，而非寻找初始立足点。该方法无需重训、即插即用、跨智能体和跨基准均有效，为未来自适应开局（根据问题难度、歧义性、检索置信度校准或跳过首步）研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at this https URL .

</details>


### [496] [Safety Signals to Verify NetOps Agents with Action-Level Granularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14422)
*Tobias Labarta,Frederik Pahde,Novak Boskov,Maximilian Dreyer,David Birkenberger,Manzoor Ahmed Khan,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对NetOps智能体在数据中心修复任务中执行高风险动作的难题，提出了一套动作级（action-level）安全验证框架。其核心贡献是构建了一个符号级回放(symbolic replay)机制，可对NetArena基准中每个动作产生精确的"动作价值"真值，并据此推导出"progress(进展)"和"harm(伤害)"两个执行前预测目标。通过对比10个不同LLM智能体在4,500回合/31,480步中的数据，证明使用注意力指纹(attention fingerprint)等内部信号的验证器，在预测harm和progress上显著优于仅使用可观测信号的基线，可将漏报率降低28%-38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体正被部署到网络运维等高风险生产系统中，但现有的NetOps智能体基准缺乏对单个动作影响的逐动作(per-action)真值评估。智能体可能发出破坏性命令却仍看似在执行任务（因为有益和有害的命令可能字符相同，取决于网络状态），因此必须在执行前判断动作安全性。然而现有评估方法（如蒙特卡洛展开或基于结果的PRM）成本极高或不可验证，且依赖智能体自身策略，无法提供独立于智能体的ground truth。

Method: 1. **符号回放(Symbolic Replay)**：对NetArena中Mininet仿真的星型拓扑网络建立确定性符号模型，追踪每个节点属性（接口状态、地址等），回放智能体的所有动作，并在每一步用连接矩阵与基准对比验证（总体98.2%完全匹配）。2. **修复距离(Repair Distance)**：利用星型拓扑无冗余路径的特性，无需搜索即可直接计算出修复网络所需的最少动作数（即破损元素数）。3. **动作价值(Action Value)**：将动作定义为对修复距离的优势(advantage)变化，类似国际象棋引擎对人类招法的评分，并具有势函数的可叠加性。4. **两类预执行预测目标**：progress（修复距离在窗口内下降）和harm（修复距离在窗口内上升），窗口参数k∈{1,3,T}。5. **三类验证器族**：基于相关性归因的"grounding verifier"、基于AttnLRP计算得到的逐头相关性分布(attention fingerprint)的"fingerprint verifier"、基于残差流激活的"activation probe"，外加LLM-as-a-judge对照。信号在动作执行前即可获取。

Result: 在10款开源LLM智能体（Qwen、Gemma、Nemotron三个系列，4B-35B参数，密集和MoE架构）上完成30次运行。关键结果：1. 修复率从Nemotron-3-Nano-9B的18%到Gemma-4-31B的77%不等；2. 表现更好的智能体具有更高的检测率（r_s=+0.78），约一半动作是只读诊断；3. 12-15%场景为inert（注入故障未生效）；4. **指纹探针(fingerprint probe)是最强验证器**：在progress k=3上AUROC超过基线+0.060，harm k=T上超过基线+0.059（95%置信区间均不包含零）；5. 转化为漏报率降低：progress减少-28%，harm减少-38%；6. progress优势在短窗口最强，harm优势在长窗口增长；7. episode内（控制episode间差异）评估仍保持优势；8. LLM-judge在k=1最佳但随k增大而下降，且总体不如内部信号验证器。

Conclusion: 本文为NetOps智能体建立了首个动作级安全验证基准和评估协议。结论是：智能体内部信号（特别是通过AttnLRP提取的逐头注意力相关性指纹）能在执行前比可观测基线更可靠地预测动作的危害性和进展性，从而为高风险网络运维环境中的智能体监督提供了可行路径。展望部分提出这些信号将作为安全反馈集成到智能体执行框架(harness)中以实现高风险动作的自动弃权(abstention)。未来工作方向包括：缓解策略、与运维框架集成、对欺骗性或破坏性智能体的检测，以及通过进度验证提前终止无效回合以降低运营成本。

Abstract: Agentic Network Operations (NetOps) are an emerging paradigm promising to enable workload-aware, self-adjustable, and reliable autonomous networks. While agents have proven their value in incident summarization and telemetry signal extraction, their effectiveness as autonomous control-loop engines heavily relies on their long-horizon reliability. One such setting is the datacenter fabric, where an agent must respond to alarms and operator intents while abstaining from high-risk actions that may cause or extend downtime. Abstention, however, presupposes that an action's impact is known pre-execution, which necessitates a per-action ground truth that NetOps agent benchmarks do not provide. We construct such a ground truth for the network repair task of NetArena. A symbolic replay of the emulated network, validated against the environment at every turn, yields the exact value of every action. From the action-level value, we derive two pre-execution targets, namely whether an action reduces the repair distance (progress) and whether it increases it (harm). We show across 10 agent models, that agent verifiers leveraging internal signals predict both harm and progress more reliably than a baseline using observable signals only. Perspectively, we aim to use these signals as safety feedback to an agent harness to abstain from risky actions and protect the target system.

</details>


### [497] [When does a scaling result justify a different allocation? A critical review of resource-allocation evidence for AI systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14500)
*Seyed Morteza Emadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇批判性综述论文，核心问题是：AI领域报告的scaling结果何时能真正支持资源分配决策的改变？作者系统分析了scaling研究文献中反复出现的三类失配（mismatch）：成功度量方式（如coverage与returned-answer accuracy混淆）、系统所获信息（部署时不可得的oracle信息）、成本核算边界（遗漏验证器、索引等成本）。论文提出了"能力曲面"（capability surface）和"资源包络"（resource envelope）两个分析工具，并通过对Snell et al. (2025)已发表研究的实例分析，展示了如何判断一个scaling结果是否真正支持部署决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI scaling研究日益评估的是包含预训练模型与检索、搜索、验证、工具和交互的复合系统。然而，更高分数（在更大预算下获得）本身并不能说明资源应如何最优分配。作者旨在回答一个实践性问题：报告的scaling结果何时真正支持不同的资源分配决策？论文填补了现有scaling文献综述在"分配决策导向"方面的不足——多数综述关注机制分类或效率度量，但未系统审视评分方法、信息获取与成本核算之间的失配如何误导部署决策。

Method: 方法论上属于critical integrative review（非系统综述或meta分析）：通过追溯基础scaling与评估论文的双向引用，并针对训练-推理分配、测试时计算、检索、验证、智能体评估等方向进行定向检索（截止2025年9月9日）。核心分析框架包括：(1) 形式化模型——能力曲面 Q_k = g_k(b, s; I) 表示质量作为预算、机制与信息的函数；(2) 可达前沿 Q*_k(B; I) 区分已测程序与最优可达性能；(3) 全生命周期成本 C_life = C_dev + C_update(N) + Σ E[C_run]；(4) 资源包络——结构化记录任务、开发与运行时资源、信息访问与程序。论文还用三个解析示例（检索度量与部署量、生成与选择、停止策略）和一个已发表研究的完整包络填写来演示分析工具的应用。

Result: 综合证据显示三方面核心发现：(1) 不同文献反复出现同一模式：成功在选择答案之前被计数、部署时不可得的信息被使用、部分成本被排除在比较之外。(2) 论文区分了四种可由scaling结果支持的claim类型：条件性能、机制归因、已测分配、可行前沿，每种需要不同证据强度。(3) 任务类型决定资源瓶颈：发现类任务受验证能力限制、因果推断受识别信息限制、顺序组合受状态可访问性限制。(4) 通过Snell et al. (2025)的资源包络示例，论文具体展示了：报告的"4倍推理计算节省"在计入PRM/ORM训练成本与2,048次难度估计成本后，其分配结论的成立条件被显著收紧。(5) 资源交互的符号依赖于度量尺度，单一交互度量不能跨评分标度传递。

Conclusion: 论文的中心结论是：scaling证据在以"完整程序产出评分结果"为分析单位时更具行动价值。预训练、推理、检索、验证与交互研究各自建立了重要的条件性结果；一旦质量、信息获取与成本核算对齐，核心问题便转化为"哪种可行资源分配以最低代价满足任务质量要求"。对实践团队而言，一个报告结果支持不同分配的充要条件是三项检验均通过：评分基于返回答案、系统所知信息不超过部署系统将获得的信息、成本在团队核算边界内被完整计量。论文不提出通用scaling律，也不从基准增益推断通用智能。其主要贡献是提供了一个可操作的解读框架与报告规范（资源包络），并指出未来需要的关键实验方向：跨任务与运行条件的分配规则迁移性研究。论文的局限性包括目的性搜索无法保证穷尽、实证中心限于语言模型系统、解析示例基于简化假设。

Abstract: AI scaling studies increasingly evaluate systems that combine a pretrained model with retrieval, search, verification, tools, and interaction. Yet a higher score under a larger budget does not by itself show where additional resources are best spent. This critical integrative review asks when a reported scaling result supports a resource-allocation decision. It compares evidence across pretraining, test-time computation, retrieval, and agent evaluation, distinguishing the performance of a tested procedure from the best performance achievable under a resource limit. The synthesis shows that three mismatches recur across this evidence: success counted before an answer is chosen, information a deployed system will not have, and costs left out of the comparison. A capability surface expresses performance as a function of budgets, mechanisms, and available information. Worked analytical examples show how the evaluation metric, deployment volume, selection rule, and stopping policy can alter an allocation conclusion. A resource envelope provides a structured record of the task, development and run-time resources, information access, and procedure behind a reported score. Its application to a published comparison illustrates which conclusions the evidence supports and which deployment questions remain unresolved. The resulting framework specifies the comparisons needed to choose among feasible systems and motivates experiments on the transfer of allocation rules across tasks and operating conditions. It does not propose a universal scaling law or infer general intelligence from benchmark gains.

</details>


### [498] [Beyond Scene Description: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Non-visual Access to Virtual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14512)
*Toqeer Ali Syed,Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Danial Hameed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MetaBlind多智能体架构，通过无障碍编排器在8个专业代理与用户之间进行仲裁，基于负载预算的评分选择机制，为盲人或视障用户在虚拟世界中提供非视觉访问能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有辅助工具多为单一任务设计（如物体识别、文字朗读、路径规划），在实时虚拟场景中会出现"将视觉障碍转化为听觉障碍"的问题；用户注意力是稀缺资源，需要协调多个信息源，决定哪些内容、何时、通过何种模态传递给用户。

Method: 构建由8个专业代理（感知、导航、社交、物体交互、通信、安全与信任、记忆、个性化）和1个无障碍编排器组成的架构；代理仅向共享无障碍上下文发布候选信息，编排器基于安全性、目标相关性、紧迫性、置信度、用户相关性和倾听负载六个维度进行评分，并在负载预算约束下进行贪心选择；安全关键信息强制纳入输出。

Result: 目前为设计阶段论文，未进行原型实现或用户研究；提出了形式化的选择问题表述、编排周期算法以及评估协议，并明确列出可能反驳该设计的实验结果情形。

Conclusion: MetaBlind的核心贡献在于仲裁机制而非检测能力；下一步工作是构建原型并执行评估协议，包含消融实验以区分智能体专业化与编排机制各自的贡献；在缺乏实证测量之前，该架构仍是带有可证伪声明的设计方案。

Abstract: Virtual worlds now host classrooms, meetings, conferences, shops, and social venues, and nearly every interaction they expose assumes a user who can scan a three-dimensional scene, follow avatars, and read floating panels. Blind and visually impaired (BVI) users are left with assistive tools that each solve one task in isolation: naming an object, reading text, describing a scene, or planning a route. A live virtual room defeats that model: obstacles, speakers, gestures, chat, slides, and notifications arrive together, and a tool that narrates all of them trades a visual barrier for an auditory one. This paper presents MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents, spanning perception, navigation, social and object interaction, communication, safety and trust, memory, and personalization, and that places an Accessibility Orchestrator between those agents and the user. Agents publish candidate information into a shared accessibility context instead of speaking to the user directly. The orchestrator scores each candidate on safety relevance, goal relevance, urgency, confidence, user relevance, and estimated listening load, then releases only the items it judges relevant at that moment through speech, structured audio, or haptic output. We give the selection step a formal statement, specify the orchestration cycle as an algorithm, and define an evaluation protocol against a single-agent assistant. MetaBlind is reported at the design stage, with no prototype measurement or user study, and the protocol states which outcomes would support the design and which would refute it.

</details>


### [499] [OptoAgent: A Trustworthy Multi-Agent Framework for Opportunistic Vision Micro-Screening in Classroom Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14514)
*Toqeer Ali Syed,Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Hammad Muneer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SightSentinel（OptoAgent）架构，将教室墙壁显示转变为儿童视力机会性微筛查站点，通过 8 个专业代理协同工作，在不打断正常教学的前提下累积证据，最终输出受限的转诊建议而非诊断结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童视力下降常因缺乏参照而被忽视，且传统学校筛查存在周期性、人员依赖及脱离真实学习场景的结构性局限。已有数字视力测试工具仍需主动发起，无法捕捉日常课堂中自然出现的视觉困难。

Method: 构建 8 个协作代理（几何、刺激控制、行为、不对称、有效性、历史、治理、转诊），结合深度学习视觉骨干进行边缘端特征提取；采用乘积形式的质量门控 Q_{i,t} 过滤无效观测，使用衰减累积模型 E_i(T) 沿个体基线积累证据，并由 Vision Concern Score 映射到 4 级转诊带；临床安全门通过输出范围约束确保系统不产生诊断、验光、配镜或安慰性结论。

Result: 本文为架构设计论文，未报告任何实测性能。作者明确说明了四阶段验证协议（临床标定校准、融合消融、前瞻性校园部署、纵向早期发现检验）及若结果为负应被拒绝的条件。

Conclusion: SightSentinel 重新定义了筛查的发生时机——通过严格的效度过滤、个体基线对比和重复累积，使许多廉价、嘈杂但合规的接触能够达到单次定期测试可能错过或延迟的转诊决策。其核心经验命题——多次弱门控接触是否比单次强测试更早发现衰退——有待未来研究验证。

Abstract: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. We present SightSentinel, an architecture that turns a wall display a child already reads from into a recurring screening site. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. A quality agent discards observations taken under bad geometry, poor lighting, or inattention. A longitudinal agent accumulates only the surviving evidence against the child's own baseline, and an orchestrator reports a Vision Concern Score routed through a safety gate whose output range excludes diagnosis, refraction, prescription, and reassurance. The design question is whether many cheap, noisy, well-gated encounters can reach a referral decision that one scheduled test reaches late or misses. We state the formulation, the architecture, a four-stage validation protocol against clinical reference standards, and the conditions under which the approach should be rejected.

</details>


### [500] [AI Deployment Accountability Engineering: A Vision for Accountable AI in Safety-Critical Socio-Technical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14592)
*Murat Kantarcioglu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI部署责任工程"(ADAE)，主张将责任性从模型属性提升为部署层系统属性，围绕四大研究支柱构建安全关键型AI系统的持续可问责工程框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估以模型为中心（关注准确率、鲁棒性、公平性、可解释性），但这些属性在动态社会技术环境中不足以保障安全；部署后的分布漂移、制度约束、人机反馈环路、隐私需求及多智能体交互会催生模型测试无法捕捉的失效，亟需一个以部署为中心的工程子学科来弥合模型评估与实际问责之间的鸿沟。

Method: 定义ADAE为"为已部署AI使能社会技术系统设计、测量和维护其在明确风险、政策与性能约束下运行证据"的工程子学科；提出六项基础原则（部署中心、情境感知、持续性、隐私保护、系统级、后果导向且可执行）；构建由四大相互关联支柱组成的研究议程：情境依赖失效模式结构化发现、隐私保护责任测量、Agentic AI系统级风险分析（含交互图模型与概率化失效归因）、技术风险向运营/制度后果的转化（贝叶斯因果建模与蒙特卡洛模拟）。

Result: 形成一套以部署社会技术系统为分析单元、以动态交互图刻画Agentic AI为技术核心、以隐私保护测量机制保障合规、以风险链条将技术失效映射至制度暴露的综合性问责框架；明确各支柱下的具体研究方向（如自适应压力测试、安全聚合、来源感知日志、最小权限授权、上下文敏感风险容忍度、护栏机制等）。

Conclusion: ADAE的长期目标不是保证AI系统永不失败，而是使机构能够系统性地预见失效、早期检测、厘清原因、限制后果并提供可辩护的负责任运行证据；呼吁将监控、来源追溯、失效分析与干预能力视为关键基础设施，推动问责话语从"模型是否值得信任"转向"特定系统在特定环境中能否被负责任地运营"。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents. This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. ADAE treats accountability as a deployment-layer property rather than solely as a property of an individual model. It seeks to determine whether an AI-enabled system continues to operate within acceptable risk limits, identify the contexts in which failures emerge, attribute failures across interacting technical and human components, translate technical failures into downstream consequences, and support timely intervention. We articulate a research agenda built around four interconnected pillars: structured discovery of context-dependent failure modes, privacy-preserving accountability measurement, system-level risk analysis for agentic AI, and translation of technical failures into operational, and institutional risks. The broader goal is to establish foundational principles, mathematical tools, and system architectures for accountable AI deployment across safety-critical applications.

</details>


### [501] [A note on goal-based hierarchical RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14605)
*Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将基于目标的分层强化学习形式化为受控的双层分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM），统一并扩展了ACGVF框架（在完全可观测下让智能体自主选择目标与终止）和基于内部信念状态的智能体设计（部分可观测但目标外部给定）。通过引入分段式目标状态 $G_t$ 和每步更新的内部状态 $Z_t$ 的双时间尺度结构，并借助 done 动作作为边界耦合，论文给出了联合分布分解、目标满足模型、段级与持续级两种价值函数、对应的actor-critic学习算法，以及可扩展到更深层嵌套的HHMM框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 ACGVF 框架虽然赋予智能体自主选择目标和终止的能力，但假设环境完全可观测（状态即充分统计量）；而基于内部信念状态的智能体架构虽能处理部分可观测，却将目标视为外部输入。两者各自缺失关键要素，亟需一个能同时支持自主目标选择和部分可观测的统一形式化框架。

Method: 1) 采用分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）作为统一形式化：将上层抽象状态 $Q^2_t = G_t$ 对应目标，下层具体状态 $Q^1_t = Z_t$ 对应内部状态，完成标志 $F^1_t = D_t$ 对应 done 动作；2) 提出受控双层HHMM的联合分布分解（策略 $\pi_\theta$、状态更新 $q_\phi$、目标选择 $\mu_\eta$ 与环境 $p_{\text{env}}$ 的耦合）；3) 引入内部目标满足模型 $\sigma_\psi$ 替代完全可观测下的谓词判断，并据此定义内部奖励；4) 推导段级价值 $V_g$ 和持续级价值 $W_g$ 两种Bellman方程，建立ACGVF在隐状态下的推广；5) 给出分层actor-critic目标函数（包含满意损失、TD损失、双critic损失、策略梯度回报和时长正则项），并通过HHMM中的冗余性证明上层critic可由下层critic加权聚合替代；6) 提出持续时间感知的上层回报（$\gamma^{\Delta_k}$）与共享重放流训练两级策略的算法，并讨论通过扩展 $Q^1,\ldots,Q^L$ 推广到更深层嵌套。

Result: 1) 建立了目标选择、目标内动作选择、目标终止三者的形式化耦合，使其具备HHMM的call-return语义和暂时持续性；2) 将ACGVF的Bellman方程自然推广到部分可观测设置（用信息状态 $z$ 替代 $s$）；3) 证明了段级目标值与持续级目标值之间的精确关系（前者为零续值，后者含 $dH$ 项）；4) 论证了目标选择（mastery）与目标达成（goal selection）的目标函数可分离（前者基于内部奖励，后者基于环境奖励）；5) 证明上层critic $\kappa$ 是冗余的，可通过 $\tilde V^{\text{upper}}(z)=\sum_g \mu_\eta(g|z)V^{\text{low}}_\nu(z,g)$ 替代，避免参数与一致性冲突；6) 在每一时间步，actor与critic共享同一TD残差作为优势估计，简化了学习算法。

Conclusion: HHMM框架为基于目标的分层RL提供了时间语法——选择目标、调用目标条件控制器、在目标激活期间基于观测更新内部状态、并在智能体声明完成时将控制权上交。六项核心收益：时间承诺、部分可观测性、call-return语义、双目标共存（段级与持续级）、结构化信用分配（原始奖励训练低层，边界回报训练上层）、以及通往更深层嵌套的清晰路径。该工作将ACGVF的"自主性"与循环状态智能体的"信息状态机制"结合到HHMM的"时间语法"之中。

Abstract: The agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) construction of \citet{tasse2026goal} lets the agent make two decisions that are normally imposed by the environment or agent designer: which goal to pursue and when to declare a goal as finished (in addition to choosing the action). This is a very general framework that subsumes almost all prior work on reinforcement learning, control and planning, as well as more general formalisms proposed in the cognitive sciences. However, it assumes the environment is fully observed, i.e., that the observation is a sufficient statistic. In \citet{murphy2025rl}, a general agent design was proposed where the policy is based on an internal belief state $z_t$ and an internal goal; however, the goals were assumed to be externally provided. In this note, we unify and extend these two approaches using the formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM) \citep{murphy2001hhmm}.

</details>


### [502] [DynSTEER: Dynamic Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Execution-time Review for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14637)
*Zhichao Shi,Wenjie Zhang,Xuhui Jiang,Xiaojun Wu,Cehao Yang,Chengjin Xu,Jian Guo,Yuanzhuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DynSTEER框架，针对LLM智能体长时域任务评估中的三大痛点（终态评估、单参考偏差、高成本延迟反馈），通过分阶段轨迹评估、路径容忍的里程碑DAG、以及不确定性自适应的多级评判与在线早停机制，实现高效精准的过程级评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体评估范式存在三大局限：(1) 终态评估忽略中间过程，难以定位错误；(2) 单参考轨迹匹配惩罚合法的替代解题路径；(3) 事后评判成本高且无法提前终止失败运行。亟需一种动态、阶段化、路径容忍且成本可控的轨迹评估框架。

Method: DynSTEER包含三大核心组件：(1) 里程碑DAG生成——通过多候选模拟规划和严格多数共识从公共任务视图编译路径容忍的有向无环图，经传递性归约保留拓扑灵活性；(2) 分阶段轨迹评估——按已关闭动作划分阶段，以图论中的立即支配子(idom)为锚点划定证据窗口，按正确性、效率、安全性、工具合规性四维评分；(3) 动态策略适应与早停——三层级评判阶梯(规则/标准/专家)按不确定性和得分自适应路由，通过致命雷区拦截、结构性失败、持续低分、前沿停滞四类条件在线终止。

Result: 在ToolSandbox基准(509场景)上对4个LLM智能体评测：DynSTEER将评估判别力提升85.2%(DS从0.0270提升至0.0500)，在ϵ=0.01下100%统计分离所有模型对(6/6)；里程碑DAG工具操作Micro-F1达86.0%，致命雷场检测F1达86.7%，DAG编译有效率100%；早停机制在519个欠优运行中消除34.51%浪费步骤，平均净节省32.89秒/运行(总计4.74小时)；评判路由将61.4%检查分配至零LLM推理的规则评判。

Conclusion: DynSTEER将LLM智能体评估从被动终态验证推进到主动的阶段化执行审查，通过路径容忍的里程碑DAG、支配子锚定的阶段隔离、脆弱性聚焦的自适应评判与在线早停，为长时域智能体提供了原则化且成本可控的评估基础，显著提升了模型区分度与资源效率。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution. However, current evaluation paradigms face three major limitations: terminal-only assessment ignores intermediate processes and struggles to localize errors efficiently and accurately, single-reference matching penalizes valid alternative solution paths, and post-hoc trajectory judging incurs high costs without the ability to halt failed runs early. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework for agents. DynSTEER segments rollouts into stages anchored by key completed actions, focusing evaluation on essential milestones with adequate context while enabling targeted strategy adjustments. It compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from public task views to respect diverse legitimate strategies without leaking ground truth. Furthermore, it adaptively routes evaluation queries across multi-tier judges and halts unrecoverable executions online to curb resource waste. Experiments demonstrate that DynSTEER improves evaluation discriminability across LLM agents by 85.2\% over native evaluation, separates all model pairs with statistical significance, and saves 34.51\% of execution steps on failed rollouts.

</details>


### [503] [Diffusion-Based Generation of Gait Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14642)
*Damian Benasco,Juan Carballeira-Lopez,Jaime Ramos-Rojas,Julio S. Lora-Millan,Antonio J. Del-Ama,David Rodriguez-Cianca,Pablo Lanillos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索条件扩散模型用于生成下肢关节角度步态轨迹，并以步长等步态参数进行可控合成。基线为关键点条件Transformer扩散模型，可控变体为结合AdaLN-Zero与无分类器引导(CFG)的DiT。在4590个步态周期上实验，DiT在中步长(R=0.838, ROM误差≤±6°)上保真度高且对称性良好；短步长因类内变异性大而出现幅值低估与对称性退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下肢外骨骼等可穿戴康复设备需要随患者形态与治疗目标自适应且保持生物力学合理的参考轨迹；传统手工模板与优化方法在跨受试者、跨步态条件上扩展性差，扩散模型在临床步态生成领域尚未充分探索。

Method: 1) 数据集：22名健康受试者(短/中两种步长)，共4590个步态周期，每个周期含21个下肢关节角及生物力学关键点。2) 基线模型：基于MDM的关键点条件Transformer扩散模型(500步线性噪声调度)。3) DiT变体：将LayerNorm替换为AdaLN-Zero，将时间步与步长参数嵌入用于逐层调制，并采用CFG(p=0.25)实现步长可控生成。4) 损失函数：MSE + 周期性 + 速度 + 前向运动学足轨迹项的加权和。5) 评估指标：Pearson R、NRMSE、各关节ROM、双侧对称性指数、跨受试者泛化。

Result: 基线模型R=0.777，收敛于数据集均值步长(57.4±3.7 cm)。DiT在中步长(68.6±7.0 cm)上R=0.838、NRMSE=0.920，ROM误差≤±6°，对称性良好。短步长(36.4±6.4 cm)上R=0.813但NRMSE=1.225，膝/髋ROM低估约10°/6°，对称性指数退化至16–17%。踝关节在所有设置下误差最高(L Ankle NRMSE≈1.5–2.1)。失败原因归因于短步态的类内变异性大(膝ROM CoV≈42%)及CFG空嵌入偏置。

Conclusion: 条件扩散模型(尤其是DiT变体)能为外骨骼控制生成生物力学合理且步长可控的步态参考轨迹；中步长表现优异，短步长受限于类内异质性。步长不足以区分临床上重要的步态模式，未来工作将加入速度与个体形态参数并实现连续多参数条件化以推动临床部署。

Abstract: Generation of musculoskeletal gait trajectories conditioned on patient-specific parameters remains a key challenge for wearable robotics and rehabilitation. Assistive systems such as lower-limb exoskeletons require reference trajectories that adapt to individual morphology and therapeutic goals while preserving biomechanical realism. Traditional approaches rely on hand-crafted gait templates or optimization procedures that scale poorly across subjects and walking conditions. In this work, we explore conditional diffusion models for generating lower-limb joint-angle trajectories conditioned on gait parameters such as step length. We compare a baseline transformer diffusion model with a controllable diffusion transformer variant incorporating adaptive normalization and classifier-free guidance. Experiments on a dataset of 4,590 gait cycles show that diffusion models can generate realistic periodic gait trajectories while enabling some controllability variation in gait characteristics, highlighting their potential for personalized gait synthesis in assistive robotics.

</details>


### [504] [Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14708)
*Yecheng Wu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lightning Weave 提出了一种后训练能力组合框架，通过离策略蒸馏（off-policy distillation）将独立后训练获得的准确性导向与效率导向能力组合到单一学生模型中，在数学与代码任务上同时提升准确性与推理效率，达到新的准确率-效率前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型常生成冗长推理链，效率与准确性目标相互冲突；独立后训练的模型已分别具备准确性和效率方面的优势，但如何将二者组合到单一模型中尚缺乏系统方法。现有联合优化困难且单次蒸馏难以兼顾互补目标。

Method: 1) 用"锚点对"（pre-anchor → post-trained specialist）表示每项能力，以对数比（log-ratio）刻画策略偏移；2) 引入 Tilted-Target DOPD，将缓存的策略偏移转化为显式的倾斜目标分布，保证离线训练有明确固定点；3) 多锚点组合：在共享学生 token 状态上对各偏移按权重 w 求和，构造联合倾斜目标 q_w，并通过最小化 KL(π_θ ‖ q_w) 训练学生；4) 通过交叉分词器对齐实现异构锚点兼容；5) 每对锚点仅需对缓存轨迹评分一次，避免同时服务多个在线教师。

Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507、Qwen3.5-4B 和 OLMo-3-7B-Think 五种学生模型上，在 AIME 2024/2025、HMMT 2025、LiveCodeBench v5/v6 五个基准上，Lightning Weave 同时提升准确率并减少响应 token：在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，HMMT 2025 准确率从 59.2% 提升至 64.0%（同时减少 10.7% token），LiveCodeBench v5 准确率从 41.7% 提升至 54.2%（减少 9.6% token）；在 Qwen3-4B 上平均准确率提升 4.02 点且 token 减少 19.7%。调节锚点权重可得到经验 Pareto 前沿。GPU 时间相比在线 DOPD 降低 1.70×–2.18×。消融实验验证了 Tilted-Target 修正与多锚点组合策略的必要性。

Conclusion: 能力组合（capability composition）为高效推理提供了新路径：无需从零联合优化竞争目标，而是复用独立后训练专家的策略偏移并组合到单一学生中。Lightning Weave 通过 Tilted-Target DOPD 解决了离线缓存训练的目标不稳定问题，实现了可控的准确率-效率前沿。局限：实验限于 10B 以下模型；需要匹配的 pre/post 锚点对；纯效率收益仍小于专攻效率的方法。未来工作将扩展至更大模型、agentic 与工具使用等场景。

Abstract: A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distillation. Each acquired capability is represented by the policy shift from the model before post-training to the resulting specialist. Lightning Weave combines aligned log-ratio shifts at shared student token states and uses Tilted-Target DOPD to convert the cached signals into a stable learning target. Each anchor pair scores the cached trajectories once, enabling subsequent student training without serving multiple live anchor models concurrently. Across diverse student models and benchmarks in mathematics and code, Lightning Weave substantially improves upon the base students and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency frontier. On Qwen3.5-4B, it raises HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer response tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer response tokens. Adjusting the relative strengths of the anchor signals yields a strong empirical accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. These results establish Lightning Weave as a new practical route to efficient reasoning through capability composition. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [505] [Depth and Scale in the Sub-150M Regime: JugnuLM-53M vs JugnuLM-110M](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14715)
*Dushyant Rajput,Nirdesh Chauhan,Siddharth Kosaraju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在严格的控制变量下将一个53M参数的常规预训练配方（Qwen3风格解码器+GQA+RoPE+SwiGLU+RMSNorm+QK-Norm+z-loss，使用FineWeb-Edu数据）扩展到109.7M参数，**仅改变几何结构**为"深而窄"的23层×576隐藏维度设计。结果110M模型在BLiMP（81.3）、ARC-Easy（52.5）和WikiText-2字节困惑度（1.95）上全面超越53M基线，BLiMP以少约12%参数追平GPT-X2-125M，且所用训练token更少（~8B vs ~12B），证明增益源于容量与深度而非数据。在此基础上构建消融阶梯（R0→R4b）：值残差（R1）+Muon优化器（R2）累计提升ARC-Easy +3.6被保留；数据混合（R3）与两种logit蒸馏设置（R4a/R4b）作为诚实负面被舍弃。R2（值残差+Muon）为最终发布的最优栈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在sub-150M小模型机制下，回答两个最朴素的问题：(1) 仅靠扩大规模与加深深度（不改方法与数据）能带来多大收益？(2) 在该规模下，哪些"改进杠杆"（值残差、Muon、数据混合、蒸馏）真正有效？研究强调通过严格的"阶梯式消融+保优保留"准则得到可信赖的基线与改进，而非堆叠多个变化。

Method: **基线对照**：保持全部recipe不变，仅将8层×512隐藏扩展为23层×576隐藏（深而窄）。**训练**：FineWeb-Edu sample-10BT，bf16+DDP+torch.compile，4×RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell，余弦LR（峰值1.5e-3→底1.5e-4），全局batch约0.5M token，z-loss稳定logits。**消融阶梯**：R1在每层value上加来自第一层value的带学习门控λ的残差；R2将优化器替换为Muon（Newton-Schulz正交化动量）作用于2D隐藏矩阵（共81.4M参数），嵌入/头/RMSNorm增益/λ标量仍用AdamW；R3将FineWeb-Edu(55%)+DCLM-baseline(35%)+FineMath(10%)混合；R4a/R4b分别以α=0.5/τ=2与α=0.7/τ=1离线top-16 logit蒸馏自SmolLM2-1.7B教师。**评估**：BLiMP、ARC-Easy、WikiText-2字节困惑度，使用EleutherAI harness。**保留准则**：每级阶梯若未在ARC-Easy上击败上一级则舍弃。

Result: - **R0（仅缩放）**：53M→110M，BLiMP 78.14→81.25（+3.11），ARC-Easy 51.43→52.48（+1.05），字节ppl 2.04→1.95（-0.09）；以~12%更少参数在BLiMP上追平GPT-X2-125M(81.28)，所用token更少。  
- **R1（+值残差）**：ARC-Easy 54.67（+2.2），BLiMP持平(81.10)，ppl 1.94；门控λ收敛到非平凡值(-2.5~+3.2)，残差路径被有效使用。  
- **R2（+Muon）**：ARC-Easy 56.10（再+1.43），ppl 1.932，BLiMP略降至80.78(~2×SE)；Muon前期ppl领先-26%，末期压缩至~-1%，但下游ARC增益持续。  
- **R3（数据混合）**：BLiMP最佳81.79、ppl最佳1.909，但ARC-Easy降至53.62（-2.48），**舍弃**；原因推断为FineWeb-Edu的教育筛选与ARC-Easy的科学问题分布高度对齐，稀释教育信号损害ARC。  
- **R4a（重KD）**：ARC-Easy 56.99追平GPT-X2-125M(57.07)，但ppl恶化至2.178（过模仿教师软化分布）；**舍弃**。  
- **R4b（轻KD）**：ppl恢复至1.917，ARC-Easy仅55.47（低于R2），BLiMP降至79.30；**舍弃**。  
- **最终结论**：R2（值残差+Muon）为最优发布栈；53M→110M-R2在sub-150M榜单上以~88%参数接近GPT-X2-125M，ARC-Easy差距约1分。

Conclusion: 在sub-150M regime中，**深度优先的几何缩放**（8层→23层×窄隐藏）是优于"宽度优先"的强默认选择，能以更少参数和更少训练token达到同尺寸模型的语法理解能力（BLiMP）。在保持方法简单的前提下，仅两个便宜且正交的杠杆——**值残差**与**Muon优化器**——即可累计带来+3.6 ARC-Easy且几乎不损失BLiMP。多样的数据混合与离线logit蒸馏在该尺度并非净胜：教育数据的分布匹配比"多样性"更关键；离线KD在~15×师生规模差距与有限token预算下要么牺牲ppl、要么牺牲ARC。本研究树立了可复现的R0基线并给出了诚实负面，为后续更大token预算（25–40B）+ 衰减阶段教育数据上采样 + 改进蒸馏机制（reverse-KL、更小教师或全语料logit）的研究指明方向。

Abstract: We scale our conventional sub-150M pretraining recipe from 53.5M to 109.7M parameters, holding the method fixed (Qwen3-style decoder with grouped-query attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, QK-Norm, and a z-loss; FineWeb-Edu data) and changing only the geometry to a deep-and-thin 23-layer x 576-hidden design. The larger model improves across the board -- BLiMP 78.1 -> 81.3, ARC-Easy 51.4 -> 52.5, WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04 -> 1.95 -- and its 81.3% BLiMP essentially matches GPT-X2-125M (81.28) at about 12% fewer parameters. Notably the 110M model achieves this on fewer training tokens (about 8B vs 12B), so the gain is attributable to capacity and depth, not more data. Both models are deliberately conventional; this report is a clean scaling control and the baseline rung (R0) of an ablation study of what further improves models in this regime. An ablation ladder follows: value residuals (R1) and the Muon optimizer (R2) lift ARC-Easy by a cumulative +3.6 (52.5 -> 56.1) at a near-flat BLiMP and are kept; a diverse data blend (R3) and two logit-distillation settings (R4a/R4b) are not kept -- honest negatives. R3 pins ARC-Easy to FineWeb-Edu's educational filtering rather than raw diversity; distillation from a 1.7B teacher can reach the class-leading ARC-Easy (56.99, matching GPT-X2-125M) but only at a perplexity cost that dialing KD down then erases -- so R2 remains the best kept stack.

</details>


### [506] [Moral Rebel Agents: Decision-Making Under Conflicting Obligations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14716)
*Hector Munoz-Avila,David W. Aha,Paola Rizzo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自主智能体在执行用户分配任务时遇到道德义务冲突时的"道德反叛"能力，提出了五种智能体架构（无道德、功利型、义务型、功利-义务型UD、尽责型），在迷你搜救场景中进行实证比较，发现尽责型智能体在任务完成、机会主义救援和规范合规之间取得最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主智能体被部署在影响人类福祉的环境中，单纯服从用户指令可能与道德义务产生冲突。如何在执行过程中整合道德推理（特别是功利主义和义务论原则），使智能体能够在道德上合理的情况下偏离原始任务，是当前认知系统与AI伦理研究中的重要开放问题。

Method: 1) 形式化五种智能体架构：无道德（amoral）、功利型（utilitarian）、义务型（deontic）、功利-义务型（UD）、尽责型（dutiful）；2) 在层次任务网络（HTN）规划框架内实现执行时修复机制（execution-time repair），通过修改当前任务列表实现道德推理；3) 构建MiniSAR搜救模拟域（20×20网格，含5名受害者、4×4危险区、安全区，45时间单位救援期限）；4) 在两种实验条件（危险穿越有/无额外时间惩罚）下，对1000个随机生成的场景进行对比实验，记录四项性能指标。

Result: 实验结果显示五种架构在任务完成、机会主义救援和规范合规之间表现出明显权衡：1) 功利型智能体救援最多受害者但任务完成率最低、执行时间最长；2) 义务型、UD和尽责型均保持零违规，但UD因放弃分配任务导致完成率较低；3) 尽责型智能体在保持零规范违规的同时，任务完成率（约0.81-0.81）与义务型相当，并救援最多受害者（惩罚条件下最高），执行时间显著低于功利型和UD型；4) 在无惩罚条件下，UD与尽责型的差异仍然存在，证明承诺保持是一个独立的道德反叛维度。

Conclusion: 道德反叛不是单一行为能力，而可分解为效用、约束和承诺保持等不同决策机制。承诺保持（commitment preservation）作为独立维度对道德智能体设计至关重要——尽责型架构通过仅在分配任务可行时才允许机会主义行动，在搜救表现、任务完成和规范合规三方面实现最佳平衡。该框架虽在搜救域验证，但所提出的修复机制原理可推广至其他领域（需定义相应修复规则）。未来工作可结合因果推理与反事实智能体理论进一步丰富该框架。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are typically obliged to follow user-assigned tasks. However, strict obedience may conflict with moral obligations that arise during execution. This paper investigates \textbf{moral rebellion}: the ability of an autonomous agent to deviate from a user-assigned task when morally justified. We formalize five agent architectures: an \textit{amoral agent} that pursues assigned tasks without considering moral obligations, and four forms of \textbf{moral rebel agency}: (1) \textit{utilitarian agents} that opportunistically maximize task outcomes; (2) \textit{deontic} agents that enforce normative constraints; (3) \textit{utilitarian-deontic} (UD) agents that combine deontic constraints with utilitarian reasoning; and (4) \textit{dutiful} agents that additionally preserve commitments to assigned tasks. We implement these architectures within a hierarchical task network planning framework and evaluate them in a Mini Search-and-Rescue domain that exposes trade-offs among assigned-task completion, opportunistic rescue, and norm compliance. Our empirical results show that the proposed agents exhibit distinct trade-offs among rescue results, assigned-task completion, and norm compliance. In particular, the preservation of task commitments emerges as an important dimension of moral rebellion, for which the UD and dutiful agents produce substantially different behaviors despite their shared utilitarian and deontological foundations. These findings highlight the importance of commitment-aware moral reasoning for autonomous agents operating in morally consequential environments.

</details>


### [507] [Bayesian Intelligence from the Outside](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14724)
*Alex Smolin,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为基于Blackwell统计实验框架的智能体行为外部贝叶斯理性理论，刻画了LLM等智能体的报告分布何时可由贝叶斯更新解释、何时可比较信息量、以及如何最优聚合粗粒度报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型被深度集成到决策与经济场景中，如何从外部观测行为判断其内部推理是否具有贝叶斯一致性（即"内部理性"），成为基础性挑战。现有研究多检验外部证据下的更新一致性或偏好可理性化，但缺乏对推理过程本身的外部可检验性框架。

Method: 基于Blackwell统计实验理论建模：每个提示p诱导一个内部实验E_p，智能体以全支撑先验μ₀出发，经贝叶斯规则更新并忠实报告后验。重复抽样在同一固定状态下独立同分布。三个核心定理：Theorem 1刻画贝叶斯可信的报告分布族（充要条件为存在一个状态在所有提示所有报告下仍可能）；Theorem 2刻画两个智能体的"可信Blackwell占优"顺序（条件为存在耦合使更信息丰富者的报告排除集被对方包含）；Theorem 3刻画多次报告的最优贝叶斯聚合（仅受支撑约束限制）。

Result: 主要结论：(1) 报告分布族的贝叶斯可信性等价于"硬排除"在所有提示和报告间的联合一致性，条件频率与正概率大小无额外约束，鞅性质不成立；(2) 二元事件下，可信Blackwell占优等价于两个极端信念被更少使用；可转化为支撑面的随机占优检验；(3) 粗粒度报告的贝叶斯聚合仅需满足支撑包含约束，加权平均不满足而仿射对数几率池化满足，并在高斯智能模型下最优。完整状态报告存在先验修正的对数几率累加公式（不需要知道实验），但粗报告则产生聚合瓶颈。

Conclusion: 本文为理解智能体行为何时"智能"提供了理论基础，并凸显拒绝贝叶斯理性的困难——只要不存在完全矛盾的硬排除，观测到的任何报告分布都可被贝叶斯解释。智能比较与最优聚合同样仅受支撑约束限制，使得实际信息量差异难以从外部识别。该框架为评估LLM推理、self-consistency聚合、verifier-guided搜索等提供了外部可检验性基础，但需明确关于推理与报告的额外假设。

Abstract: Inferring intelligence from observable behavior is a foundational challenge in artificial intelligence. We develop a theory of Bayesian intelligence for agents such as language models. Each prompt induces a possibly imperfect internal experiment; the agent updates a full-support prior by Bayes' rule and faithfully reports its posterior over the possible answers to the question. Repetitions draw fresh, independent outcomes from the same unobserved experiment at one fixed state. We show that the agent's behavior admits this explanation if and only if its reports are not fully contradictory, i.e., some state remains possible under every report across all prompts. Report frequencies and the sizes of positive probabilities impose no further restrictions. We further propose and characterize the behavioral implications of an intelligence order that makes the behavior of two agents consistent with one agent having access to a more informative experiment: there should exist a coupling of report distributions such that the more informative agent's report excludes every answer excluded by its counterpart. Finally, we show the difficulty of aggregating coarse reports from intelligent agents: unless the agent reports a belief about the complete state of the world, the optimal aggregation can assign arbitrary weights to states that have not been excluded. These results provide a basis for understanding when agents' behavior is intelligent and highlight the difficulty of rejecting Bayesian rationality.

</details>


### [508] [AppliedScientist: Automated Scientific Revision Through Iterative AI Reviewing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14738)
*Vidushee Vats,Karun Sharma,Shengzhi Li,Shichao Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AppliedScientist，一个由"AI科学家"与"AI评审者"组成的闭环系统，用于对已被拒稿的论文进行迭代式自动修订。研究在30篇ICLR论文上对比了三种修订条件，发现评审引导的修订显著优于固定提示的自主修订，且执行类弱点（85.3%）远比创意类弱点（11.1%）更容易被解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI科学家和AI评审系统大多独立评估"生成论文"或"撰写评审"的质量，却忽略了核心问题：依据评审意见进行修改是否能带来论文质量的真实提升？特别是在闭环修订中，评审者既是引导信号又是评估者，其可靠性至关重要。因此需要研究：在迭代修订闭环中，AI评审者的引导能否真正改善论文？

Method: 系统包含两个组件：(1) AI科学家——保留完整的修订历史（代码、实验结果、稿件、评审反馈），可修改实现、运行新实验、更新手稿，但不改变核心研究贡献；(2) AI评审者——独立评估每版稿件（无历史记忆、无前序分数），通过结构化流程（识别贡献→文献检索→新颖性评估→方法批评→定位→建议）生成评审。三种修订条件：人类初始化（用原始venue评审引导第一轮，后续由AI评审引导）、AI初始化（AI评审从第一轮起引导）、自主修订（固定自审提示）。在30篇ICLR论文（涵盖NLP、CV、图学习、时序、RL五个领域）上每篇运行5轮修订（约9小时/$65），并使用Stanford Reviewer作为独立外部评估者验证人类初始化轨迹的质量提升。

Result: 在人类初始化条件下，AI评审者评分从平均5.37提升至最佳修订的6.53（+1.16），Stanford Reviewer从5.50提升至6.15（+0.65）；30篇论文在最佳修订时全部得分≥6（原始仅12篇）。评审引导的修订显著优于固定提示的自主修订，AI初始化条件收敛结果接近人类初始化。按弱点类型分析：执行类弱点（缺基线、证据不足、表述不清）解决率85.3%（128/150），而创意类弱点（新颖性、意义不足）仅11.1%（2/18），且残存的14项可验证创意异议均被人工核实有真实相关前期工作支撑。AI评审者本身在DeepReviewBench上与人类评分Spearman相关系数0.571，与venue决策一致率76.2%，优于多个基线。

Conclusion: 迭代式AI评审引导能有效提升论文的执行质量（实验、基线、消融、表述），但难以改变对核心研究创意新颖性或重要性的判断——这类问题需要回到构思阶段而非修订阶段。自主修订是一个有前景的方向，尤其适合强化既有研究的证据基础，但应认识到其在创意层面的根本局限。

Abstract: Automated reviewing systems are increasingly evaluated based on the quality of the reviews they produce. Yet a review is only useful if acting on it leads to a measurable improvement in the paper. We present AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system that couples an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer, and evaluate it by iteratively revising rejected papers from a range of research subfields. To mirror how human authors build on earlier drafts, the AI scientist has access to its previous versions during revision. To avoid bias from prior judgments, however, each review is generated independently, with the reviewer having no memory of earlier feedback or scores. We compare three revision settings: one initialized with the original venue reviews, one initialized with AI-generated reviews, and autonomous self-revision using the same fixed prompt in every round. Because the reviewer both guides and evaluates the revision, we also assess the human-initialized revisions using Stanford Reviewer as an independent evaluator. Reviewer-guided revision consistently improves more than fixed-prompt self-revision, and Stanford Reviewer also assigns higher scores to later revisions. AppliedScientist resolves 128 of 150 execution-related weaknesses (85.3%), but only 2 of 18 idea-related weaknesses (11.1%), suggesting that iterative revision is effective at improving experiments and implementation, but rarely changes concerns about novelty or significance.

</details>


### [509] [AcquireBound: Runtime Authorization for Resources Acquired by AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14744)
*Genliang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AcquireBound提出了一种针对AI智能体获取资源后的运行时授权架构，通过隔离、解析和激活三阶段协议及关系型安全包络，解决交易验证完成但资源语义权限未被有效授权的"履约后激活缺口"问题，并附带八项安全属性的形式化证明与多维度实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主AI智能体通过API调用可能获取凭证、计算环境、服务账户乃至新智能体等持久性资源。现有支付、预算、OAuth及履约校验仅验证交易条件，不判定返回资源是否构成可执行权限，导致同一交易记录可能产生不同语义权限（如管理员凭证与只读实例），形成授权决策的盲区——即"履约后激活缺口"。

Method: 构建类型化资源-能力超图，将获取事件分解为提议→保留→分发→隔离→解析→激活六阶段；采用向下封闭的关系型包络谓词在规范化活性投影上评估，跨同一授权域（issuer, canonicalRoot, policyEpoch）聚合所有活跃授权；隔离保管库对返回资源进行版本化解析，从认证的提供商状态推导真实能力清单；通过单次激活许可与单次效应许可在事务性提交点消费槽位，配合完整时期向量与域版本控制防止陈旧授权继承。

Result: 五类资源60个基准固件中良性20/20全部接受、unsafe 40/40全部拒绝；独立检查器在89/89篡改测试中拒绝；Codex与Gemini MCP客户端54/54次stdio调用完成；18例分级组合中16条unsafe路径未产生未授权Docker启动；五源1248对字段对审计显示无单一来源可独立完成激活判定；附带八项安全定理（隔离非授权、背书激活、非放大、分割不规避、崩溃安全至多一次、退款非复活、时期非继承、资源到效应约束）的形式化证明。

Conclusion: AcquireBound通过将激活决策从事前交易层移至履约后解析层，建立了"交易成功不等于资源可执行"的架构分离原则，为异构自主智能体系统提供统一可审计的获取到授权过渡规则；其条件性安全保证明确界定了假设边界与适配器合规要求，证实了关系型图谓词相对字段独立检查与标量预算的必要性。

Abstract: By acquiring compute, credentials, accounts, services, and other agents, autonomous AI agents can introduce new authority into a task. Payment, budget, OAuth, mandate, and fulfillment checks can validate transaction conditions without deciding whether a returned resource may become usable authority. This post-fulfillment activation gap spans tool-mediated creation, inter-agent delegation, and agentic commerce. We present AcquireBound, a provenance-bounded runtime authorization architecture. It quarantines acquired outputs, resolves their actual capabilities from authenticated provider evidence through a versioned resolver, and activates them only through a current activation transaction that checks the resolved manifest, provenance, epochs, and a downward-closed relational envelope over a typed resource-capability hypergraph. The envelope preserves correlated identity, effect, data, delegation, and graph-wide limits. Single-use effect permits are revalidated and consumed at effect linearization. Under explicit assumptions, we prove eight safety properties covering quarantine, backing, non-amplification, split non-evasion, crash/retry, refunds, epochs, and effect confinement. Across five resource classes, reference semantics accepted 20/20 benign traces and rejected 40/40 registered unsafe traces over 810 events; an independent checker agreed on 60 base and 40 refinement traces and rejected 89/89 tamper tests.
